articles.title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
articles.content: Native visual reasoning treats visual generation as the medium of reasoning itself: visual states (i.e. images and videos) are not merely inputs to be understood or outputs to be rendered, but first-class substrates for problem solving beyond language. Yet progress remains bottlenecked by the lack of scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. In this work, we introduce VBVR-Pro, a closed-loop testbed that makes native visual reasoning through generation trainable, verifiable, optimizable, and experimentally controllable. 1) Task scaling. VBVR-Pro turns visual reasoning into a controlled task space of 300 procedurally generated tasks. Models trained on VBVR-Pro show strong transfer beyond the proposed suite across seven external visual reasoning benchmarks such as RISE-Video, MME-CoF-Pro, and BabyVision. 2) Verifiable rewards. VBVR-Pro provides verifiable reward scorers for task-grounded evaluation. Through a systematic study of leading MLLMs as judges, we identify recurring failure modes of the prevalent VLM-as-a-judge paradigm. In contrast, the proposed scorers are grounded in deterministic, task-specific rules, achieve fine-grained alignment with human judgments. Importantly, they serve as reliable reward signals for large-scale multi-task reinforcement learning and demonstrate stronger post-RL performance across visual reasoning tasks. 3) Mechanism study. VBVR-Pro enables controlled modality studies across more than 30 image, video, and interleaved generators. Our analysis shows that video generation remains strongest for tasks requiring persistent spatiotemporal state tracking, while interleaved generation provides a compute-efficient alternative. Critically, ablations and probing suggest the presence of vision-native trajectories that are crucial to visual reasoning. We release all data, models, scorers, and code.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VBVR- Pro:一个可扩展和可验证的土著视觉理由套件
articles.content_zh: 原生视觉推理将视觉生成视为推理本身的媒介:视觉状态(即图像和视频)不仅仅是要被理解的输入或要提供输出,而是解决语言以外问题的一流底物. 然而,由于缺乏可扩展的培训任务、可靠的反馈和对基因底物的控制性比较,进展仍然受到阻碍。 在这部作品中,我们引入了VBVR-Pro,一个闭路试验台,通过生成可训练,可核查,可选择,以及实验可控,使得本土视觉推理. 1) 任务规模。 VBVR-Pro将视觉推理转化为300个程序生成任务的可控任务空间. 接受VBVR-Pro培训的模型显示,在拟议的套间之外,跨越了7个外部视觉推理基准,如RISE-Video、MME-CoF-Pro和Baby Vision。 2)可核实的奖励. VBVR-Pro为基于任务的评价提供可核查的奖励分数. 通过对担任法官的女法官进行系统研究,我们查明了普遍存在的作为法官的VLM模式的一再失败模式。 相比之下,提议的计分者则以决定性、任务特定规则为基础,实现与人类判断的精细一致。 重要的是,它们可作为大规模多任务强化学习的可靠奖励信号,并显示跨视觉推理任务的RL后性能更强. (3) 机制研究。 VBVR-Pro能够对30多个图像、视频和间叶生成器进行控制模式研究。 我们的分析表明,视频生成对于需要持续瞬间状态跟踪的任务来说仍然是最强的,而间叶生成则提供了计算效率的替代品. 关键的是,虚构和试验表明存在视觉内在的轨道,这对于视觉推理至关重要。 我们公布所有的数据,模型,计分器和代码。

articles.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
articles.content: Zero-shot cross-task generalization, where a policy must execute manipulation tasks never seen during training, remains a central challenge in robot learning. In large language models, a novel task can be performed simply by specifying it in the context, without any parameter update. This form of in-context learning (ICL) turns generalization into a problem of task specification. To achieve cross-task generalization, we bring this paradigm to robotic manipulation, and argue that the natural task specification for manipulation is a human video: unlike language, it provides rich visual cues about the intended task evolution. We present Zero-WAM, a causal video-action model that executes unseen tasks by following in-context human video guidance. To address the scarcity of task-rich paired human-robot data, we propose an automatic pipeline that converts task-sampled robot trajectories into semantically matched human videos, yielding HumanGen, a dataset of 74.2K human-robot ICL pairs across 8.6K tasks. For model training, we further introduce an in-context future chunk prediction (IFP) objective that suppresses shortcuts learned from seen tasks and forces the policy to draw task information from the video prompt. On seven unseen tasks in RoboTwin 2.0 simulation, Zero-WAM achieves a 47.0% average success rate, an absolute improvement of 29.5 percentage points over the strongest video-action baseline. In real-world evaluations, it follows human video guidance to generalize to unseen task configurations involving multi-object scenes, long-horizon manipulation, and fine-grained insertion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Zero-WAM:人类录影带中的世界行动模式,供不限时任务通用
articles.content_zh: 零镜头跨任务概括,即政策必须执行训练中从未见过的操纵任务,仍然是机器人学习中的一项中心挑战. 在大语言模型中,可以简单地通过在上下文中指定来完成一个新任务,而没有任何参数更新. 这种形式的内文学习(ICL)将概括化变成任务规格问题. 为了实现跨任务概括化,我们把这个范式带到机器人操纵上,并主张操纵的自然任务规格是人视频:与语言不同,它为预定的任务进化提供了丰富的视觉提示. 我们提出Zero-WAM,一种因果视频动作模型,通过遵循内在的人类视频指导来执行隐形任务. 为了解决任务丰富的配对人机器人数据的稀缺问题,我们提议建立一个自动管道,将任务抽样的机器人轨迹转换成精密匹配的人类视频,生成HumanGen,一个74.2K人机器人ICL对的数据集,跨8.6K任务. 对于模型培训,我们进一步引入了内在的未来块预测(IFP)目标,该目标压制从所看到的任务中汲取的捷径,并迫使政策从视频提示中提取任务信息. 在RoboTwin 2.0模拟的7个未见任务上,Zero-WAM取得了47.0%的平均成功率,绝对比最强的视频动作基线提高了29.5个百分点. 在现实世界的评价中,它遵循人类的视频指导,将任务配置概括到不可见的,涉及多对象场景,长视距操纵,精细的插入.

articles.title: RefVideo-6M: A Reliable Reference-Based Dataset for Instructional Video Editing
articles.content: Recent advances in video editing have been largely driven by large-scale instruction-based datasets. However, existing datasets still suffer from two critical limitations. First, target videos are commonly produced by automatic editing models, which may introduce visible artifacts and unreliable supervision signals. Second, most public datasets rely primarily on textual instructions, while lacking visual references that are crucial for precise, identity-preserving, and controllable editing. To address these limitations, we introduce RefVideo-6M, a large-scale reference-guided editing dataset containing 5 million video editing samples and 1 million image editing samples. To ensure reliable supervision, our dataset uses a construction pipeline that treats artifact-free real videos as editing targets and generates quality-filtered input conditions with multiple editing experts. In addition, it provides approximately 6 million visual references, covering diverse reference types and editing scenarios, thereby enabling models to learn fine-grained visual correspondence beyond text-only instructions. Based on RefVideo-6M, we further train a reference-guided video editing model, Ref-MoT, to evaluate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RefVideo-6M provides substantially more reliable supervision than existing datasets and enables the training of powerful editing models with improved visual quality, controllability, and reference consistency. The open-source dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RefVideo6M/RefVideo6M.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RefVideo-6M:用于教学录像编辑的可靠参考数据集
articles.content_zh: 视频编辑方面最近的进展主要是由大规模基于指令的数据集推动的. 然而,现有的数据集仍然受到两个关键限制。 首先,目标视频通常通过自动编辑模型制作,这可能会引入可见的文物和不可靠的监督信号. 第二,大多数公共数据集主要依赖文字指示,同时缺乏对精确、保存身份和可控制的编辑至关重要的视觉参考。 为了克服这些局限性,我们采用了RefVideo-6M,这是一个大型的参考指南编辑数据集,包含500万个视频编辑样本和100万个图像编辑样本. 为了保证可靠的监督,我们的数据集使用一个建筑管道,将无文物真实的视频作为编辑目标,并产生质量过滤的输入条件,有多个编辑专家参与. 此外,它还提供了大约600万个视觉参考,涵盖不同的参考类型和编辑情景,从而使模型能够学习精细的视觉对应,超越文本指令. 根据RefVideo-6M,我们进一步培训一个参考指南视频编辑模型Ref-MoT,以评估拟议数据集的有效性和可扩展性。 广泛的实验表明,RefVideo-6M提供比现有数据集更可靠的监督,并能够培训能提高视觉质量、可控性和参考一致性的强大编辑模型。 开源数据集见https://huggingface.co/datasets/RefVideo6M/RefVideo6M.

articles.title: A Visual Dependence-Aware Framework for Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training
articles.content: In this paper, we explore a novel task of Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training (MU-CPT), enabling deployed MLLMs to continually evolve from streaming unlabeled data. Existing unsupervised post-training methods for MLLMs typically optimize target tokens uniformly, overlooking their heterogeneous visual dependence (VD). However, we reveal that token-level VD is crucial for MU-CPT. Specifically, its structural distortion serves as an indicator of cross-modal catastrophic forgetting, and its inherent heterogeneity acts as a compass to guide new-task learning. Leveraging this property, we propose a Visual Dependence-Aware (VDA) framework with two main components. First, Visually Constrained Optimal Transport (VC-OT) formulates the VD structural distortion of old-task VD during new-task learning as an optimal transport problem to mitigate cross-modal forgetting. By designing a region-aware ground cost and a dependence-stratified transport penalty, it prevents global shifts in visual focus while strictly prohibiting visual reliance from degenerating into language bias. Second, Visually Modulated Adaptation (VMA) exploits VD heterogeneity to emphasize visually grounded new-task learning, promoting new-task plasticity. Together, our method simultaneously maintains old-task stability and new-task plasticity during challenging MU-CPT. Extensive experiments under our MU-CPT setting validate the effectiveness of VDA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一种可视的依赖性-智能的多式联运连续培训框架
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们探讨一项新的任务,即多式联运、无监督的连续培训后培训(MU-CPT),使已部署的MLLMs能够从无标签的流数据不断演变。 MLLMs现有的无监督的训练后方法通常统一优化目标符号,忽略了其多样的视觉依赖性(VD). 然而,我们揭示,象征级VD对MU-CPT至关重要。 具体而言,其结构扭曲是跨模式灾难性遗忘的一个指标,其固有的异质性是指导新任务学习的指南针。 利用这个属性,我们提出一个视觉依赖-智能(VDA)框架,其中包含两个主要部分. 首先,我们... 在新任务学习期间,视觉限制优化运输(VC-OT)形成旧任务VD的VD结构扭曲,作为缓解跨模式遗忘的最佳运输问题. 它设计了一种具有区域意识的地面成本和依赖性最低的运输处罚,防止视觉焦点的全球转移,同时严格禁止视觉依赖退化为语言偏见。 第二,可视化模块化适应(VMA)利用VD异质性强调可视化基于新任务学习,促进新任务可塑性. 在挑战MU-CPT期间,我们的方法同时保持旧任务稳定性和新任务可塑性。 在我们的MU-CPT设定下进行了广泛的实验,验证了VDA的有效性.

articles.title: MyoMechanix: Biomechanically-Grounded Compositional Skilled Activity Understanding and Coaching
articles.content: Existing action quality assessment (AQA) datasets and methods rely primarily on visual inputs such as RGB and pose, overlooking physiological dynamics such as muscle mechanics and often modeling actions as monolithic patterns. These limitations hinder fine-grained, biomechanically grounded feedback. We introduce MyoMechanix, a multimodal ecosystem for weight-loaded actions that aligns motion with muscle activity. Expert-annotated, it contains 7,500+ samples of 20 actions from 38 subjects, with synchronized multiview RGB video, 3D pose, sEMG, and additional physiological signals, forming the largest multimodal AQA benchmark to date. We further construct the Fitness Knowledge Graph (FKG), which organizes expert annotations into structured relationships among actions, phases, key steps, errors, and corrective feedback, enabling compositional scoring and interpretable assessment. Building on these representations, we develop CUBIST (Compositional Ontological Reasoning Engine), which performs decomposition-analysis-recomposition for fine-grained error attribution and feedback generation. We also establish MyoMechanix-AQA, MyoMechanix-VideoQA, and a novel MyoMechanix-Video2EMG task. Experiments show that multimodal sensing and structured representations improve performance, interpretability, and error attribution, with CUBIST achieving state-of-the-art results; VideoQA enhances language-grounded action understanding; and Video2EMG suggests video-based alternatives to costly EMG sensing. MyoMechanix advances skilled activity understanding toward biomechanically grounded, multimodal, and compositional reasoning for Physical AI applications in fitness, rehabilitation, healthcare, and machine learning. Project page: https://haoyin116.github.io/MyoMechanix/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 妙梦尼: 生物机械组合 构成 技能活动理解与指导
articles.content_zh: 现有的动作质量评估(AQA)数据集和方法主要依靠视觉输入,如RGB和姿势,俯瞰肌肉力学等生理动力学,经常将动作建模为单体模式. 这些限制阻碍了精细、生物力学上的反馈。 我们介绍 Myo Mechanix, 一种用于重载动作的多模式生态系统, 将运动与肌肉活动联系起来。 专家说明,它包含来自38个主题的20个动作的7,500+样本,有同步多视图RGB视频,3D姿势,SEMG,以及额外的生理信号,构成了迄今为止最大的多式联运AQA基准. 我们进一步构建了 " 适应性知识图 " (FKG),该图将专家说明组织为行动、阶段、关键步骤、错误和纠正反馈之间的结构化关系,从而能够进行组成评分和可解释的评估。 基于这些表述,我们开发了CUBIST(组合本体理性引擎),用于分解-分析-重构,用于精细的误差归属和反馈生成. 我们还建立了MyoMechanix-AQA,MyoMechanix-VideoQA,以及小说MyoMechanix-Video2EMG任务. 实验显示,多式联运和结构化的表示提高了性能、可解释性和误差归属,CUBIST取得了最先进的成果;VideoQA增强了基于语言的动作理解;Video2EMG建议采用基于视频的替代办法来取代昂贵的EMG感知。 MyoMechanix将熟练的活动理解推向基于生物机械的、多模式的、以及物理AI应用在健身、康复、保健和机器学习方面的组成推理。 项目网页:https://haoyin116.github.io/MyoMechanix/

articles.title: PlanSightRAG: A Visual-First Multimodal RAG for Automating Question Answering and Compliance Checking for Civil Standard Plans
articles.content: Civil infrastructure compliance checking has long relied on engineers manually reading legacy 2D plans; however, OCR-based automation strips away the geometry and layout essential for interpreting these plans. We present a Visual-First Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework called PlanSightRAG. It indexes and reasons directly over plan imagery, integrates a ColNomic-3B multi-vector retrieval, an agentic Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer, and MaxSim heatmaps as an evidence trail. We introduce a 4,056-pair benchmark from five state Departments of Transportation (DOT) standard plans (1,898 pages). PlanSightRAG achieves 91.47% Recall@5 on zero-shot retrieval, while on a held-out Michigan DOT corpus, it achieves 91.40%. On synthetic, parametrically-generated compliance drawings, our Qwen2.5-VL-72B pipeline reaches 100% verdict accuracy only when supplied a pre-resolved rule threshold, a controlled ceiling that a non-VLM OCR baseline already reaches at 76.4%. Finally, we demonstrate autonomous visual rule-grounding by extracting numeric limits directly from a specification corpus without any human-supplied rules.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PlanSightRAG:用于公民标准计划自动化问答和合规检查的视觉-第一多式联运RAG
articles.content_zh: 民用基础设施合规性检查长期以来依靠工程师手动阅读遗留的2D计划;然而,基于OCR的自动化脱去解释这些计划所必需的几何和布局. 我们提出了一个名为PlanSightRAG的视觉-第一多式联运检索增强型(RAG)框架。 它直接在计划图像上索引和原因,整合了ColNomic-3B多向量检索器,代理计划器-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer,以及MaxSim热图作为证据线索. 我们从五个州交通部的标准计划(1 898页)中引入了4 056页的基准。 PlanSightRAG在零镜头检索上实现了91.47%的Recall@5,而在被搁置的密歇根DOT仪上,它实现了91.40%. 在合成的,参数生成的遵守图纸上,我们的Qun2.5-VL-72B输油管只有在提供预先解规则阈值时才达到100%的判定精度,这个控制上限非VLM OCR基线已经达到76.4%. 最后,我们通过直接从一个没有人类提供规则的规格中提取数字限制来展示自主的视觉规则基础。

articles.title: ICON Decomposition: Multivariate Concept-Level Explanations of Deep Representations for Model Auditing
articles.content: Deep neural networks often exploit spurious associations in their training data, a failure known as shortcut learning. Concept-based explainability methods screen for shortcuts by testing whether concepts such as a patient's sex or scanner settings can be decoded from a network layer. Because each concept is evaluated in isolation, these methods can mistake correlations between concepts as evidence that the model uses them. We introduce ICON decomposition, which instead quantifies how much of a layer's variance each concept explains after accounting for all other concepts and the outcome. On synthetic data with known ground truth, ICON recovers concept importance more accurately than seven alternative baseline methods. On skin-lesion and brain-imaging models, it isolates the concepts on which a model genuinely relies, quantifies the representation unexplained by any of the supplied concepts, and yields sparse explanations that we validate by retraining and out-of-distribution testing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 独立 分解状态 : 对示范审计深层表述方式的多变概念-层次解释
articles.content_zh: 深层神经网络经常在其训练数据中利用虚假的关联,这种失败被称为捷径学习. 基于概念的可解释性方法筛选快捷键,通过测试患者的性别或扫描器设置等概念是否可以从网络层解码. 由于每个概念都是孤立地评价的,这些方法可以错误地将概念之间的关联性作为模型使用它们的证据. 我们引入ICON分解法,它用数量来解释每一层的差异在考虑所有其他概念和结果之后的多少。 在已知地面真相的合成数据上,ICON比七种备选基准方法更准确地恢复概念的重要性. 在皮肤松散和脑成像模型上,它将模型真正依赖的概念隔离开来,用任何提供的概念来量化无法解释的表示,并且产生我们通过再培训和分配外测试来验证的稀有解释.

articles.title: StreamPI: Streaming Multimodal Temporal Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated effectiveness in robot manipulation, yet state-of-the-art models such as pi0.5 operate under a single-frame paradigm, limiting their ability to retain past observations and develop precise spatial perception. In this paper, we propose StreamPI, a streaming multimodal temporal modeling framework that equips single-frame VLA with temporal reasoning capability without introducing any additional parameters. One core design is instruction-anchored temporal modeling. It treats each (visual observation, language instruction) pair as an atomic temporal unit: bidirectional attention within each pair enables cross-modal fusion, while causal attention across pairs preserves autoregressive streaming inference. This ensures the language instruction serves as a persistent semantic anchor throughout task execution. To bridge the gap between synchronous training and asynchronous real-robot deployment, we introduce a andom-interval streaming training strategy: a proper inter-frame interval (e.g., every 3 frames) enables faster and smoother action execution. Beyond this, randomizing the interval further improves robustness to frame-timing perturbations, supporting asynchronous deployment in practice. Furthermore, by leveraging the length extrapolation capability of the LLM backbone, StreamPI seamlessly inherits pretrained single-frame weights and supports flexible single-frame and multi-frame inference. Experiments on real-robot tasks spanning memory-dependent and precise perception scenarios, as well as the simulation benchmark LIBERO, demonstrate that StreamPI outperforms pi0.5 across diverse tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StreamPI:为远景-语言-行动模式简化多式联运临时模型
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型在机器人操纵中表现出了有效性,然而pi0.5等最先进的模型在单一框架范式下运行,限制了它们保留过去观测并发展精确空间感知的能力. 在本文中,我们提议采用流式多模式时间模型框架StreamPI,使单一框架的VLA具备时间推理能力,而不引入任何额外的参数。 一个核心设计是指令-预置时间模型. 它将每对(视觉观察,语言指示)作为原子时间单位:每对内部的双向关注可以实现跨模式聚变,而对对之间因果关注则保留了自旋流推论. 这确保了语言教学在整个任务执行过程中始终作为语义主线。 为了弥合同步训练与同步实际机器人部署之间的差距,我们引入了一种并时间流式训练策略:一个适当的帧间间隔(例如每3帧)能够更快更平稳地执行动作. 除此之外,随机的间隔会进一步提高稳健度,达到帧定时扰动,支持实际同步部署. 此外,通过利用LLM主干线的长度推算能力,StreamPI无缝继承了预先训练的单帧权重,并支持灵活的单帧和多帧推论. 关于真机器人任务的实验跨越了内存依赖性和精确感知情景,以及模拟基准LIBERO,表明StreamPI在各种任务中的表现优于pi0.5.

articles.title: UltraPIPS: Improving model perception in B-mode ultrasound with foundation models
articles.content: In medical imaging, it is common to use learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) to compare images semantically in feature space. Although backbones pretrained on natural images are widely used for LPIPS computation, B-mode ultrasound images possess distinct speckle patterns and acoustic-specific image statistics that are fundamentally different from natural images and even from other images in radiology. Consequently, we propose that domain-specific models are needed to measure perceptual similarity in ultrasound data, a finding which is not necessarily the case for other imaging modalities. We compare LPIPS metrics across downstream tasks like classification, segmentation and reconstruction using natural image, medical generalist and ultrasound backbone models and show that selection of LPIPS backbone is a non-trivial design choice. In particular, the ultrasound backbone models were more correlated with downstream performance of supervised models than classical and natural image models, and optimization of the LPIPS loss with an ultrasound backbone achieved a strong balance between reconstruction quality and realism. Our code is available at https://github.com/talg2324/UltraPIPS and introduces the UltraPIPS library, a set of LPIPS metrics based on the open-source foundation models analyzed in this paper.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UltraPIPS:用基础模型改进B-mode超声波中的模型感知
articles.content_zh: 在医学成像中,通常使用已学到的知觉图像补丁相似性(LPIPS)来比较特征空间中的图像. 尽管在自然图像上预先训练的骨干被广泛用于LPIPS的计算,但B-mode超声波图像具有明显的光谱图案和声学特异性图像统计,它们与自然图像甚至辐射学中的其他图像有着根本的不同. 因此,我们建议,需要针对特定域的模型来测量超声波数据中的感知相似性,而其他成像模式不一定是这种情况。 我们利用自然影像,医学通论和超声波骨干模型,比较下游任务中的LPIPS度量衡,如分类,分化和重建,并显示选择LPIPS骨干是一种非三角设计选择. 特别是超声波骨干模型与被监督模型的下游性能相比,古典和自然图像模型更为相关,使用超声波骨干优化LPIPS损失在重建质量和现实主义之间实现了有力的平衡. 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/talg2324/UltraPIPS 并引入了UltraPIPS库,一套基于本文分析的开源基础模型的LPIPS度量衡.

articles.title: Uncertainty-Guided Latent Diffusion Models for Faithful Super Resolution
articles.content: The perception-distortion trade-off poses a fundamental challenge in single-image super-resolution (SR). Although diffusion-based SR methods excel at generating perceptually realistic images, achieving high fidelity remains a key limitation. Recent advances in diffusion-based SR have shown promise in improving fidelity, but these methods often compromise perceptual quality due to their high reliance on a high-fidelity image. To address this, we introduce UGDiff, a novel diffusion guidance paradigm designed to further improve the perception-distortion balance. In particular, we first estimate the reconstruction uncertainty of the latent features corresponding to a high-fidelity image. This uncertainty is then used to guide the diffusion process to selectively restore high-frequency details in high-uncertainty regions, while preserving fidelity elsewhere. Furthermore, our guidance method adaptively identifies the high-uncertainty regions by considering not only the estimated uncertainty but also the posterior variance of the diffusion sampler at each timestep. This relaxes the reliance on the high-fidelity image in the later stages of sampling, thereby achieving a better perception-distortion balance. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art diffusion-based SR methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 迷信超强解析的不确定引导后期扩散模型
articles.content_zh: 认知扭曲的权衡在单像超解析(SR)中提出了根本性的挑战. 虽然基于传播的SR方法在产生概念上现实的图像方面非常出色,但是实现高度忠诚仍然是一个关键限制。 最近,在传播基础上的SR方面取得的进展表明,在提高忠诚度方面很有希望,但这些方法由于高度依赖高忠诚度形象,往往会损害观念质量。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了UGDiff,这是一种新型的传播指导范式,旨在进一步改善认知-扭曲平衡. 特别是,我们首先估计与高度真实性图像相对应的潜在特征的重建不确定性。 然后,这种不确定性被用来指导传播过程有选择地恢复高不确定性地区的高频细节,同时在其他地方保持忠诚。 此外,我们的指导方法不仅考虑到估计的不确定性,而且考虑到扩散取样器在每一时段的后差异,从而适应性地确定高不确定性区域。 这缓解了在采样后期对高真实度图像的依赖,从而实现更好的认知-扭曲平衡. 广泛的实验结果表明,我们的方法与以传播为基础的最新方法相比表现良好。

articles.title: FRAME: separating sampling variation from representational cause in medical imaging fairness
articles.content: Subgroup performance differences are the standard evidence for fairness bias in medical imaging, and the usual response removes the demographic information that a model encodes. Here we introduce Fair-model Reference And Mechanism Evaluation (FRAME), a two-step framework for auditing such a claim. The first step derives a fair-model reference, the distribution of the difference under exact fairness at the observed subgroup sizes. In the second step, we test the remainder with two operators in representation space. One operator cannot change a within-group ranking by construction. Across 702,206 images and 36 encoders, the reference accounts for a median 41% of the reported race difference and 22% of the age difference. Injecting demographic decodability leaves the remainder unchanged, while entangling the group with the disease direction raises the race difference from 0.077 to 0.118. No intervention we tested changes the remainder more than a change of random seed does. Those interventions reduce a difference at the operating point and leave the within-group ranking difference at a median of 0.000. Applied to 89 differences in 9 published studies across 6 medical imaging modalities, the reference accounts for a median 25% of a rate difference and 70% of a difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. Image-text pretraining instead raises worst-group performance by about 0.05. Applying FRAME before choosing an intervention could distinguish differences that need a mechanistic explanation from differences compatible with sampling variation at the current cohort sizes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FRAME: 将抽样变化与医学成像公平性中的代表性原因区分开来
articles.content_zh: 分组性能差异是医学成像中公平偏差的标准证据,通常的反应去除模型编码的人口信息. 我们在此介绍了公平模型参考和机制评估(FRAME),这是审计这种索赔的两步框架。 第一步是一个公平模式的参照,即按照观察到的分组大小的准确公平分配差额。 第二步,我们用两个操作员在代表空间测试其余部分。 一个运营商不能通过建筑改变集团内部的排名. 在702,206张图像和36个编码器中,参考数字占所报告的种族差异的中位数41%和年龄差异的22%。 注射人口可解码性使得其余部分保持不变,同时将群体与疾病方向缠绕在一起,将种族差异从0.077提高到0.118. 我们所测试的干预措施,除了随机种子的改变之外,不会改变其余部分。 这些干预措施减少了操作点的差异,使组内排名差异为中位数0.000。 在对6种医学成像模式的9种公布研究中,有89种差异,参考数据占一个比率差异的中位数25%,占接收器操作特征曲线下区域差异的70%。 相反,图像文本预训将最差组的性能提高了约0.05. 在选择干预措施之前应用FRAME可以区分需要机械解释的差异和与当前组群规模的抽样变化相符的差异。

articles.title: PANDA - Prototype-Anchored Alignment for Partially Unpaired Multimodal Learning, with Applications to Alzheimers MRI and TCGA Pathology
articles.content: Multimodal medical prediction often faces incomplete pairing: auxiliary modalities with complementary signal are available for only a subset of subjects (or none) and cannot be assumed at deployment. We introduce PANDA (Prototype Anchored Data Alignment), a two-stage framework that transfers auxiliary information to a primary-modality model without auxiliary inputs at inference. Stage 1 learns a shared embedding from the paired subset and estimates class prototypes from auxiliary modalities; Stage 2 trains the primary encoder on all subjects using cross-entropy plus alignment to the frozen prototypes. Because supervision is defined at the class-prototype level, PANDA accommodates arbitrary pairing rates, including zero subject overlap. We evaluate PANDA on two applications. On a 1,021-subject multi-scanner ADNI cohort, we perform AD/CN classification with three auxiliary modalities at distinct pairing rates: tabular scores (44.8%), FDG-PET (18.7%), and external handwriting kinematics (0% overlap). Relative to the same-backbone MRI-only baseline, PANDA attains AUC 0.868 +-0.020 (+7.9pp) and reduces 1.5T CN false positives by 24.3pp; on a fully trainable Conv5-FC3 backbone it reaches AUC 0.893 (best overall). A pairing-rate ablation shows that the joint anchor remains within seed noise from 75% to 5% pairing. On TCGA-Lung survival prediction from whole-slide images with RNA-seq as auxiliary data, PANDA improves over WSI-only on 2-year OS (AUC +3.5pp) and Cox PH (C-index +9.0pts) and outperforms full-fusion training, which underperforms WSI-only, while requiring no RNA at inference; wide confidence intervals on this smaller cohort keep the gains below conventional significance. Overall, PANDA provides a deployment-oriented mechanism for leveraging incomplete auxiliary modalities to improve primary-modality prediction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PANDA - 原型-安乔德部分未注册的多式学习,应用阿尔茨海默氏病核磁共振和TCGA病理学
articles.content_zh: 多式医学预测往往面临不完全的配对:只有子集(或无)的辅助模式具有补充信号,在部署时不能假设. 我们引入了PANDA(Prototype Anchored Data Unitation),这是一个两阶段框架,将辅助信息转移至初级模式模型,而无需辅助输入推论. 第1阶段从配对子集中学习到一个共享嵌入,从辅助模式中估计班级原型; 第2阶段使用跨进式加配合冷冻原型对所有主体进行主编码器的训练. 由于监督是按类原型来定义的,所以PANDA适应任意配对率,包括零主题重叠. 我们评价PANDA的两个应用。 在1,021个学科的多扫描器ADNI组群中,我们采用三种辅助模式进行AD/CN分类,其配对率各不相同:表分(44.8%)、FDG-PET(18.7%)和外部笔迹动画(0%重叠)。 相对于同一背骨核磁共振基线,PANDA达到AUC 0.868 +- 0.020(+7.9pp),并将1.5T CN假阳性减少24.3pp;在一个完全可训练的Conv5-FC3主干线上,它达到AUC 0.893(总体最佳)。 配对率的衰减表明,联合锚在种子噪声中保持在75%至5%的配对. 在以RNA-seq作为辅助数据的全滑图像的TCGA-Lung存活率预测上,PANDA在2年OS(AUC +3.5pp)和Cox PH(C-index + 9.0pts)上改进了仅WSI,并且超越了完全聚变训练,这种训练只表现不足WSI,同时不需要RNA推论;对于这个较小的组群来说,广泛的置信间隔将收益保持在常规意义以下. 总体而言,PANDA为利用不完整的辅助模式改进初级模式预测提供了一个面向部署的机制。

articles.title: Less Contouring, More Accuracy: Lesion-Guided ROI Deep Learning for Ovarian Ultrasound Classification
articles.content: Ovarian lesion classification using transvaginal ultrasound remains challenging due to overlapping imaging characteristics and the dependence on expert interpretation. This study investigates whether lesion-guided region-of-interest (ROI) deep learning can achieve competitive diagnostic performance while reducing the annotation burden associated with pixel-level lesion segmentation. Two publicly available ovarian ultrasound datasets were evaluated: the Multi-Modality Ovarian Tumor Ultrasound (MMOTU) dataset for eight-class classification and the Ovarian Ultrasound Dataset (OUD) for binary classification. Four strategies were compared under a unified framework: global image-based deep learning, lesion-guided ROI-based deep learning, lesion contour-based deep learning, and contour-based radiomics with machine learning classifiers. Four deep learning architectures, MaxViT-Tiny, Swin Transformer, EfficientNet-B7, and ResNet18, were evaluated. Radiomics models were developed using support vector machine, k-nearest neighbors, and artificial neural network classifiers, with ANOVA-based feature selection applied for the lower-sample OUD dataset. The lesion-guided ROI strategy achieved the strongest overall performance, with MaxViT-Tiny obtaining 93.10% accuracy and an AUC of 0.99 on MMOTU and 97.56% accuracy and an AUC of 0.99 on OUD. The contour-based approach achieved comparable accuracy but required substantially higher annotation effort. These findings demonstrate that lesion-guided ROI deep learning provides an effective balance between diagnostic performance and annotation efficiency, offering a practical approach for scalable AI-assisted ovarian ultrasound analysis
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 较少的轮廓,更精确:Lesion-Guided ROI 欧伐利亚超声波分类深层学习
articles.content_zh: 由于成像特征重叠和依赖专家解释,使用横断面超声波的有机损伤分类仍然具有挑战性。 本研究调查了损伤导引区(ROI)深度学习能否实现竞争性诊断性能,同时减轻与像素级损伤分化相关的注释负担. 对两个可公开使用的卵巢超声数据集进行了评价:用于八级分类的多动性卵巢超声数据集(MMOTU)和用于二进制分类的卵巢超声数据集(OUD). 在一个统一的框架下对四项战略进行了比较:以图像为基础的全球深层学习、以损害为指南的ROI深层学习、以损害为轮廓的深层学习以及以机器学习分类器为基础的放射线。 4个深层学习架构,即MaxViT-Tiny,Swin Transformer,高效Net-B7和ResNet18,都得到了评价. 辐射模型是利用支持向量机,k-近邻,人工神经网络分类器开发的,基于ANOVA的特性选择适用于下抽样的OUD数据集. 由损伤导导的ROI战略取得了最强的整体性能,MaxViT-Tiny获得了93.10%的精确度,MMOTU的AUC为0.99,OUD为97.56%的AUC为0.99。 以轮廓为基础的方法取得了相当的准确性,但需要大大加强注释工作。 这些调查结果表明,由损伤导导的ROI深度学习在诊断性能和注释效率之间提供了有效的平衡,为可伸缩的AI辅助卵巢超声分析提供了一个实用的方法.

articles.title: 4DGS-WAM: Bridging Past and Future with an Object-Centric World Action Model based on 4D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Current world action models (WAMs) typically operate on 2D visual data. These models can achieve exceptional visual quality, but they lack explicit spatial structure for individual objects and repeatedly process redundant background content. Although point clouds can represent the world in 3D space, they can be difficult to align and accumulate across viewpoints. In this paper, we leverage an explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) representation that separately models dynamic objects and the static background of a scene. For dynamic objects, we use a policy model to predict future actor actions and a world model to predict transformations of their observed Gaussian splats. The static background need not be regenerated for future states, as much of it has already been observed in past frames. This forms an object-centric world action model, which we name 4DGS-WAM. It lifts 2D observations into a persistent 4D representation so that previously observed static content can be reused during future prediction. Future-state extrapolation can then focus on modeling the evolution of dynamic objects. Experiments on KITTI-MOT evaluate short-horizon prediction and past reconstruction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 4DGS-WAM:用基于4D高斯镀板的物体-Central世界行动模型来弥合过去和未来
articles.content_zh: 目前的世界行动模型(WAMs)一般在2D视觉数据上运行. 这些模型可以实现超乎寻常的视觉质量,但它们缺乏单个物体的清晰空间结构,并反复处理冗余背景内容. 虽然点云可以在3D空间中代表世界,但它们可能难以在各种观点之间对齐和积累. 在本文中,我们利用一个明确的4D高斯电镀(4DGS)表示,将动态物体和场景的静态背景分别模型. 对于动态物体,我们使用一个政策模型来预测未来的行为者行动,以及一个世界模型来预测它们观察到的高斯海板的变换. 静态背景无需为未来状态重新生成,因为在过去的框架里已经观察到很多静态背景. 这形成了以物体为中心的世界行动模型,我们命名为4DGS-WAM. 它将2D观测值提升到持久的4D表示值中,以便以前观测到的静态内容在未来的预测中可以再利用. 未来状态外推法可以随后专注于模拟动态物体的进化. 关于KITTI-MOT的实验评价了短视预测和过去的重建.

articles.title: Auditable CT Phenotyping Through Report-derived Radiological Observations
articles.content: Medical image foundation models can predict clinical phenotypes from computed tomography (CT), but strong performance leaves open whether they read disease-specific findings or shortcuts that correlate with the diagnosis. We tested this in 221 electronic-health-record (EHR) phenotypes using Auditable CT phenotyping (ACT), built on report-derived radiological observations. We trained ACT on 38,317 patients, mined 376,194 observations and evaluated it in 25,183 held-out patients. ACT exceeded five vision-language baselines on zero-shot annotation, and CT-CLIP across 221 phenotypes from unseen CT pulmonary angiography, both under zero-shot scoring (0.651 versus 0.572) and under linear probing (0.709 versus 0.662). Reading each probe exposes what accuracy conceals: only 97 observations occupy the 221 rank-1 positions, and one phrase describing aortic and coronary calcification ranks first for 20 phenotypes, including osteoporosis, urinary tract infection and major depressive disorder. Restricting the bank to clinician-specified evidence redirects those probes onto phenotype-related observations in 86 phenotypes at no accuracy cost (0.751 versus 0.741). Accurate CT-based EHR phenotyping can therefore rest on observations that are not valid evidence for the coded phenotype and that ACT can identify and intervene on.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过报告产生的辐射观测发现的可审计CT
articles.content_zh: 医学图像基础模型可以从计算成像法(CT)中预测临床的苯基类型,但无论它们读取与诊断相关的特定疾病结果还是快捷方式,强效性都留有余地. 我们在221个电子-健康记录(EHR)中用可审计的CT线程(ACT)进行了测试,该线程基于报告的辐射观测结果。 我们对38 317名病人进行了青蒿素综合疗法培训,对376 194次观测进行了开采,并对25 183名被滞留的病人进行了评估。 青蒿素综合疗法在零射线注解上超过了5个视线语言基线,CT-CLIP从未见的CT肺血管学中跨越了221种苯基,既在零射线评分(0.651比0.572)下,在线性检测(0.709比0.662)下。 阅读每个探测器都暴露出准确性所掩盖的:只有97个观测占据221级-1位置,一个描述主动脉和冠状钙化的短语在20种苯基中排在首位,包括骨质疏松,尿道感染和重大抑郁障碍. 将银行限于临床医生指定的证据,可以将这些探测器重新定位到86种苯基中与苯基有关的观测中,不需精确成本(0.751比0.741)。 因此,准确的基于CT的EHR phenotyping可以依赖于对编码的酚类没有有效证据的观测,而ACT可以识别和干预.

articles.title: TAU-Agent: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Traffic Anomaly Understanding
articles.content: Traffic Anomaly Understanding (TAU) requires models and systems to detect, reason about, and explain anomalous events in transportation videos. To address this challenge, we propose TAU-Agent, an agentic retrieval-augmented framework for traffic anomaly understanding. Given a task query, a central retrieval agent orchestrates two visual perception tools, namely a Video Captioning Tool and an Open-Vocabulary Tracking Tool, to retrieve and select query-relevant evidence, including captions, temporal intervals, and object trajectories. The selected evidence, together with sampled video frames and the input query, is provided to a supervised fine-tuned vision-language model for final reasoning and answer generation. We evaluate TAU-Agent on both the in-domain and the out-of-domain benchmarks from the AI City Challenge 2026. TAU-Agent achieves scores of 0.6779 on Track 3, 0.3998 on Track 7, and 67.9275 on Track 8, ranking second, twelfth, and fifth, respectively. Code is available at: https://github.com/siri-rouser/TAU-Agent.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TAU- Agent: 代理检索-强化的交通异常理解框架
articles.content_zh: 交通异常理解(TAU)需要模型和系统来检测、解释和解释交通视频中的异常事件。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议TAU-Agent,这是了解交通异常情况的代理检索强化框架。 鉴于一个任务查询,中央检索代理组织两个视觉感知工具,即视频字幕工具和一个开放词汇跟踪工具,以检索和选择与查询相关的证据,包括标题、时间间隔和物体轨迹。 选定的证据,连同抽样的视频帧和输入查询,都提供给一个监督的微调视觉语言模型,用于最终推理和答案生成. 我们从AI City Challenge 2026中评估TAU-Agent的域内和域外基准. TAU-Agent在第3轨分别获得0.6779分,第7轨分别获得0.3998分,第8轨分别获得67.9275分,第2名,第12名,第5名. 代码见:https://github.com/siri-rouser/TAU-Agent.

articles.title: When Composition Doesn't Add Up: Humans Identifying Defects in AI-Generated Images
articles.content:
*Chulin Zhao and Ruoqi Hu contributed equally to this work.
  State-of-the-art text-to-image (T2I) models exhibit pronounced and systematic defects when prompts involve intricate compositional factors such as multiple entities and multiple attributes. In this paper, we investigate how humans identify such defects. Specifically, we manually select 651 reference images from the four categories of people, hand, object, and scene that exhibit complex compositional characteristics, from which prompts emphasizing compositional factors are derived by manually editing ChatGPT-generated prompts. We then feed the prompts into three selected T2I models to generate AI images and conduct a comprehensive subjective study to identify their defects. For each image, 29 participants provide multi-label assessments specifying defect types and locations. The study yields the compositional AI-generated image defect (CO-AID) dataset, including reference images, prompts, AI-generated images, and information on defect locations and types. Experimental results show that training a deep model on CO-AID can both predict defects in AI-generated images and optimize AI image generation, demonstrating its usability and effectiveness. The database and supplementary materials are available at: https://github.com/Future-IQA/CO-AID .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当组成不添加时: 人类识别AI- Generated Images中的缺陷
articles.content_zh:
{\fn华文楷体\fs20\bord1\shad1\1cHE0E0E0\2cH000000}♪ 趙秋琳和魯琪 胡人同样为这项工作做出了贡献.
当提示涉及复杂的组成因素,如多个实体和多个属性时,最新文本对图像(T2I)模型显示出明显和系统的缺陷。 在本文中,我们调查人类如何识别这些缺陷. 具体来说,我们手动从四类人中选择651个参考图像,手,物体,以及表现出复杂组成特征的场景,从中通过手动编辑ChatGPT生成的提示来得出强调组成因素的提示. 然后,我们将提示输入三个选定的T2I模型,生成AI图像,并进行全面的主观研究,以查明其缺陷. 对每幅图像,29名参与者提供多标签评估,具体说明缺陷类型和地点。 这项研究得出了由人工智能生成的图像缺陷数据集,包括参考图像、提示、人工智能生成的图像以及关于缺陷位置和类型的信息。 实验结果表明,对CO-AID的深层模型进行培训既可以预测AI生成图像的缺陷,也可以优化AI图像生成,展示其可用性和有效性. 数据库和补充材料见https://github.com/Future-IQA/CO-AID。 。 。 。

articles.title: Controlling for Omitted Variable Bias in Deep Neural Networks
articles.content: Control variables are widely used in statistical modelling to account for omitted variable bias of known confounders. However, they have largely been underexplored in deep learning. This is surprising, given that deep learning models encode image-inferable covariates, such as demographic variables, into their predictions when these covariates are correlated with the outcome---a form of omitted variable bias referred to as 'shortcut learning'. While many existing confound-control or fairness methods try to restrict the correlation of such covariates with model predictions, we show that this fails to correct for omitted variable bias. We therefore propose a control variable approach for deep learning models, based on generalised additive modelling of the effects of model inputs and covariates. As flexible additive models can suffer from concurvity, we introduce an estimation procedure that refits the final layer of a pre-trained network to include covariate effects, using cross-fitting with ridge penalisation. We show how these effects can be orthogonalised with respect to covariates to exclude their mediated effects and that model predictions can be marginalised over the covariate distribution to control for their effect. This yields unbiased, interpretable predictions and offers flexibility to model the desired effects depending on the scientific or fairness objective. We verify our approach using simulated images, and demonstrate consistent estimation of true effects. Existing methods either require more data or fail to recover the true effects. We apply our method to real neuroimaging data with experimentally induced confounding, where it recovers prediction performance to near the level of a model trained on unconfounded data. Code is available at https://github.com/mpff/cocodeel.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 控制深神经网络中的有机变量比亚斯
articles.content_zh: 控制变量在统计建模中被广泛用于核算已知混沌者省略的变量偏差. 然而,在深入学习方面,他们基本上没有得到充分利用。 这是令人惊讶的,因为深层的学习模型将图像可推导共变量(如人口变量)编码成其预测值,当这些共变量与结果相关时——一种被忽略的可变偏差形式,被称为“短期学习”。 虽然许多现有的混乱控制或公平方法试图限制这种共变与模型预测的关联性,但我们表明,这未能纠正省略的可变偏差。 因此,我们提议对深层学习模型采取控制可变方法,其基础是对模型输入和共变物的效果进行通用的添加模型。 由于灵活的添加剂模型可能存在偏差,我们采用了一种估计程序,将预先训练的网络的最后一层重新配齐,以包括共变效应,使用交叉配对的脊刑。 我们显示,这些效应如何在共变方面被正交化,以排除其介导效应,模型预测可被边缘化于共变分布,以控制其效应。 这就产生了无偏见、可解释的预测,并提供了根据科学或公平目标对预期效果进行模拟的灵活性。 我们用模拟图像验证我们的方法,并显示对真实效果的一致估计。 现有方法要么需要更多的数据,要么无法恢复真正的效果。 我们用我们的方法 将真实的神经成像数据 与实验引发的混乱, 在那里它恢复 预测性能 接近一个模型的水平 训练 未经证实的数据。 代码可见于https://github.com/mpff/cocodeel.

articles.title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
articles.content: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining the reasoning and coding capabilities of language models with the generative priors of video models. A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state and perform rule-consistent evolution. To connect executable state with visual generation, we introduce a proxy representation that encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video, which conditions a video model to render high-fidelity visual observations. We further develop data pipelines for constructing aligned proxy-observation pairs from gameplay and real-world videos. After fine-tuning on paired gameplay data, MiniMax-H3 follows proxy-based spatiotemporal specifications from simple interactive worlds built by the coding agent while preserving rich visual details and dynamics. These results demonstrate the potential of combining code for persistent world evolution with video models for flexible visual realization, providing a new path toward open-ended world models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代码世界模型:作为世界大脑的编码代理
articles.content_zh: 世界模型旨在模拟复杂环境在行动和事件下是如何演变的,然而现有的基于视频的世界模型主要是从视觉观测中学习动态,这些动态揭示的是结果,而不是指导世界演变的基本知识、规则和机制。 这使得难以保持持续的后果,也难以支持连贯、无限制的发展。 我们引入了代码世界模型(Code World Model),这个框架通过将语言模型的推理和编码能力与视频模型的基因前传相结合,将世界进化与视觉实现区分开来. 编码剂充当世界大脑,对事件及其后果进行推理,并生成可执行代码,以维持持续的世界状态,并进行符合规则的演化. 为了将可执行状态与视觉生成连接起来,我们引入了一种代理表示,它编码了帧式的spatiotemporal约束,并被编译成代理视频,它以视频模型为条件来制作高真实性的视觉观察. 我们进一步发展数据管道,从游戏和现实世界视频中构建对齐的代理观测对. 在对配对的游戏游戏数据进行微调后,MiniMax-H3遵循了来自编码代理构建的简单互动世界的基于代理的spatiotopal规格,同时保留了丰富的视觉细节和动态. 这些结果表明,将持续世界演变的代码与视频模型结合起来以灵活视觉实现的潜力,提供了通往开放世界模型的新途径。

articles.title: Visual General Intelligence: A White Paper
articles.content: This paper reconsiders intelligence from a vision-centered perspective and examines whether intelligence emerging from visual experience and learning may provide a pathway toward AGI. In the language domain, beginning with the introduction of the Transformer architecture, the GPT series has demonstrated transfer to unseen tasks through autoregressive language modeling on web-scale text combined with aggressive scaling. This raises a natural question, namely, what capabilities and forms of intelligence can emerge from visual modalities such as images, videos, and geometry? In this paper, we discuss whether visual intelligence can serve as a pathway toward AGI, referred to in this paper as visual general intelligence (VGI), by bringing together contributors from diverse standpoints and affiliations. Our aim is not to offer a single definition of visual intelligence, but to clarify the principles that computer vision should pursue in the AGI era, the visual input modalities, the benchmarks, the learning paradigms, and the relationship between vision, when taken as the core, and other modalities such as language.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉常规 情报:白皮书
articles.content_zh: 本文从以视觉为中心的角度重新考虑了智能,并研究了从视觉经验和学习中产生的智能是否能提供通往AGI的途径. 在语言领域,从引入变形器架构开始,GPT系列通过在网络尺度文本上自动递归语言模型,加之激进的缩放,证明了向隐形任务的转移. 这自然提出了一个问题,即从图像、录像和几何等视觉模式中可以产生什么样的能力和智能形式? 在本文中,我们讨论视觉智能是否可以作为通往AGI(本文中称之为视觉一般智能)的一条途径,通过将来自不同观点和从属关系的贡献者聚集在一起. 我们的目的不是为视觉智能提供一个单一的定义,而是要澄清计算机视觉在AGI时代应当追求的原则,视觉输入模式,基准,学习范式,以及视觉(当被作为核心时)与语言等其他模式之间的关系.

articles.title: Embedding NDRE Trajectories into Contrastive Learning for Label-Free, Physiology-Aware Crop-Stress Staging and DSS Outputs
articles.content: Timely detection of crop stress is critical for sustaining yields under increasing drought frequency, yet conventional vegetation index thresholds or image-based clustering often fail to capture stress progression, limiting their value for farm decision-making. To address this gap, we present EigenCL, a physiology-guided contrastive learning framework that stages crop stress from Sentinel-2 NDRE trajectories, with the goal of providing interpretable and transferable stress diagnostics for decision support systems (DSS). EigenCL was trained on 10,000 maize NDRE patches from drought-affected Iowa fields in 2020 and tested on Nebraska fields in 2023 without retraining, with validation incorporating soil-moisture records, U.S. Drought Monitor maps, and county-level yield statistics. The model produced four physiologically coherent stress clusters (Healthy, Mild, Moderate, Severe), significantly outperforming baselines including K-Means, SimCLR, ProtoCLR, and an ablation model (Silhouette = 0.748, DBI = 0.35, CHI = 49,624). Clusters aligned with maize growth stages, with severe stress peaking around tasseling-silking (VT-R1), a stage known to drive yield loss; moreover, EigenCL clusters correlated with soil moisture at 0-14-day lags (rho up to 0.72) and matched yield anomalies in drought-affected counties. By embedding NDRE trajectory dynamics into contrastive learning, EigenCL enables early stress alerts and interpretable DSS outputs (e.g., heatmaps, scouting priorities, regional risk indices), extending beyond single-date NDRE thresholds and supporting scalable monitoring for climate-smart agronomy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 嵌入的NDRE 内置 为无标签、生理学、智能作物、压力和安保部产出进行对照学习的轨迹
articles.content_zh: 及时发现作物压力对于在干旱频率增加的情况下维持产量至关重要,但传统的植被指数阈值或基于图像的集聚往往无法反映压力的发展,限制了其对农场决策的价值。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了EigenCL,这是一个生理学指导的对比性学习框架,它从Sentinel-2 NDRE轨迹中分解作物压力,目的是为决策支持系统提供可解释和可转移的压力诊断。 EigenCL于2020年接受了来自受干旱影响的艾奥瓦田地的10,000个玉米NDRE补丁的培训,并于2023年在内布拉斯加州田地进行了测试,没有再培训,其验证内容包括土壤污染记录、美国干旱监测地图和县级产量统计。 该模型产生了四个生理上一致的应力集合体(健康,Mild,中度,严重),显著超过基线,包括K-Means,SimCLR,ProtoCLR,以及一个衰竭模型(Silhouette=0.748,DBI=0.35,CHI=49,624). 组群与玉米生长阶段相一致,在集成-硅(VT-R1)周围出现严重压力峰值,这一阶段已知会导致产量损失;此外,EigenCL组群与土壤水分在0-14天的滞后期(rho至0.72)相关,与受干旱影响县的产量异常情况相符。 通过将NDRE轨迹动态纳入对比性学习,EigenCL使早期压力警报和可解释的DSS产出(如热图、侦察优先事项、区域风险指数)得以扩展,超出单日NDRE阈值,并支持气候智能农学的可扩展监测。

articles.title: Do Vision-Language Models Agree on the Affective Qualities of Shape? A Cross-Model Audit for Generative Design Interfaces
articles.content: Generative design interfaces increasingly expose semantic controls that let users steer output with concepts such as "more elegant" or "more minimalist," typically encoded by a vision-language model (VLM). A practical question is whether state-of-the-art VLMs represent objects consistently in terms of the same concept. We audit 6 VLMs by ranking untextured 3D objects along Kansei adjective pairs, where Kansei describes affective impressions of product form, with each axis defined as the difference between the text representations of its two poles. Geometric pairs serve as positive controls, and pairs of unrelated adjectives establish an empirical null. Across 10 categories of ShapeNet database, affective axes converge above the null (mean pairwise rank correlation 0.36 vs. 0.14) but below the geometric ceiling (0.44). The agreement between models is partial and highly uneven: on the three axes shared by all categories, mean convergence ranges from 0.21 for bookshelves to 0.51 for jars. Convergence depends primarily on whether a category's representational variation aligns with the semantic direction being evaluated, rather than simply on how much the objects vary in shape overall. Cross-model convergence does not imply agreement with human judgments. Based on our findings, we implement a UI prototype that shows how the audit can inform which Kansei descriptors to expose as controls for a given object class and which to withhold.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型是否同意形状的动感性定性?. 基因设计接口的跨模式审计
articles.content_zh: 基因设计接口越来越暴露语义控制,让用户用"更优雅"或"更最小化"等概念来引导输出,一般用视觉语言模型(VLM)编码. 一个实际问题是,最新水平的VLM是否以同一概念一致地代表物体。 我们审计6个VLM,沿着Kansei形容词对排列无文字的3D对象,其中Kansei描述产品形态的情感印象,每个轴被定义为其两极的文字表示的区别. 几何对作为正控,对不相关的形容词建立经验无效. 在ShepeNet数据库的10个类别中,震动轴在无效(平均对等级关系0.36对0.14)以上,但低于几何上限(0.44)。 模型之间的协议是片面的,高度不平衡:在所有类别共享的三轴上,平均趋同度从书架0.21到罐子0.51不等. 趋同主要取决于某一类的表达式变异是否与被评价的语义方向一致,而不是简单地取决于物体在整体形状上的差异有多大. 跨模式的趋同并不意味着同意人类的判断。 根据我们的调查结果,我们实施了一个UI原型,显示审计如何告知哪些Kansei描述者要作为特定对象类别的控制而披露,哪些要拒绝。

articles.title: LUTSeg: A Longitudinal Multi-Expert Dataset for Ulcer Tissue Segmentation
articles.content: Quantifying wound tissue composition is essential for monitoring chronic ulcer progression and guiding treatment decisions. However, pixel-level annotations are costly, and multi-tissue wound datasets remain scarce, particularly for neglected diseases such as leprosy. We introduce LUTSeg, a longitudinal chronic ulcer dataset comprising 141 images from 39 patients with wound masks and five tissue categories annotated by five expert clinicians, including a multi-expert gold-standard subset for inter-rater agreement analysis. To establish an initial benchmark for LUTSeg, we further propose TiSage, a semi-supervised tissue segmentation framework that integrates multi-scale semantic priors from a frozen medical vision-language model within a teacher-student architecture. We evaluate TiSage on LUTSeg and DFUTissue, showing improvements over supervised and semi-supervised baselines in most low-label settings. Code & data: https://github.com/carlosh93/TiSage
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LUTSeg:用于 Ulcer 组织的纵向多实验数据集
articles.content_zh: 量化伤口组织组成对于监测慢性溃疡进展和指导治疗决定至关重要。 然而,像素级的说明成本很高,多问题伤口数据集仍然很少,特别是麻风病等被忽视的疾病. 我们介绍LUTSeg,这是一个纵向慢性溃疡数据集,由39名有伤口口罩的病人的141张图像和5个组织类别组成,由5名专家临床医生作注释,包括一个用于对双方协议进行分析的多专家黄金标准子集。 为建立LUTSeg的初始基准,我们进一步提出TiSage,即一个半监督组织分解框架,将多尺度语义学前科从一个冻结的医疗视觉语言模型中整合到师生结构中. 我们用LUTSeg和DFUT问题来评价TiSage,显示在大多数低标签环境中,比监督的和半监督的基线有所改善。 代码和数据:https://github.com/carlosh93/TiSage

articles.title: Learning Late, Guiding Early: Timestep-Decoupled Semantic Guidance for Fair Face Generation
articles.content: Demographic imbalance in synthetic face generation can propagate to downstream face recognition systems, making fairness an important consideration when diffusion models are used for data generation. Existing fairness-aware generation approaches often require model retraining, architectural modifications, or repeated guidance throughout the reverse diffusion process. In this work, we introduce Semantic Boundary Predictor (SBP), an inference-time framework that performs demographic guidance through a one-shot intervention during reverse denoising. Our approach is motivated by the observation that latent representations at different diffusion timesteps play distinct semantic roles: late-stage latents provide stronger demographic separability, whereas early-stage latents offer greater flexibility for semantic intervention. SBP leverages this timestep decoupling by learning linear semantic boundaries from late-stage latent representations while applying them only once at the initial noisy latent, allowing the remainder of the reverse denoising process to proceed unchanged. The method requires neither retraining nor fine-tuning of the underlying Latent Diffusion Model and operates without external balanced datasets. Experiments on CelebA-HQ demonstrate substantial improvements in demographic fairness, reducing fairness disparity by 98% for gender, 95% for binary race, and 15% for four-class race, while maintaining perceptual image quality across demographic groups. Owing to its one-shot inference strategy and model-agnostic design, SBP introduces only a small computational overhead and can be readily integrated with existing pre-trained latent diffusion models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习迟到,指导早期:为公平面部生成提供时间步调减速语义指导
articles.content_zh: 合成面部生成中的人口失衡可以传播到下游面部识别系统,在使用传播模型生成数据时,公平性成为一个重要的考虑因素. 现有的公平意识生成方法往往需要模式再培训、建筑改造或在整个反向传播过程中反复提供指导。 在这项工作中,我们引入了语义边界预断器(SBP),这是一个推论时间框架,通过在反向解密时的一弹一弹干预来进行人口指导. 我们之所以采取这一办法,是因为有观点认为,在不同扩散阶段的潜在表述具有不同的语义作用:后期潜在表述提供了更强的人口分布,而早期潜在表述为语义干预提供了更大的灵活性。 SBP通过从后期潜在表达中学习线性语义边界,同时在最初的扰动潜伏中只应用一次,从而利用这一时间步脱钩,使反向解密过程的其余部分能够保持不变地进行。 这种方法既不需要再培训,也不需要调整基本的Latent扩散模型,而且没有外部平衡数据集。 CelebA-HQ的实验显示,人口公平性有了很大的改善,性别的公平性差距减少了98%,二进制种族减少了95%,四级种族减少了15%,同时保持了各人口群体的观念形象质量。 由于其一发即发的推论策略和模型不可知性设计,SBP只引入了少量的计算管理费,并且可以随时与现有的预先训练的潜在扩散模型结合.

articles.title: Precipitation Downscaling Using Foundation Model-Conditioned Diffusion
articles.content: High-resolution precipitation fields are essential for hydrological impact assessment, yet global climate model outputs are too coarse and biased for direct use. AI-based statistical downscaling with diffusion models offers a promising approach, but the mechanism by which large-scale atmospheric predictors condition generation remains largely unexplored. We investigate three conditioning strategies for a denoising diffusion probabilistic model applied to daily precipitation downscaling: channel concatenation of upsampled coarse predictors, cross-attention conditioning with a learned convolutional encoder, and cross-attention conditioning with the frozen encoder of the pretrained Prithvi WxC weather foundation model. All strategies are evaluated against an unconditioned baseline under identical conditions using probabilistic, distributional, spectral, and extreme-event metrics for the Colorado River Basin. Concatenation conditioning achieves the lowest point-wise CRPS and MSE, but tends to produce over-smoothed fields that suppress high-intensity events. In contrast, cross-attention conditioning provides substantially better distributional realism and modest improvements in spectral fidelity. Improvements are greatest for extremes: the Prithvi-WxC conditioned model retains over half of >100mm/day events, although estimates are uncertain due to limited samples. When trained on the full dataset, the learned convolutional model performs similarly to the foundation model-conditioned approach while requiring lower computational resources. However, the Prithvi-WxC-conditioned model achieves comparable performance with only five years of training data. These results indicate that cross-attention conditioning offers advantages over simple concatenation for probabilistic precipitation downscaling, and that pre-trained foundation model representations may offer benefits in data-limited settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用基础模型-有条件的分散式降水
articles.content_zh: 高分辨率降水场对水文影响评估至关重要,但全球气候模型产出过于粗糙,偏向于直接使用。 基于AI的统计缩小范围,采用传播模型,提供了一个很有希望的办法,但大规模大气预测器条件生成的机制基本上仍未加以探讨。 我们研究了三种用于日降水降水的去诺氏扩散概率模型的调适策略:经取样的粗度预测器的通道调适,用有学识的转录编码器的交叉调适,用预先训练的Prithvi WxC天气基础模型的冷冻编码器的交叉调适. 对所有战略的评估都以相同条件下的无条件基线为基础,采用对科罗拉多河流域的概率、分布、光谱和极端事件的衡量标准。 凝聚调制能实现最低点智的CRPS和MSE,但倾向于产生抑制高强度事件的过滑场. 与此相对照的是,交叉注意条件提供了更好的分布现实主义和光谱忠诚度的适度改善。 对极端的改进最大:Prithvi-WxC条件模型保留了>100毫米/日事件的一半以上,尽管由于样本有限,估计不确定. 在接受关于完整数据集的培训时,所学的演化模型与基础模型条件化方法类似,同时需要较低的计算资源。 然而,Prithvi-WxC有条件的模型仅以5年的培训数据实现了可比较的性能. 这些结果表明,交叉注意力调节比简单调适降水降水降级有优势,经过预先培训的基础模型表述可能在数据有限的环境下提供好处.

articles.title: DEFUSE: Generalizable Backdoor Defense for Self-Supervised Encoders with Generative Priors
articles.content: Self-supervised learning (SSL) encoders are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, posing threats to both visual SSL encoders and vision-language encoders. Existing defenses are typically designed for only one of these paradigms and rely on restrictive assumptions such as access to uninfected in-distribution data or precomputed pseudo-labels, which are difficult to satisfy in practice. To address these limitations, we propose DEFUSE, a generalizable backdoor detection framework for SSL encoders. Inspired by Bayesian posterior inference, we reformulate backdoor detection as a representation-conditioned image likelihood estimation problem parameterized by a conditional diffusion generative model. Uninfected representations tend to yield semantically consistent reconstructions, whereas backdoored ones are more likely to be mapped to the attacker's target class or semantically meaningless images, deviating from the original semantics and thereby exposing the backdoor. However, we find that the exact likelihood is intractable, because highly abstracted representations discard the low-level information necessary for pixel-faithful reconstruction. We therefore relax the objective to semantic reconstruction and evaluate it in a well-separated representation space provided by a reference encoder. Rather than training from scratch, we fine-tune a pretrained diffusion model, leveraging its generative prior to map data onto the natural image manifold while preserving semantic content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DEFUSE substantially outperforms existing detectors across diverse attack settings, generalizing to both visual SSL and vision-language encoders. Notably, our method greatly reduces the reliance on prior knowledge about the victim encoder or the attack strategy. The source code is available at https://github.com/jsrdcht/DEFUSE .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DEFUSE: 通用后门防御,用于自导自导的编码器和基因前传
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的学习(SSL)编码器容易受到后门攻击,对视觉SSL编码器和视觉语言编码器都构成威胁. 现有的防御通常只为其中一种范式设计,并依赖限制性假设,如获取未感染的传播数据或预估的伪标签,在实践中难以满足. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议DEFUSE,一个通用的SSL编码器后门检测框架. 在贝叶斯后推论的启发下,我们重构后门检测,作为有条件的图像概率估计问题参数,通过有条件的传播基因模型来进行. 未受感染的表示体往往会产生模棱两可的连贯重建,而后门的表示体则更有可能被映射到攻击者的目标类或模棱两可的无意义图像,偏离了原语义,从而暴露出后门. 然而,我们发现,确切的可能性是难以解决的,因为高度抽象的表述抛弃了像素-忠诚重建所需的低层次信息. 因此,我们放宽了在参考编码器提供的分隔良好的代表空间中进行语义重建和评估的目标。 而不是从零开始训练,我们微调一个预先训练的传播模型,在将数据映射到自然图像多面之前,利用它的基因,同时保留语义内容。 广泛的实验表明,DEFUSE在各种攻击环境上大大超过现有的探测器,将它概括到视觉SSL和视觉语言编码器上。 值得注意的是,我们的方法大大减少了对先前对受害人编码器或攻击策略的了解的依赖。 源代码见https://github.com/jsrdcht/DEFUSE 。 。 。

articles.title: THA-Flow Generative Model: Prosthesis Geometry Prediction from Preoperative CT
articles.content: Preoperative planning for total hip arthroplasty (THA) is commonly framed as selecting a single prosthesis configuration and placement for a patient's osseous anatomy. In practice, however, the same anatomy may admit several clinically reasonable solutions, making planning inherently a one-to-many problem that is better represented by a conditional probability distribution. We present THA-Flow, a conditional flow-matching model that generates three-dimensional prosthesis geometry directly from preoperative CT. Separate AutoencoderKL models compress preoperative bone anatomy and prosthesis geometry, while a three-dimensional UNet learns a rectified flow from Gaussian noise to the prosthesis latent space under spatial bone conditioning and optional structured prosthesis parameters. The retrospective cohort comprised 1,355 hips from 1,149 patients undergoing primary THA. Following rigid registration of postoperative CT to preoperative CT, the actual postoperative prostheses were transformed independently according to the pelvic and femoral registrations and represented as a dual-channel truncated signed distance field. The prosthesis autoencoder achieved a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 47.11 dB and a structural similarity index of 0.9964 on the validation set. Complete acetabular and femoral geometries were generated across seven major stem models representing 93.4% of the cohort. Repeated bone-conditioned sampling preserved component position, alignment, and the principal bone-prosthesis interfaces while allowing limited local geometric variation. To our knowledge, THA-Flow represents the first application of generative AI to three-dimensional surgical planning for THA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: THA- Flow 基因模型: Preactive CT的假构几何预测
articles.content_zh: 全面臀部节肢整形术(THA)的手术前规划通常被设定为选择一个单一的假肢构型和放置在病人的骨骼解剖学上. 然而在实践中,同样的解剖学可能会接受几种临床上合理的解决方案,使得规划本身就成为一个一对多的问题,更能以条件概率分布为代表. 我们提出THA-Flow,一种有条件的流量比对模型,直接从操作前的CT产生三维假体几何. 分离的AutoencoderKL模型会压缩手术前的骨解剖学和假体几何学,而一个三维的UNet则在空间骨质条件和可选的结构化假体参数下学习从高斯噪声到假体潜在空间的纠正流. 复诊组共有1 355个臀部,其中1 149个患者正在接受初级THA检查。 在刚性地将术后CT登记为术前CT后,实际术后假肢按照盆腔和股骨登记进行独立转化,并代表双通道截断的签名距离场. 假体自编码器在验证集上实现了47.11 dB的峰值信号对噪声比和0.9964的结构相似性指数. 在7个主要干线模型中产生了完整的表型和股型几何模型,占组群的93.4%。 重复的骨质采样保留了组件位置,对齐,以及主骨质修复界面,同时允许有限的局部几何变化. 据我们所知,THA-Flow是基因AI首次应用于THA的三维外科规划.

articles.title: Socialized Detector Learning: Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation for Heterogeneous Object Detectors
articles.content: Object detection knowledge is fragmented across independently trained, heterogeneous detectors with complementary category supports. In socialized learning, this knowledge resides in a society, and learning aims to evolve the society collectively through exchange. However, aggregation-based socialization does not explicitly plan transfer order, whereas progressive multi-teacher distillation considers order but remains a one-way student enhancement in a shared category space. Building on Socialized Learning, we formulate Socialized Detector Learning (SDL) for heterogeneous, category-specialized object detectors and propose Trajectory-Guided and Reciprocal Distillation (TGRD).TGRD estimates directed operational Inter-Detector Transfer Difficulty (IDTD) from held-out feature-alignment residuals, precomputes a fixed score table, and greedily constructs a carrier trajectory. Along the trajectory, knowledge is progressively consolidated into a union-category carrier and then returned to experts through reciprocal transfer. A conditional proxy-certificate analysis shows that, under stated assumptions, the progressive certificate is no larger than an aggregated-target counterpart. On MS COCO with four heterogeneous experts and two carrier initializations, final carriers outperform epoch-matched simultaneous aggregation controls by 2.6 AP in both settings. Reciprocal detectors attain 20.8--28.4 AP on previously unsupported categories while remaining within 1.3 AP of original expert-specific performance. These results support order-aware progressive consolidation followed by reciprocal transfer as a viable mechanism for detector-society evolution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 社会化探测器学习:异质物体探测器的轨迹引导和对等蒸馏
articles.content_zh: 物体探测知识分散在经过独立培训的、具有补充性类别支持的不同探测器之间。 在社会化学习中,这种知识存在于一个社会,学习旨在通过交流集体发展社会。 然而,基于聚合的社会化没有明确计划转移令,而渐进的多教师蒸馏则考虑秩序,但仍然是共享类别空间中单向学生的提升. 在社会化学习的基础上,我们为不同、类别、专业的物体探测器制定了社会化探测器学习方案,并提出了Traphiory-Guided and reprocal Dispilation(TGRD)。 TGRD估计,从搁置的特征调整剩余部分中可直接操作的探测器间转移困难(IDTD),预算一个固定的计分表,贪婪地构建一个载体轨迹. 沿轨迹,知识逐渐被整合为联盟类载体,然后通过对等转让返回专家。 有条件的代理证书分析显示,根据说明的假设,累进证书不超过总目标对应证书. 在有4名不同专家和2名载体初始化的MS COCO上,最终载体在两种情况下都以2.6 AP比对时间标定的同步聚合控制超标。 对等探测器在以前没有支持的类别上达到20.8-28.4 AP,而原专家特定性能保持在1.3 AP范围内。 这些结果支持逐步巩固订单,然后相互转让,作为探测器-社会演变的可行机制。

articles.title: FlowMoDL: Model-Based Deep Learning with Conjugate-Gradient Data Consistency for Highly Accelerated 4D Flow MRI Reconstruction
articles.content: We present FlowMoDL, an unrolled neural network for highly accelerated 4D flow MRI reconstruction that directly optimizes for both anatomical magnitude and phase-derived velocity accuracy. Building on the MoDL framework, FlowMoDL alternates a learned (3+1)D spatiotemporal denoiser with conjugate-gradient data-consistency updates based on the SENSE forward model. A novel dual-pathway conditioning scheme adapts the denoiser features and data-consistency weighting, enabling a single model to handle varying acceleration factors ($10\times$ to $50\times$). To ensure physiological accuracy, the network is trained using a deep-supervision composite loss that explicitly penalizes velocity magnitude and angular errors, stabilized by a curriculum schedule. We evaluate FlowMoDL on the multi-center CMRx4DFlow dataset against classical and deep-learning baselines (CG-SENSE, MoDL, FlowVN, and FlowMRI-Net). A key advantage of FlowMoDL is its superior gradient step efficiency. When evaluated under an equivalent, limited budget of gradient steps, competing flow-specific networks degrade significantly. In contrast, FlowMoDL robustly converges and strictly outperforms all competitors across all acceleration factors in magnitude SSIM, nRMSE, relative velocity error, and angular error, successfully recovering sharp structural details and temporally coherent velocity fields.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FlowMoDL:基于模型的深层学习,具有高度加速4D流磁共振的数据一致性 重建
articles.content_zh: 我们提出FlowMoDL,这是一个用于高度加速的4D流核磁共振重建的无滚动神经网络,直接优化解剖量和相位生成速度精度。 在MODL框架的基础上,FlowMoDL在SENSE前方模型的基础上,替换了学习到的(3+1)D spatiotemporal denoiser,并配有相容性的数据一致性更新. 一个全新的双路径调节方案适应了凹槽特性和数据一致性加权,使单一模型能够处理不同的加速因子(10美元到50美元)。 为确保生理准确性,网络通过深度超视综合损失进行训练,这种损失明确惩罚速度大小和角误差,并通过课程表稳定下来。 我们对照古典和深层学习基线(CG-SENSE、MODL、FlowVN和FlowMRI-Net), FlowMoDL的一个关键优势是其优越的梯度阶梯效率. 在对等、有限的梯度步骤预算进行评估时,相互竞争的流量专用网络会显著退化。 相比之下,FlowMoDL在大小SSIM,nRMSE,相对速度误差,角误差等所有加速度因子上强势地汇聚并严格超越了所有竞争对手,成功回收了尖锐的结构细节和时间上一致的速度场.

articles.title: Steer the Sampling, Not the Kernel Grid: Geometry-Guided Sampling Operator for Volumetric Segmentation
articles.content: Accurate 3D segmentation is central to quantitative lesion assessment and anatomy mapping for clinical planning and follow-up. Thin, elongated, and fine anatomical/pathological structures (e.g., vessels) are a particularly challenging case: a one-voxel boundary error can disconnect a branch and change clinically relevant topology. In encoder-decoder networks (e.g., U-Net), repeated downsampling and fixed-grid convolution blur or alias fine structures and weaken orientation cues, so early mistakes propagate across scales. We propose a geometry-guided local operator that steers where features are sampled, rather than deforming convolutional kernels, under a single formulation for both feature refinement (stride 1) and resolution reduction (stride > 1). At each voxel, it predicts a local orientation and bounded step sizes, samples symmetrically along these directions, and transforms paired samples into compact geometric and boundary cues with lightweight mixing; a cross-scale consensus aligns encoder and decoder features at skip connections to reduce geometric mismatch. Replacing all stride 1 and stride 2 operators in a 3D U-Net yields consistent improvements on BraTS, MSD Hepatic Vessel, and TDSC-ABUS, with notably better boundary metrics (e.g., BraTS Dice 86.1 to 88.9, HD95 7.1 to 6.2; TDSC-ABUS HD95 39.1 to 27.8) while reducing parameters from 2.3M to 0.8M. We further demonstrate that the operator can be integrated into other backbones (e.g., nnU-Net, Swin-UNETR, and MedNeXt) without changing their macro-architectures while providing consistent performance gains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 引导采样,而非内核网格:几何-导引采样操作员进行卷片分解
articles.content_zh: 精确的3D分解是定量损伤评估和解剖学绘图的核心,用于临床规划和后续. 细长的,精细的解剖/病理结构(如血管)是一个特别具有挑战性的案例:单伏瑟尔边界误差可以断开一个分支,改变临床相关的地形. 在编码器-解码器网络(如U-Net)中,重复的下采样和固定网格缩进模糊或别名精细结构,并削弱方向提示,因此早期的错误在尺度上传播. 我们提出一个几何制导的本地操作器,在特征取样的地方进行引导,而不是使演化内核变形,采用单一的公式来改进特征(第1步)和降低分辨率(第1步)。 在每个voxel上,它预测一个局部方向和边距的步号大小,沿这些方向对称的样本,并将配对的样本转换成有轻量级混合的紧凑几何和边界提示;一个跨尺度的共识在跳过连接时将编码器和解码器的特性相配合,以减少几何不匹配. 在3D U-Net中取代所有步态1和步态2的操作器,对BrATS、MSD Hepatic Ship和TDSC-ABUS进行一致改进,并显著改进边界测量(如BrATS Dice 86.1至88.9、HD95 7.1至6.2、TDSC-ABUS HD95 39.1至27.8),同时将参数从2.3M减少到0.8M。 我们进一步证明,运营商可以整合到其他骨干(如nU-Net,Swin-UNETR,和MedNEXt)中,而不改变其宏观结构,同时提供一致的性能收益.

articles.title: Label-Free Foundational Model Selection for Medical Image Classification under Distribution Shift via Pseudo Label Discrepancy
articles.content: Foundation models are increasingly deployed for medical image analysis. However, under the inter-institutional distribution shift typical of deployment, their performance varies widely and cannot be known without target-domain labels, which are rarely available. This leaves a practical question unresolved: given several candidate foundational models and labeled-data from a source domain, which one to deploy in an unlabeled target domain? We propose a label-free selection criterion built on SUDO, a framework for evaluating clinical AI systems without ground-truth annotations. SUDO partitions the unlabeled target data by predicted probability and, for each region, measures a pseudo-label discrepancy reflecting class contamination; aggregated across regions, this yields a score (AURCC) requiring neither target annotation nor fine-tuning. We show that AURCC can be used to rank a variety of vision-language models (BioMedCLIP, CXR-CLIP, CheXzero, MedCLIP, MedImageInsight, CLIP) on chest X-ray classification across three inter-hospital shift scenarios, under zero-shot and MLP-probe regimes. The AURCC ranking recovers the ground-truth ranking with Spearman rho up to 0.943 (p<0.05). Against the natural baseline of ranking by held-out source accuracy, AURCC is competitive when the labeled source is large and yields a more accurate ranking once it is small; the regime of interest in resource-constrained settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 无标签基金会 通过 Pseudo Label 差异分配的医学图像分类模型选择
articles.content_zh: 基础模型越来越多地用于医疗图像分析。 然而,在典型的机构间部署分配转变下,它们的性能大不相同,没有目标域标签就无法知晓,而这些标签很少可用. 这留下了一个实际问题未解决:鉴于来自一个源域的几个候选基础模型和标签数据,哪个将部署在一个没有标签的目标域? 我们提出一个基于SUDO的无标签选择标准,一个在没有地面真实说明的情况下评价临床AI系统的框架. SUDO通过预测概率对未贴标签的目标数据进行分割,并对每个区域测量反映类别污染的伪标签差异;跨区域汇总后,得出分数(AURCC),不需要目标注释或微调. 我们显示,AURCC可以用于将各种视觉语言模型(BioMedCLIP,CXR-CLIP,CheXzero,MedCLIP,MedImage Insight,CLIP)排列在胸X射线分类上,跨越三个医院间转动情况,在零射线和MLP-probe制度下. AURCC排名恢复了与斯皮尔曼·罗的地面真实排名,最高达0.943(p<0.05). 相对于按被搁置源的准确性进行排名的自然基线,当标注源量大时,AURCC具有竞争力,一旦小则产生更准确的排名;在受资源限制的环境下,利益体系.

articles.title: TDFNet: Tri-projection Deformable Fusion Network for Panoramic Salient Object Detection
articles.content: Recent years have witnessed the growing potential of panoramic salient object detection in robotic vision, virtual reality, and related applications. However, projecting spherical scenes onto 2D planes inevitably introduces geometric distortions, which fundamentally limit the effectiveness of existing projection-based methods. Specifically, Equirectangular Projection (ERP) suffers from severe polar stretching distortions, while cube map projection introduces discontinuities across cube-face boundaries, resulting in degraded feature discriminability and compromised geometric consistency. To address these limitations, we propose TDFNet, the first Tri-projection Deformable Fusion Network for panoramic salient object detection, exploiting complementary projection representations to alleviate geometric distortions and improve detection performance.Specifically, we design a cross-projection deformable attention (CDA) module that leverages spatial correspondences between different projections to construct geometry-aware sampling locations, guiding deformable attention for cross-projection contextual aggregation and enhancing robustness against projection-induced deformations. Furthermore, we introduce a latitude-guided fusion module, which utilizes spherical latitude priors to construct geometric confidence weights for adaptively balancing ERP and CMP features. Meanwhile, LGF incorporates distortion-reduced semantic references from Tangent Projection to achieve cross-projection feature refinement and spatial alignment.By constructing a three-branch encoding architecture based on ERP, CMP, and Tangent Projection, TDFNet simultaneously preserves global spatial continuity, local geometric details, and fine-grained boundary information.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TDFNet:三投影变形聚合网络,用于全景敏感对象检测
articles.content_zh: 近年来目睹了全景显著物体探测在机器人视觉,虚拟现实,以及相关应用中不断增长的潜力. 然而,将球面场景投射到2D平面上不可避免地会引入几何扭曲,这从根本上限制了现有基于投影的方法的有效性. 具体地说,Equirectangular Projection(ERP)有严重的极性拉伸扭曲现象,而立方体地图投影则引入了跨立方体面边界的不连续现象,导致特征退化的区别性和几何一致性受损. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议TDFNet,这是第一个用于全景显性物体探测的三投影变形融合网络,利用互补的投影表示来缓解几何扭曲,提高探测性能. 具体地说,我们设计了一个跨预测可变形注意(CDA)模块,利用不同预测之间的空间对应来构建几何-知觉取样位置,指导可变形注意跨预测背景的聚合,加强抵御预测引起的变形的稳健性. 此外,我们采用了一个经纬度制导的聚变模块,利用球面纬度前缀来构建几何置信权重,以适应性地平衡ERP和CMP的特性。 同时,LGF纳入了来自Tangent Projection的扭曲减少语义引用,以实现交叉投影特征的完善和空间对齐. 通过构建基于ERP,CMP,和Tangent Projection的三分支编码架构,TDFNet同时保存了全球空间连续性,局部几何细节,以及细纹边界信息.

articles.title: Learning from waste: Machine Learning for health risk prediction and computer vision-based sorting in Ghana
articles.content: The inappropriate disposal of solid waste remains a significant public health and environmental concern worldwide, including in Ghana. Poor sanitation and improper waste management practices contribute to substantial economic costs and avoidable deaths annually. In 2022, a field study in Atonsu, Kumasi, Ghana, reported a community-perceived relationship between household waste disposal and illness patterns, but only through descriptive analysis without quantitative validation. This study extends that investigation using two data-driven approaches. First, a Random Forest classifier was developed to predict illness categories using waste disposal practices and demographic survey data. On a held-out group of respondents who reported illness (N=69), the model obtained a macro F1 score of 0.63, with disposal method emerging as the most important substantive predictor of illness type. Second, a MobileNetV2 image classification model enabled automated waste sorting via visual recognition, achieving 88.2% accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.87 on the test set (N=415). The vision-based approach offers an affordable, camera-driven alternative to complex multi-sensor systems, making it highly suitable for resource-constrained settings. Taken together, the findings provide quantitative evidence for a community health relationship previously documented only qualitatively. They demonstrate the potential for automated waste-sorting in low-resource environments. Importantly, the results illustrate that technological performance alone does not guarantee public health improvements; effective institutional support and implementation are equally necessary.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习废物:加纳用于健康风险预测的机器学习和计算机视觉分拣
articles.content_zh: 固体废物的不当处置仍然是全世界,包括加纳的一个重大公共健康和环境问题。 卫生条件差和不当的废物管理做法每年造成高昂的经济成本和可避免的死亡。 2022年,在加纳库马西的阿通苏(Atonsu)进行的一项实地研究表明,生活垃圾处置与疾病模式之间存在社区感知的关系,但只能通过描述性分析而不进行定量验证. 这项研究利用两种数据驱动的方法扩展了这项调查。 首先,开发了随机森林分类仪,以利用废物处理做法和人口调查数据预测疾病类别。 在报告生病(N=69)的被搁置的一组受访者中,该模型获得了0.63的宏F1分,处置方法逐渐成为疾病类型的最重要的实质性预测器. 其次,一个MobileNetV2图像分类模型通过视觉识别实现了废物自动分类,实现了88.2%的精度,在测试集(N=415)上获得了0.87的宏F1分. 基于愿景的方法为复杂的多传感器系统提供了一个负担得起的、由相机驱动的替代方法,使其非常适合受资源限制的环境。 综合来看,调查结果为以前只记录在质量上的社区健康关系提供了定量证据。 它们显示出在资源低的环境下自动处理废物的潜力。 重要的是,这些结果表明,单靠技术业绩并不能保证公共卫生的改善;有效的机构支持和执行同样是必要的。

articles.title: Moving Beyond More Views: Redundancy-Aware Ego-Exo Fusion for Proficiency Estimation
articles.content: EgoExo proficiency estimation aims to assess action quality by integrating fine-grained motion cues from egocentric (1st-person) views with spatial context from multiple exocentric (3rd-person) views. Simply adding more exocentric views degrades EgoExo performance, as redundant or noisy perspectives dilute useful motion cues. Our analysis identifies two key causes: (1) Multiview redundancy - From the data perspective, certain views provide limited or noisy information, diluting discriminative cues; (2) Overfitting - From the feature perspective, conventional fusion increases representational complexity, causing the model to memorise view-specific patterns rather than learn generalisable representations. To address these issues, we propose two complementary modules: AdaMVS, which adaptively identifies and fuses the most informative view tokens under weak supervision from the data perspective, and VIB-GB, which combines Gradient Blending and Variational Information Bottleneck regularisation from the feature perspective to compress redundant signals and suppress overfitting during training. Experiments on EgoExo-4D and EgoExo-Fitness demonstrate that our method learns both which view to look at and how to fuse them, achieving new state-of-the-art results. Our source code is available at https://github.com/dx199771/AdaMVS
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越更多 视图:对能力估计的冗余 -- -- 警觉的Ego -- -- Exo合并
articles.content_zh: EgoExo能力估计旨在通过将自我中心(第1人)观点的精致运动提示与空间背景从多种异心(第3人)观点相结合来评估动作质量. 仅仅增加更离心的视角会降低EgoExo的性能,因为多余或吵闹的视角会淡化有用的运动提示. 我们的分析确定了两个主要原因: (1)多视图冗余 - 从数据角度看,某些观点提供有限或吵闹的信息,稀释了歧视性提示; (2) 偏差 - 从特征角度看,常规聚变增加了代表性复杂性,导致模型记忆了特定观点的规律,而不是学习泛泛性表述. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出两个补充模块:AdaMVS从数据角度在薄弱的监督下适应性地识别和引信信息性最强的视图符号;VIB-GB从特征角度将渐变混合和变异信息波特伦克规范化结合起来,以压缩冗余信号,抑制训练时的过度配置. 关于EgoExo-4D和EgoExo-Fitness的实验表明,我们的方法既学会了看哪一种观点,也学会了如何将其引信,取得了新的最新结果. 我们的源代码可在https://github.com/dx199771/AdaMVS上查阅

articles.title: InteractGesture: Progressive Chunk Guidance for Continuous Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Control
articles.content: Co-speech gesture generation has made significant progress toward realistic full-body motion from speaker audio, yet existing models lack fine-grained spatial controllability of individual joints. To address this, we introduce \emph{InteractGesture}, a model-agnostic, inference-time method for spatially controllable gesture generation. \emph{InteractGesture} guides target latent estimates of a diffusion sampler through a differentiable RVQ-VAE decoder, backpropagating spatial control gradients to adjust motion latents during sampling. A primary challenge in streaming co-speech generation is chunk-wise dependency: standard sequential inference freezes prior chunks, preventing spatial constraints in future chunks from adjusting preceding trajectories and causing boundary inconsistencies. To overcome this limitation, we propose \emph{Progressive Chunk Guidance}, a chunk-window strategy that maintains an active set of editable chunk latents with staggered delays, enabling spatial constraints to propagate gradients backward across chunk boundaries during streaming generation. Experiments on the BEAT2 dataset show that \emph{InteractGesture} improves multi-joint spatial control while preserving overall gesture quality. Furthermore, our approach supports diverse applications, including sparse joint positioning, dense joint trajectory control, and directional pointing. Our project page is available at https://exitudio.github.io/interactgesture-page .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 互动:不断流动的同声道控制渐进弹簧指南
articles.content_zh: 共声手势生成在从扬声器声波中实现实事求是的全体运动方面取得了显著进展,但现有的模型缺乏单个关节的精细的空间可控性. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入\emph{InteractGesture},一种用于空间可控手势生成的模型-不可知,推论-时间方法. \emph{ InteractGesture} 引导通过不同的 RVQ- VAE 解码器对扩散采样器进行目标潜在估计, 反向传播空间控制梯度, 在采样过程中调整运动潜在值 。 流体共声道生成的主要挑战在于块的依赖性:标准顺序推论冻结了先前的块,防止了未来块的空间限制调整之前的轨迹,导致边界不一致. 为了克服这一限制,我们提议\emph{ 进步 Chunk Guide} , 一个块窗口策略, 它保持一组活跃的可编辑块潜伏, 并交错延迟, 使得空间限制在流源生成时能够跨越块边界向后传播梯度 。 BEAT2数据集上的实验显示\emph{InteractGesture}在保持整体手势质量的同时,改进了多联合空间控制. 此外,我们的方法支持各种应用,包括稀少的联合定位、密集的联合轨道控制和方向指向。 我们的项目网页见https://exitudio.github.io/interactgesture-page。

articles.title: MIMONet: Multi-scale Input and Multi-scale Output Network for Salient Object Detection
articles.content: The existing methods for saliency detection task focus on the application of multi-level features, aiming to take advantage of the respective strengths of high- and low-level features. However, because the inputs of these models are single-size images, their multi-level features have difficulty in learning the knowledge of size variations of salient objects. Object-scale variation learning has great potential for detecting multi-scale objects, which has not been fully explored by existing methods. To improve the recognition ability of a model for objects with different sizes, we are inspired by the image pyramid to propose a Multi-scale Input and Multi-scale Output Network (MIMONet). In MIMONet, we extract multi-level features for three images with different resolutions to form three encoder branches, and information will be exchanged between the branches. The advantage of this approach is that the features of one branch can learn the knowledge of target size variation from the features of the other two branches. In addition, we design a Multi-scale Perception (MSP) module, in which the input feature layer is divided into several sub-layers with different resolutions. Capturing the multi-level structure information of the objects in these sub-layers can make the objects more fully perceived. For network training, we propose a Joint Saliency Loss (JSL), which can constrain multiple saliency maps output by the network to identify the same foreground objects, and induce their boundaries to be preserved clearly. Experimental results show that MIMONet has stronger detection capabilities and harvests better evaluation scores on multiple datasets compared to existing models. The code of our model will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MIMONet:用于检测敏感对象的多规模输入和多规模输出网络
