articles.content_zh: 现有优势检测任务的方法侧重于多层次特征的应用,旨在利用高低层次特征各自的优势. 然而,由于这些模型的输入是单尺寸的图像,因此其多层次的特征很难学习显性物体大小变化的知识. 对象尺度变异学习对探测多尺度物体有很大潜力,而现有方法尚未充分探索. 为了提高不同大小物体的模型的识别能力,我们受到图像金字塔的启发,提出一个多比例输入和多比例输出网络(MIMONet). 在MIMONet中,我们为三个具有不同分辨率的图像提取多层次特性,形成三个编码分支,信息将在分支之间交换. 这种方法的优点是,一个分支的特征可以从其他两个分支的特征中学习到目标大小变化的知识. 此外,我们还设计了一个多尺度感知(MSP)模块,其中输入特征层被分为几个具有不同分辨率的子层. 捕捉这些子层中物体的多层次结构信息,可以使物体更完整感知. 对于网络训练,我们提出"联合优势损失"(JSL),它可以限制网络的多个优势地图输出,以识别相同的前缘对象,并诱导其边界清晰保存. 实验结果表明,与现有模型相比,MIMONet具有更强的探测能力,在多个数据集上获得更好的评价分数。 我们模式的代码将公布。

articles.title: LongVU-TTT: Causal Test-Time Training for Visual Resampling in Long Video Understanding
articles.content: Long-video MLLMs must model temporal change before a limited visual-token budget removes most frame evidence. We introduce LongVU-TTT, which inserts a convolutional Test-Time Training (TTT) resampler with causal fast-weight updates between the vision encoder and the LLM. Its grouped 2D fast weights adapt to each video and contextualize frame features before compression, while a hybrid uniform-and-change-aware selector retains explicit visual evidence for downstream reasoning. Under controlled conditions, TTT-Conv improves over TTT-MLP by up to +2.12 and bidirectional Mamba2 by up to +3.04 on MLVU, and it is stronger than attention- and fixed-state recurrent resamplers across three benchmarks. Analysis shows that the fast weights behave as a temporal aggregation state rather than a reliable long-horizon episodic memory: their benefit attenuates as evidence becomes more distant, motivating explicit frame retention. LongVU-TTT processes up to 512 frames before reducing them to 128 LLM frames and achieves competitive performance across five video understanding benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LongVU-TT:在长视频理解中视觉恢复的因子测试-时间培训
articles.content_zh: Long-video MLLMs 必须在有限的视觉键预算删除大多数帧证据之前模拟时间变化. 我们引入了LongVU-TTT,它插入了带有视觉编码器和LLM之间因果快重更新的演化测试-时间训练(TTT)重印器. 其分组的2D快速权重在压缩前适应每个视频并背景化帧特征,而混合统一和变化感选择器则保留了清晰的视觉证据用于下游推理. 在受控条件下,TTT-Conv比TT-MLP改进最高为+2.12,在MLVU上双向Mamba2改进最高为+3.04,并且比注意和固定状态的重复标注器强,跨越三个基准. 分析表明,快速权重表现为时间聚合状态,而不是可靠的长视距瞬间记忆:随着证据变得更加遥远,其好处会减弱,促使明确框架的保留。 LongVU-TT进程可达512帧,然后降低到128LLM帧,并实现5个视频理解基准的竞争性性能.

articles.title: Difficulty-Aware Sample Allocation for Adaptive Data Augmentation in Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: Data augmentation is a standard component of modern semantic segmentation pipelines, but most augmentation techniques allocate transformations uniformly across training samples or adapt to a single difficulty signal such as loss. This ignores the fact that segmentation difficulty is multi-factorial, since ambiguous predictions, persistent optimization errors, rare classes, and complex object boundaries can each make a sample informative in different ways. This paper introduces Difficulty-Aware Sample Allocation (DASA), an architecture-agnostic framework that assigns stronger augmentation to samples estimated to be more difficult. DASA combines prediction ambiguity, training loss, class rarity, and boundary complexity into a normalized difficulty score, then maps that score to sample-specific augmentation strength during iterative training. Experiments on Oxford-IIIT Pet and binary Pascal VOC segmentation with U-Net, DeepLabV3, and SegFormer-B0 show that DASA improves over standard training and is competitive with or stronger than single-signal adaptive baselines. On Oxford-IIIT Pet, DASA improves DeepLabV3 from 0.633 to 0.740 mIoU. On binary Pascal VOC, DASA obtains the best foreground IoU for all three evaluated architectures. These results attest to the value of multi-factor difficulty estimation as a practical mechanism for directing augmentation where it is most useful.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语义分区中适应性数据增强的难度- 智能样本分配
articles.content_zh: 数据增强是现代语义分解管道的标准组成部分,但大多数增强技术统一分配各个培训样本的变换或者适应损失等单一难度信号. 这忽略了分解难度是多因子的这一事实,因为模棱两可的预测,持续的优化错误,罕见的类,以及复杂的对象边界,可以使样本以不同的方式提供信息. 本文引入了难度-智能样本分配(DASA),这个架构-不可知性框架为估计难度更大的样本分配了更强的增强. DASA将预测模糊度,训练损失,班级稀有度和边界复杂度合并为一个常态难度分数,然后在迭代训练中将得分的地图与特定样本的增强强度进行组合. 关于Oxford-IIIT Pet和与U-Net,DeepLabV3和SegFormer-B0的二进制Pascal VOC分割的实验表明,DASA改进了标准训练,与单信号适应基线具有竞争力或强于单信号适应基线. 在Oxford-IIIT Pet上,DASA将DeepLabV3从0.633改进为0.740 mIoU. 在二进制Pascal VOC上,DASA获得所有三种评价架构的最佳前置IoU. 这些结果证明,多因素困难估计作为指导最有用的增强的实际机制的价值。

articles.title: Skeleton-based Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Action Localization via Weakly-Supervised Pretraining
articles.content: We propose a novel pretraining strategy for skeleton-based zero-shot spatio-temporal action localization to estimate unseen actions for person instances while overcoming high annotation costs for training via new target actions and pretraining using large-scale action scenery datasets. Specifically, our approach, termed Skeleton-Language feature Pooling Switching, introduces a weakly-supervised vision-language pretraining mechanism. This mechanism transitions pooling kernels from pretraining, which aggregates skeleton features at the video level and aligns them with each video's known action text embeddings, to the inference phase that computes instance-level features without training via target actions. Furthermore, we propose Scene-Mixed Discriminative Contrastive Learning to distinguish actions at the instance level within the combined scene through the MIL framework. Our experiments on four public spatio-temporal action localization and classification datasets demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses annotation limitations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于 Skeleton 的 Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal 动作通过弱超监督本地化 预 训
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了一个基于骨架的零射片时空动作本地化的新预训战略,以估计对人的情况的隐蔽行动,同时通过新的目标行动和使用大规模行动场景数据集的预训克服培训的高额注释费用。 具体来说,我们的方法,即Skeleton-Language的功能Pooling Switching,引入了一个弱监督的视觉语言预培训机制。 这种机制将集合内核从预训(预训集成视频层面的骨架特征,并将其与每个视频已知的动作文本嵌入)向不通过目标动作来计算实例层面特征的推断阶段过渡. 此外,我们建议通过MIL框架,在实例层面区分各种行动。 我们关于四个公共时空动作局部化和分类数据集的实验表明,拟议方法有效地解决了注释的局限性。

articles.title: Unsupervised Anatomical Feature Learning via Diffusion Models: Enhanced Medical Image Segmentation with Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
articles.content: Acquiring pixel-level annotations for medical image segmentation is a severe bottleneck. Traditional U-Net architectures, while effective, learn local texture patterns and lack awareness of global anatomical structures, leading to boundary delineation failures in low-data regimes. This research paper proposes utilizing unsupervised Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) to extract anatomical features. We train a DDPM on 21 unlabeled abdominal CT scans to learn structural representations, transferring the encoder weights to a downstream segmentation task evaluated on the BTCV multi-organ dataset. Diffusion pretraining significantly improved liver segmentation: Dice increased from $0.75\pm0.36$ to $0.93\pm0.16$ ($p < 5.33\times10^{-26}$, 0.529 Cohen's d), Average Surface Distance (ASD) decreased by 66%, and 95th-percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) reduced by 45%. For kidney segmentation, Dice improved from $0.90\pm0.19$ to $0.95\pm0.10$ ($p < 4.01\times10^{-11}$). Multi-organ pooled performance showed a 68% variance reduction and a 74% improvement in boundary precision (Dice $0.95\pm0.07$). Crucially, frozen encoder models retained > 80% of fine-tuned performance without exposure to segmentation labels, proving the existence of learned anatomical priors. In low-data scenarios, diffusion-pretrained models maintained robust performance with only 50% (Dice: 0.92 liver, 0.94 kidney), 25%, and even 10% (Dice: 0.89 liver, 0.71 kidney) of labeled data. Using unlabeled images for diffusion-based pretraining successfully embeds robust anatomical features prior to human supervision, transforming U-Nets into anatomy-aware systems.
