articles.title_zh: 未经监督的通过扩散模型进行解剖特征学习:增强医学图像分解与去化扩散概率模型
articles.content_zh: 获取像素级说明用于医疗图像分割是一个严重的瓶颈. 传统的U-Net架构虽然有效,但学习了当地纹理规律,缺乏对全球解剖结构的认识,导致低数据制度中的划界失败. 这份研究论文提议利用不受监督的Denoising扩散概率模型来提取解剖特征. 我们在21个无标签的腹部CT扫描上训练一个DDPM来学习结构表达,把编码器的权重转移到BTCV多器官数据集评价的下游分解任务上. 肝脏分化明显改善: Dice从0.75\pm0.36美元增加到0.93\pm0.16美元(p < 5.33\times10\=26}美元,0.529美元) Cohen's d),平均表面距离(ASD)下降了66%,第95百分位豪斯多夫距离(HD95)下降了45%. 在肾分裂方面,Dice从0.90\pm0.19美元提高到0.95\pm0.10美元(p < 4.01\times10X-11}美元)。 多器官集合性能显示差异减少68%,边界精度提高74%(0.95美元/pm0.07美元)。 关键是,冷冻编码器模型保留了 > 80%的微调性能,而不暴露于分解标签,证明了已学习解剖学前科的存在. 在低数据假设中,扩散前置模型维持稳健性能,只有50%(剂量:0.92肝,0.94肾),25%,甚至10%(剂量:0.89肝,0.71肾)的标注数据. 利用无标签图像进行基于传播的预训,在人类监督前成功地嵌入了强健的解剖特征,将U-Nets转化为解剖意识系统.

articles.title: CloSeR: Unified Relational Distillation from Closed-Set Teachers for Category Discovery
articles.content: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) is an intriguing open-world problem that has garnered increasing attention: given partially labelled data, the goal is to correctly recognize known classes while discovering coherent novel categories from unlabelled samples. Recent GCD methods typically adapt foundation models by jointly optimizing supervised classification and unsupervised discovery objectives on mixed labelled and unlabelled data. While effective, this coupled training can entangle closed-set recognition and open-set discovery, leading to objective conflict and biased predictions, and may disturb the semantic geometry of pretrained representations under limited labels and noisy pseudo-labels. We propose CloSeR, a simple plug-and-play framework that injects Closed-Set Relational knowledge into GCD training. CloSeR first builds a domain-adapted closed-set teacher by tuning lightweight block-wise adapters on labelled known-class data while keeping the foundation model backbone frozen, thereby preserving pretrained priors at low training cost. It then transfers the teacher's knowledge to downstream GCD via Unified Relational Distillation (URD), which distills complementary global sample-to-prototype relations to anchor known-class semantics and local sample-to-sample relations to preserve neighborhood structure, using separate feature pathways to reduce optimization interference. CloSeR is head-agnostic and readily integrates with both parametric and non-parametric GCD methods. Extensive experiments with DINO and DINOv2 backbones on six benchmarks (CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet-100, CUB, Stanford-Cars, and FGVC-Aircraft) show consistent gains over GCD baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/closer/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CloSeR: 封闭式教师中用于发现类的统一关系分裂
articles.content_zh: 通用分类发现(GCD)是一个令人感兴趣的开放世界问题,它得到了越来越多的关注:给予部分标签数据,目标是正确识别已知的类别,同时从无标签的样本中发现一致的新类别。 最近的GCD方法一般通过在混合标签和无标签数据上共同优化监督的分类和无监督的发现目标来调整基础模型. 这种结合的训练虽然有效,但可以缠绕封闭的设定识别和开放的发现,从而导致客观的冲突和偏颇的预测,并可能扰乱在有限标签和吵闹的伪标签下预先训练的表述的语义几何. 我们提出CloSeR,一个简单的插件和游戏框架,将闭合的组合关系知识注入GCD训练中. CloSeR首先通过在标注的已知等级数据上调用轻量级的块式适配器来构建一个域名适应的闭塞设置老师,同时保持基础模型主干线的冻结,从而以低培训成本保留了预训前科. 之后通过United Relational Distillation(URD)将教师的知识转移到下游GCD,将互补的全球样本对原型关系提炼出来,以锚定已知的类语义和局部样本对样本关系,以维护邻里结构,使用单独的特征路径减少优化干扰. CloSeR是头-不可知的,很容易与参数化和非参数化的GCD方法结合. 在六个基准(CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-100、CUB、Stanford-Cars和FGVC-Aircraft)上与DINO和DINOv2主干线进行的广泛试验显示,在GCD基线上取得了一致的收益,实现了最先进的性能。 项目网页:https://visual-ai.github.io/closer/

articles.title: Deep Learning Segmentation of Diffusion-Weighted MRI Acute Ischaemic Stroke: A Pragmatic Evaluation Across Three Datasets
articles.content:
Objective: Diffusion-weighted MRI (DWI-MRI) is the gold standard for visualizing and quantifying acute ischaemic stroke (AIS). Although deep learning methods can accurately segment AIS lesions, the optimal image inputs and model architecture remain uncertain. We evaluated whether accurate AIS lesion segmentation can be achieved using a pragmatic deep learning approach with minimal preprocessing and clinically feasible inference times.
  Materials and Methods: Self-configured nnU-Net models were trained on 1,744 DWI cases from local, national, and open-access datasets and tested on 436 cases. Four experimental conditions were evaluated using five-fold cross-validation: with or without brain extraction and using either DWI alone or DWI plus apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images as inputs. Two architectures were compared: the baseline nnU-Net (base) and a residual encoder nnU-Net (ResEnc). Performance was benchmarked against the DeepISLES ensemble model from the 2022 ISLES challenge.
  Results: In the test set (n=436), the base model achieved a median (IQR) Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) of 0.84 (0.19). For the base model, only two of six pairwise comparisons between input configurations showed significant differences. ResEnc produced small but significant improvements in DSC compared with the base model for DWI, DWI+brain extraction, and DWI+ADC inputs (all p<0.02), but not for DWI+ADC+brain extraction (p>0.50). The base model significantly outperformed DeepISLES, particularly in patients with smaller infarct volumes (signed-rank test, p<0.01).
  Conclusions: A baseline nnU-Net trained on DWI alone, without preprocessing, enabled fast and accurate AIS lesion segmentation. This streamlined approach may facilitate clinical research and support acute stroke imaging workflows
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 深入学习分解扩散-加权核磁共振 急性缺血弦:跨越三个数据集的实用评价
articles.content_zh:
目标:扩散加权核磁共振(DWI-MRI)是可视化和量化急性缺血性中风(AIS)的黄金标准. 虽然深层学习方法可以准确分解AIS损伤,但最佳图像输入和模型架构仍然不确定. 我们评价了是否可以采用实用的深层学习方法,在最少的预处理时间和临床上可行的推断时间实现准确的AIS损伤分解。
材料和方法: 自配置 对nU-Net模型进行了关于1 744个DWI案例的培训,这些案例来自地方、国家和开放存取数据集,并对436个案例进行了测试。 利用五倍的交叉验证评价了四个实验条件:有无脑提取,单独使用DWI或DWI外加表面扩散系数(ADC)图像作为输入. 比较了两个架构:基线nnU-Net(基地)和一个剩余编码器nnU-Net(ResEnc)。 业绩以2022年ISLES挑战的DeepISLES组合模式为基准。
结果: 在测试集(n=436)中,基准模型实现了中位数(IQR) 虱类相似系数(DSC)为0.84(0.19). 对于基准模型,6个输入配置之间的对偶比较中只有2个显示显著差异. ResEnc与DWI、DWI+大脑提取和DWI+ADC输入的基准模型(均为p<0.02)相比,DSC产生了小而显著的改进,但DWI+ADC+大脑提取(p>0.50)并非如此. 基本模型的性能大大超过DeepISLES, 特别是在梗塞体积较小的病人中(署名排名测试,p<0.01)。
结论:一个仅就DWI培训的NNU-Net基线,不经过预处理,就能够快速和准确地进行AIS损伤分解。 这一简化方法可能有助于临床研究并支持急性中风成像工作流程

articles.title: Towards Purified Multi-Label Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has been widely explored in single-label recognition, effectively mitigating distribution shifts, especially when combined with vision-language models. However, real-world images often contain multiple objects, while the more practical multi-label test-time adaptation (MLTTA) has received little attention so far. Recent cache-based TTA methods have shown promising efficiency and effectiveness, yet directly extending them to multi-label scenarios suffers from a one-to-many mapping problem: a shared global representation entangling co-occurring objects is stored as class-wise cache prototypes, inducing dominant-label bias and compromised cache calibration. While introducing region-level cues helps isolate class-specific evidence, such regional evidence can also be unreliable under distribution shifts, making its identification and utilization non-trivial. To address these issues, we introduce PuRF, a novel PuRiFication-driven cache-based method for multi-label test-time adaptation of vision-language models. Specifically, PuRF first performs region purification to identify reliable regions, providing comprehensive regional cues for multi-label recognition and enabling fine-grained alignment. Based on these purified regions, PuRF conducts cache purification to enhance cache representation and adaptability, where episodic purification builds a discriminative region-based cache, and temporal refreshing further promotes long-term cache adaptability. Experiments demonstrate that PuRF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving a notable 4.05% mAP improvement on ViT-B/32 across five datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 走向纯化多标签 愿景语言模型的测试-时间调整
articles.content_zh: 测试时间适应(TTA)在单标签识别中被广泛探索,有效缓解了分布变化,特别是在结合视觉语言模型时. 然而,现实世界的图像往往包含多个对象,而更为实用的多标签测试时间适应(MLTTA)至今很少受到关注. 最近基于缓存的TTA方法显示出有希望的效率和效果,但直接将其推广到多标签方案却遇到一对多的绘图问题:共享的全球代表式嵌入共生物体被作为类缓存原型存储,诱发了主标签偏差和缓存校准受损。 虽然采用区域一级的提示有助于孤立具体类别的证据,但在分配变化中,这种区域证据也可能不可靠,使其确定和利用不以部落为主。 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了PuRF,一种新型的PuRiFication驱动缓存式方法,用于多标签测试时间的视觉语言模型改造. 具体地说,PuRF首先进行区域净化以确定可靠的区域,为多标签识别提供全面的区域提示,并促成精细的调整。 基于这些纯净区域,PuRF进行缓存净化,以增强缓存的表示和适应性,其中偶发性净化会构建一个带有歧视性的区域缓存,时间更新会进一步促进长期缓存的适应性. 实验表明,PuRF一贯优于最先进的方法,在五个数据集的ViT-B/32上实现了显著的4.05%的mAP改进。

articles.title: Diffusion Transformers for Roof Graph Synthesis and Reconstruction
articles.content: We present RoofDiT, a generative framework for 2D roof graph synthesis and reconstruction. Roofs are compactly described as planar graphs of junctions and structural edges, but existing methods often rely on fixed geometric rules or direct reconstruction objectives. RoofDiT instead models roof structures directly as vertex-edge graphs and learns a conditional generative prior over their geometry and connectivity. Our framework follows a two-stage design: a diffusion transformer generates roof vertices, and an edge prediction module infers the corresponding graph topology. To improve geometric fidelity, RoofDiT combines relative geometry-aware attention with footprint and aerial-image conditioning, while using an alignment regularizer to encourage common horizontal, vertical, and diagonal roof patterns. The same model supports unconditional generation, footprint-conditioned synthesis, and image-guided reconstruction by changing the conditioning signal. Experiments show improved graph generation quality over a diffusion baseline, favorable performance against a straight-skeleton prior in the footprint-conditioned setting, and the highest edge F1 among compared methods for image-guided reconstruction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 屋顶图合成和重建的传播变压器
articles.content_zh: 我们提出RoofDiT,这是2D屋顶图合成和重建的基因框架。 屋顶被紧凑地描述为连接点和结构边缘的平面图,但现有方法往往依赖于固定几何规则或直接重建目标. RoofDiT转而直接将屋顶结构作为顶点-尖端图样模型,并在几何学和连接学之前学习有条件的基因. 我们的框架遵循两阶段设计:一个扩散变压器产生屋顶顶点,一个边缘预测模块推断出相应的图表地形. 为了改善几何忠诚度,RoofDiT将相对几何感知的注意力与足迹和空中图像调节相结合,同时使用对齐调节器鼓励常见的横向,纵向,对角屋顶图案. 同一模型支持无条件生成,脚印条件合成,并通过改变调制信号进行图像引导重建. 实验显示,在扩散基线之上,图生成质量有所改善,在足迹条件设定之前,对直塞勒顿具有有利的性能,在图像制导重建的比较方法中,其边缘为F1。

articles.title: MAMA-FLUX.2: Image-to-Image Synthesis of Post-Contrast Breast DCE-MRI for the MAMA-SYNTH Challenge
articles.content: Dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI is central to cancer diagnosis and monitoring, but requires gadolinium-based contrast agents. In this work, we address pre-to-post contrast breast MRI synthesis for the MAMA-SYNTH challenge. We propose MAMA-FLUX.2, a conditional latent flow-matching approach based on FLUX.2-Klein-4B. The pre-contrast image is encoded as spatial conditioning, while the model predicts the flow field associated with the post-contrast target latent. To adapt the pretrained model efficiently, we use LoRA fine-tuning and introduce a regional training objective combining global flow matching, tumor-region supervision, and stable foreground regularization. We further investigate LoRA rank, intensity windowing, and regional loss weights on axial slices, prioritizing clinically relevant tumor-focused metrics. Our ablation study shows that moderate tumor and stable-foreground weighting improves the trade-off between image fidelity and tumor-region accuracy. The final model achieves the best overall balance with LoRA rank/$α=64/64$, $\mathrm{MHA}_{\max}=25$, $λ_{\mathrm{tumor}}=0.25$, and $λ_{\mathrm{stable}}=0.1$. These results demonstrate that compact pretrained rectified-flow transformers can be adapted for contrast-enhanced MRI synthesis using parameter-efficient fine-tuning and task-aware regional losses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MAMA-FLUX.2:为MAMA-SYNTH挑战而制作的后连锁乳房DCE-MRI的图像对图像合成
articles.content_zh: 动态对比增强乳房核磁共振是癌症诊断和监测的核心,但需要加多肽基对比剂. 在这项工作中,我们针对MAMA-SYNTH挑战,处理前置对比乳房核磁共振合成问题。 我们提议采用基于FLUX.2-Klein-4B的有条件潜在流比方法。 孔径前图像被编码为空间调节,而模型则预测与孔径后目标潜在相关的流场. 为了高效改造预训模式,我们使用LORA微调,引入区域培训目标,结合全球流量匹配,肿瘤区域监管,稳定前缘规范. 我们进一步调查LORA的排名,强度窗口, 以及轴切片的区域损失权重, 优先考虑临床上与肿瘤相关的指标。 我们的减肥研究表明,中度肿瘤和稳定前方加权可以改善图像忠贞度与肿瘤区域准确度之间的权衡。 最终模式实现最佳总体平衡的是:LORA排名/$α=64/64$,$\mathrm{MHA}_{\max}=25$,$λ_{\mathrm{tumor}}=0.25$,和$λ_{\mathrm{stable}}=0.1$. 这些结果表明,可采用参数效率高的微调和对任务有敏感认识的区域损失,对压缩的事先经过训练的整流变压器进行调整,以适应反差增强的核磁共振合成。

articles.title: SeVeR: Selective Visual Exposure and Retrieval for 3D Medical Image Question Answering
articles.content: Volumetric medical VQA requires reasoning over long and redundant 3D visual token sequences, especially in multi-sequence MRI where complementary modalities provide diverse diagnostic cues but expose the decoder to many repeated anatomical regions. To investigate reasoning under multi-sequence visual redundancy, we first introduce BreMRIs-VQA, a clinically curated breast MRI benchmark with 1.19M QA pairs from 71.0K sequences and 12.9K patients, covering both free-text and multiple-choice questions. We further propose SeVeR, a selective visual exposure framework that compresses dense volumes into modality-wise prototypes and retrieves complementary multi-level evidence with change-aware gated attention during decoding, trained with a marginal-utility self-consistency objective that suppresses unhelpful retrieval. Experiments on BreMRIs-VQA and public benchmarks show that SeVeR improves both discriminative and generative performance while exposing substantially fewer visual tokens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SeVeR:3D医疗影像答题的选择性视觉曝光和检索
articles.content_zh: 卷体医学 VQA要求对长而冗余的3D视觉符号序列进行推理,特别是在多序列核磁共振中,互补模式提供不同的诊断提示,但将解码器暴露在许多重复的解剖区域. 为了在多序列视觉冗余下调查推理,我们首先引入了BreMRIIs-VQA,这是临床治疗的乳房核磁共振基准,由71.0K序列和12.9K患者的1.19MQA对组成,既包括自由文字问题,也包括多选择问题. 我们进一步提出SeVeR,一种选择性的视觉曝光框架,将密集量压缩成模式化原型,在解码过程中以变化感门关注获取互补的多层证据,训练有边际实用性自相容目标,抑制无益检索. 关于BreMRIS-VQA和公众基准的实验表明,SeVeR既能改善歧视性能,又能提高基因性能,同时能曝光的视觉标志明显减少.

articles.title: Plans You Can Check: Verifier-Grounded Learning of an Open-Weight Planner for Executable Video-Editing
articles.content: Practical video editing is not only pixel generation: an editor must turn a brief, a clip pool, music metadata, and hard constraints into an executable timeline. We study this decision layer as \emph{executable video-editing planning} and introduce RefineCut, which, unlike workflow systems that wrap a prompted frontier model, trains a compact open-weight planner for it. The planner edits a typed timeline through structured patches covering clip selection, trimming, ordering, transitions, and duration and music alignment; a deterministic verifier applies each patch and checks it against an explicit constraint ledger. Because editing has no single ground-truth repair, we do not imitate teachers directly: RefineCut replays every multi-teacher branch through the verifier and keeps verifier-best repairs as supervision. A second stage, RefineCut-Evo, lets the student score its own repairs with the verifier and a task rubric and trains on high-margin preference pairs, so the final $8$B planner runs in a closed verifier loop with no teacher calls at inference. On RefineCut-Bench ($3{,}578$ tasks, $7{,}971$ captioned clips, $499$ music tracks, explicit ledgers), verifier-replayed distillation lifts the planner from $0.620$ to $0.858$ on the protocol-specific Video-Editing Score and RefineCut-Evo reaches $0.924$; the gain transfers to Llama-3.1-8B and GLM-4-9B, and in the same closed loop the $8$B planner matches or exceeds its frontier teachers. Code and RefineCut-Bench are publicly released; see the Data Availability statement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 计划 您可以检查: 校验- 环绕学习可执行视频编辑的开放- 重量规划器
articles.content_zh: 实用的视频编辑不仅仅是像素生成:编辑者必须把一个短片,剪辑池,音乐元数据,以及硬约束变成可执行的时间表. 作为\emph{可执行的视频编辑计划}我们研究了这个决策层,并引入了FineCut,它与覆盖一个被激发的前沿模型的工作流程系统不同,它为此培训了一个紧凑的开放量级规划员. 计划员通过结构化的补丁编辑一个打字的时间线,包括剪辑选择,剪辑,订购,过渡,以及持续时间和音乐对齐;一个确定性的核查员应用每个补丁,并对照明确的约束分类账加以检查. 由于编辑没有单一的地面真相修复,我们不直接模仿教师: 完善 切换每个多教师分支通过校验器进行重播,并保持校验器-最佳维修作为监督. 第二阶段"RefineCut-Evo"让学生自己用校验器和高边际偏好对的任务标本和列车获得修补分,因此最终的8美元B计划员运行在封闭的校验器循环中,没有老师的呼声推断. 在精细剪辑(3{,}578美元的任务,7{,}971美元字幕剪辑,499美元音乐音轨,明细分类账)上,核查器重播的蒸馏器将计划器从0.620美元提升至0.858美元,用于特定协议的视频编辑分数和精细剪辑Evo,达到0.924美元;增益转至Llama-3.1-8B和GLM-4-9B,在同一闭环中,8美元B计划器匹配或超过其前沿教师. 代码和FineCut-Bench公开发布;参见数据可用性声明.

articles.title: On the Separation of Human and AI-Generated Images in CLIP Embedding Space
articles.content:
We identify a previously unreported phenomenon in CLIP representations: human and AI-generated paintings spontaneously separate along the dominant principal directions of their joint embedding distribution, without any supervised objective designed to distinguish the two classes. Rather than exploiting this phenomenon for detection, our objective is to interpret it: we seek to identify the visual information underlying the separation and to trace it back from the embedding space to the image domain. We pursue this objective through a progressive investigation combining interpretable image representations with gradient-based inversion, used systematically as an experimental probe of the relationships identified in feature space. Robustness experiments and increasingly expressive statistical descriptors progressively rule out several intuitive explanations based on global image properties and simple local statistics, and point instead to distributed multiscale image structure. Multiscale scattering provides the most informative interpretable representation considered, but offers only a partial account of the phenomenon.
  Direct inversion provides a complementary and striking observation: substantial displacements along the dominant CLIP directions can be induced by image perturbations that remain nearly imperceptible to human observers, showing that the directions involved in the separation are highly sensitive to image variations with very low perceptual salience for humans. Taken together, these results reveal a significant difference between the visual evidence reflected in CLIP representations and that readily accessible to human perception, raising broader questions about the relationship between artificial and human vision and, ultimately, between artificial and human aesthetic judgment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于CLIP嵌入空间中人类和人工智能图像的分离
articles.content_zh:
我们发现在CLIP表述中有一个以前未报告的现象:人类和人工智能创作的绘画按照它们联合嵌入式发行的主要方向自发分离,没有任何旨在区分这两类作品的有监督的目标。 我们的目标不是利用这种现象来探测,而是解释它:我们寻求识别分离背后的视觉信息,并追溯它从嵌入空间到图像域. 我们通过将可解释的图像表示与梯度反演相结合的渐进式调查来追求这一目标,这种反演有系统地用作对特征空间中查明的关系的实验探针。 强性实验和日益表现性的统计描述器逐渐排除了基于全球图像属性和简单局部统计的几种直观解释,而是指分布式的多尺度图像结构. 多尺度散射提供了所考虑的可解释性最强的表述,但对这一现象只作了部分说明。
直接反转提供了一种补充和惊人的观察:在主要CLIP方向上,图像扰动可能诱发大量迁移,而这种扰动对于人类观察者来说仍然几乎是无法想象的,这表明分离中涉及的方向对图像变化高度敏感,对人类的认知度非常低。 综合起来,这些结果揭示了CLIP表述中反映的视觉证据与人们容易获得的视觉证据之间的显著区别,对人造视觉和人造视觉之间的关系提出了更广泛的问题,并最终对人造和人造美学的判断提出了更广泛的问题.

articles.title: When Should a Network Emit Geometry, and When Should It Detect It? Readout, Reconciliation, and Representation in Floorplan Vectorization
articles.content: A network trained to recover the walls, openings, and rooms of a rasterized floorplan can produce its output in two ways: by emitting the geometry as an autoregressive coordinate sequence, or by detecting it on dense junction and centerline heatmaps and assembling a graph. We compare the two readouts on the same trained network. On real scans (CubiCasa5K) detection is better on every wall measure (+2.7 wall F1 at tolerance 0.05, +5.1 at 0.015; paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero), and reading an opening heatmap the decoder never used raises opening F1 by 2.6x without retraining. Within real scans the readout's advantage grows with plan size and reverses on small plans; on clean vector renders sequence decoding is better by 5 to 8 points where its training covered the render style, while under full domain shift the readout, given calibrated thresholds, stays ahead; neither ink density nor plan size explains the reversal. With matched data and recipe, a room-centric system with a reconciliation step and a wall-first sequence model reach comparable wall quality, so the output representation matters less than is usually assumed. A prior from the other family helps at the output but not at the input: deterministic fusion of the two outputs raises wall F1 by 7 points, whereas conditioning one model on the other's output gives no gain in three forms, including two ground-truth-content controls. We also provide an edit-cost metric that scores a draft by the human work needed to correct it, corrected CubiCasa5K annotations, and ResPlan-FP, a CC BY 4.0 benchmark of 16,998 plans with frozen splits and three baseline tracks. Code, the benchmark, and the corrected annotations are available at https://github.com/Cyprinus12138/fpvec-lab
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 网络几何时间和探测时间? 阅读、校对和在地面规划中的代表性
articles.content_zh: 训练有素的网能回收光栅化平面的墙壁、开口和房间,其输出方式有两种:将几何作为自动回转坐标序列释放,或在密集的交叉点和中线热图上探测,并组图。 我们比较了同一个训练有素的网络上的两次阅读。 在真扫描(CubiCasa5K)中,每一次墙壁测量(耐受度0.05+2.7墙F1,耐受度0.015+5.1;对靴间隔排除0)检测都更好,阅读一次开口热图时,解码器从未使用过提升开口F1乘2.6x而不再培训. 在真正的扫描范围内,读取的优势随着计划大小和小计划的反向而增加;在干净的矢量上,使序列解码在它的训练覆盖渲染样式的5到8点上更好,而在全域下,根据校准阈值,读取移位保持领先;墨水密度和计划大小都不能解释反向. 通过匹配的数据和配方,一个具有调节步骤的以房间为中心的系统以及一壁一序模型可以达到可比的墙壁质量,因此输出表现的重要性低于通常的假设. 另一个家族的前身有助于产出而不是投入:两种产出的确定性组合使墙F1上升了7点,而将一种模型限定在另一种产出上则没有三种形式的收益,包括两种地面真实内容控制。 我们还提供一种编辑成本衡量标准,通过人力工作对一份草稿进行评分,加以修正的CubiCasa5K说明,以及ResPlan-FP,一个CC BY 4.0基准,16,998计划,有冻结的拆分和三个基线轨道。 代码、基准和经更正的说明可在https://github.com/Cyprinus12138/fpvec-lab查阅。

articles.title: A Dual-Transformer for Multi-Camera View Recommendation
articles.content:
Multi-camera systems are foundational to modern media production, and multi-camera editing is a critical task. This involves the proper selection of the appropriate camera view at each moment. In this paper, we propose a novel Dual-Transformer architecture with Cross-Attention that heavily outperformed the current SOTA models over the TVMCE dataset (TV Shows Multicamera Editing dataset). Our model decouples these tasks: (1) a dedicated temporal encoder first processes the sequence of past frames to build a rich memory of the recent history, and (2) the candidate camera views then act as queries to this memory via a cross-attention module, allowing each candidate to independently interrogate the historical context and find the most relevant information for its own evaluation.
  Our approach achieved 56.60% Precision@0.5, representing a substantial improvement over the prior best result of 37.16%. We further conducted an ablation study exploring the use of lightweight backbone architectures, where the SwinV2 backbone yielded the best performance, achieving 69.65% Precision@0.5.
  Using this best-performing configuration, we then investigated the feasibility of adapting the model to replicate the editing style of a specific human editor. To this end, we fine-tuned the model using varying proportions of the initial segment of a target video. Our results demonstrate that even with only 20% of the video used for fine-tuning, the model exhibited measurable improvements in Precision@0.5, indicating strong potential for data-efficient personalization of editing style adapted to each individual TV show or producer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多卡梅拉双转换器 查看建议
articles.content_zh:
多镜头系统是现代媒体制作的基础,多镜头编辑是一项关键的任务. 这涉及在每一时刻适当选择适当的摄像机视图。 在本文中,我们提出一种具有跨视角的新型双转换器架构,它比TVMCE数据集(TV Shows Multicamera Edition data set)大大超过了目前的SOTA模型. 我们的模型解开这些任务:(1)一个专用的时间编码器首先处理过去帧的顺序,以建立丰富的近代历史记忆;(2)候选相机查看后通过交叉注意模块作为查询这个记忆,使每个候选相机能够独立地询问历史背景,找到最相关的信息来进行自己的评价.
我们的方法达到了56.60%的精度@0.5,与先前37.16%的最佳结果相比有了很大的改善。 我们进一步进行了一项开发研究,探索轻量级骨干结构的使用,SwinV2骨干取得了最佳业绩,实现了69.65%的精度@0.5.
使用这种最出色的配置,我们随后调查了对模型进行修改以复制特定人类编辑器的编辑风格的可行性. 为此,我们利用目标视频初始部分的不同比例对模型进行了微调. 我们的结果显示,即使只有20%的视频用于微调,该模型在精密度@0.5中显示出了可衡量的改进,表明对适合每个电视节目或制片人的编辑风格进行数据高效个性化的巨大潜力。

articles.title: V-Rubrics: Visual Faithfulness via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Vision-language models can produce fluent answers that are insufficiently grounded in the visual evidence: a single unsupported object, chart value, or intermediate inference can undermine an otherwise plausible response. We argue that this is a credit-assignment failure in multimodal post-training. Scalar outcome rewards indicate whether an answer is acceptable, but do not identify which visual facts are grounded, which reasoning steps are valid, or which instruction constraints are missed. We introduce Visual Rubrics-Based Reinforcement Learning, which decomposes reference responses into atomic propositions and scores generated answers along Visual Faithfulness (VF), Reasoning Consistency (RC), and Instruction Following (IF). The resulting rubric items provide structured partial credit and localize rubric credit when supporting evidence spans are available. We first obtain an SFT checkpoint by fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on the public OpenMMReasoner-SFT-874K corpus, adapting OpenMMReasoner's cold-start data recipe. We construct V-Rubrics 50K, a 50,248-example training set from 17 visually grounded sources, by applying rule-based filters before deriving example difficulty from rejection-sampling scores and then annotating every example with Gemini-3-Pro under the same structured prompt and protocol. We train our model based on the same SFT checkpoint using component-wise, prefix-localized rubric credit. Experiments show that our rubricbased GRPO improves over both the shared SFT baseline and answer-only GRPO, with the largest gains on knowledge-oriented and visually grounded reasoning benchmarks. The results show rubrics as a useful reward abstraction for visual post-training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: V-卢比: 通过基于Rubric的强化学习实现视觉信仰
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型可以产生在视觉证据中没有足够基础的流畅的答案:单个无支持对象,图表值,或中间推论会破坏原本可能存在的响应. 我们认为,这是多式联运后培训中的信用分配失败。 Scalar结果奖励表示一个答案是否可接受,但不确定哪些视觉事实是依据的,哪些推理步骤是有效的,或者哪些指令限制被忽略. 我们引入了基于视觉Rubrics的强化学习,将参考反应分解为原子命题,分数按照视觉信仰(VF),理性一致性(RC)和指令跟随(IF)生成答案. 由此产生的额定项目提供结构化部分信贷,并在有证据时将额定信贷本地化。 我们首先通过微调在公开的OpenMReasoner-SFT-874K 上的Qwen3-VL-8B-指令来获得一个SFT检查点,改造OpenMReasoner的冷启动数据配方. 我们从17个视网膜来源设计了V-Rubrics 50K,一个50 248个实例培训集,先采用基于规则的过滤器,然后从拒绝抽样分数中得出实例困难,然后根据同样的结构化的即时和协议将每个实例与双子座-3-Pro进行注释。 我们用相同的SFT检查站 来训练我们的车型, 使用组件, 前缀本地化的值名。 实验显示,我们基于标点的GRPO改进了共享的SFT基线和只回答的GRPO,在面向知识和基于视觉的推理基准方面取得了最大的收益。 结果显示Rumics是视觉训练后有用的奖励抽象.

articles.title: MLLMCLIP: Feature-Level Distillation of MLLM for Robust Vision-Language Representations
articles.content: Pretrained vision-language models such as CLIP excel at zero-shot recognition but often fail at compositionality, particularly attribute-object and relational structures. Recent studies mitigate this issue by augmenting training with synthetic hard negatives generated by a cascade of large language models and text-to-image models, which incurs substantial pipeline overhead. We instead propose MLLMCLIP, a heterogeneous distillation framework that transfers multimodal knowledge directly from a generative Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) teacher into a discriminative CLIP student, bypassing synthetic data entirely. To bridge the architectural mismatch between the two paradigms, we introduce an attention-based per-layer token selection and a CKA-based distillation loss. Compared to prior CLIP-enhancement methods, MLLMCLIP achieves state-of-the-art compositional accuracy while delivering consistent gains on standard zero-shot classification and image-text retrieval, showing that feature-level distillation strengthens both compositional and general vision-language representation capability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MLLMCLIP:用于强视-语言代表的 MLLLM 的特性级分级
articles.content_zh: CLIP等经过预先训练的视觉语言模型在零镜头识别上表现优异,但往往在组成上失败,特别是属性对象和关系结构. 最近的研究减轻了这一问题,办法是通过一系列大型语言模型和文本到图像模型产生的合成硬底片来增加培训,这需要大量的管道管理费。 相反,我们提议采用MLLMCLIP这一多样化的蒸馏框架,将多式联运知识直接从遗传性多式联运大语言模型(MLLM)教师转移到歧视性的CLIP学生身上,完全绕过合成数据。 为了弥补两个范式之间的建筑不匹配,我们引入了基于注意力的每层符号选择和基于CKA的蒸馏损失. 与以前的CLIP增强方法相比,MLLMCLIP实现了最先进的组成精度,同时在标准零镜头分类和图像文本检索上取得了一致的收获,表明特征级的蒸馏既加强了组成能力,也加强了一般的视觉语言表现能力.

articles.title: CrossMambaTuning: Synergistic Spatial and Cross-Layer Adaptation for Machine Vision Compression
articles.content: To reduce deployment cost and retraining overhead, adapting pretrained learned image compression (LIC) models to downstream machine vision tasks has attracted growing attention. However, existing methods typically insert fine-tuning modules independently into frozen backbones, lacking explicit mechanisms for cross-layer coordination. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework named CrossMambaTuning, which integrates State Space Models with cross-layer interaction mechanisms for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Specifically, we design an efficient Mamba adapter equipped with task-specific prompts and multi-scale branching to precisely capture both local features and global dependencies. Furthermore, we introduce a Scale-Invariant Cross-Layer Adapter (SICA) utilizing a parameter-sharing strategy to fuse task information across different scales and reduce redundancy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CrossMambaTuning achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on multiple machine vision tasks, reducing parameter overhead by 72\% compared to SOTA methods. Code is available at https://github.com/rsr1123/CrossMambaTuning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CrossMambaTuning:协同空间和跨Layer适应机器视觉压缩
articles.content_zh: 为降低部署成本和再培训管理费用,将经过预先训练的图像压缩模型用于下游机器视觉任务,引起了越来越多的关注。 然而,现有方法通常会独立地将微调模块插入冷冻骨干,缺乏明确的跨层协调机制. 为了解决这一局限性,我们提出了一个名为CrossMambaTuning的新框架,将州空间模型与跨层互动机制结合起来,进行参数效率微调。 具体地说,我们设计了一个高效的Mamba适配器,配备了针对具体任务的提示和多尺度分支,以准确捕捉当地特征和全球依赖性. 此外,我们采用了一个“规模-Invariant Cross-Layer”适应器(SICA),利用一个参数共享战略,将任务信息纳入不同尺度,并减少冗余。 广泛的实验证明,CrossMambaTuning在多个机器视觉任务上实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能,与SOTA方法相比,参数的间接性减少了72\%. 代码见https://github.com/rsr1123/CrossMambaTuning。

articles.title: AdaVDR: Adaptive Tool Use and Reflection for Video Deep Research
articles.content: Video deep research answers complex questions by jointly understanding video content and retrieving external knowledge from the open Web. However, diverse questions and videos require different tool-use strategies, and inappropriate tool calls can produce incorrect results. Uncertain grounding and retrieval also make unnecessary interactions costly and error-prone, increasing latency and reasoning errors. To address these challenges, we propose AdaVDR, an adaptive video deep research agent with adaptive tool invocation and reflection. AdaVDR selects tools according to the task and its capabilities, and backtracks only when unreliable intermediate results require correction. To enable these capabilities, we develop a video deep research data construction pipeline. We first discover retrieval-relevant events and entities in diverse videos and acquire detailed information through grounding and external retrieval to construct high-quality QA pairs. For each QA, task-specific prompts organize the information acquisition process into a tool-use trajectory, allowing different question and video types to follow different grounding and retrieval strategies. We further introduce model-conditioned tool necessity filtering, which evaluates tool calls against the target model's video understanding and internal knowledge, removing tools or tool chains the model can bypass. This yields trajectories tailored to the target model's video understanding capability and knowledge. Using this pipeline, we construct training data and VDR-EE, a benchmark covering entity-centric and event-centric questions. We perform supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with a redundancy-aware reward to strengthen adaptive tool invocation and reflection. Experiments show that our method performs best among the evaluated open-source models on VDR-EE and substantially improves over its base models on VideoDR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AdaVDR:视频深层研究的适应性工具使用和反射
articles.content_zh: 视频深度研究通过共同理解视频内容和从开放的网络检索外部知识来解答复杂的问题. 然而,不同的问题和视频需要不同的工具使用策略,不适当的工具调用可能会产生不正确的结果. 不确定的地基和检索也使得不必要的相互作用代价高昂,而且容易出错,从而增加了延迟性和推理错误。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议AdaVDR,一个具有适应性工具引用和反思的适应性视频深度研究代理商。 AdaVDR根据任务及其能力选择工具,只有在不可靠的中间结果需要更正时才进行回溯跟踪. 为了增强这些能力,我们开发了一个视频深层研究数据构建管道。 我们首先在各种视频中发现与检索相关的事件和实体,并通过地面定位和外部检索获取详细信息,以构建高质量的质量保证配对. 对于每个质量保证,特定任务提示将信息获取过程组织成一个工具使用轨迹,允许不同的问题和视频类型遵循不同的定位和检索策略. 我们进一步引入了模型有条件的工具必要性过滤,它根据目标模型的视频理解和内部知识来评价工具调用,去除模型可以绕过的工具或工具链. 这产生适合目标模型视频理解能力和知识的轨迹. 利用这一管道,我们构建了培训数据和VDR-EE,这一基准涵盖以实体为中心的问题和以事件为中心的问题。 我们进行有监督的微调,然后进行强化学习,并给予冗余意识奖励,以加强适应性工具的引用和反思。 实验显示我们的方法在VDR-EE上被评价的开源模型中表现最好,并且大大改进了VideoDR上的基础模型.

articles.title: CropCop: An Auditable 120-Class Plant-Health Model from Benchmark Reconstruction to a Quantised Runtime Artifact
articles.content: A plant-health score can appear precise while resting on duplicated image families, a long-tailed label space, or a runtime file that was never evaluated. We present CropCop, a closed-set recognition system spanning 120 operational plant-health classes and an evidence chain from corpus reconstruction to direct execution of the final quantised artifact. Starting from 117,546 audited images, we rejected the inherited partition after confirming 3,233 duplicate relationships across split boundaries and froze a 109,107-image benchmark with zero crossings among the audited trusted leakage groups and a 151.7 largest-to-smallest class ratio. A fully fine-tuned DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Tiny reference achieved 98.51% accuracy and 96.87% macro-F1 on the locked internal test. A compact MobileNetV4 Conv-Medium derivative achieved 98.46% accuracy and 96.27% macro-F1 without being presented as evidence for a new distillation method. Validation-only post-training quantisation selected dynamic activations with per-channel weights, and the final 22.60 MiB ExecuTorch/XNNPACK PTE achieved 98.46% accuracy and 96.23% macro-F1 when executed directly. Only six of 16,363 top-1 decisions changed between the converted INT8 graph and the PTE, while paired analysis showed a modest class-balanced loss; an exploratory post hoc fruit-label slice localized a larger recall decline than aggregate accuracy revealed. CropCop establishes strong leakage-controlled internal recognition and software-runtime fidelity; it does not establish performance on unseen farms, camera pipelines, or physical Android hardware.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CropCop:从基准重建到量化运行时人工操作的可审计120级植物健康模型
articles.content_zh: 植物健康得分可以看起来精确,同时休息在复制的图像家族,长尾标签空间,或者运行时间文件上从未被评价过. CropCop是一个封闭的识别系统,涵盖120个可操作的植物保健类别,以及从生物体重建到直接执行最后量化文物的证据链。 从117 546份经审计的图像开始,我们在确认3 233个跨分界线的重复关系之后,拒绝了继承的分区,冻结了109 107个图像基准,在经审计的可信赖的渗漏组中,零跨度和151.7个最大与最小的类比。 完全微调的DINOv3 ConvNEXt-Tiny 引用在锁定的内部测试中实现了98.51%的精度和96.87%的宏F1. 一个紧凑的MobileNetV4 Conv-Medium衍生物实现了98.46%的精度和96.27%的宏F1,但没有被作为新的蒸馏方法的证据. 只验证的训练后量子化选择了每个通道重量的动态激活,最终的22.60 MiB ExecuTorch/XNNPACK PTE实现98.46%的精度,直接执行时达到96.23%的宏F1. 在转换后的INT8图和PTE之间,16,363个最高-1决定中只有6个改变了,而配对分析显示的阶级平衡损失不大;探索性的后果标签切片本地化的召回率比总精度揭示的要大。 CropCop建立了强大的渗漏控制内部识别和软件运行时忠贞性;它没有在看不见的农场、照相机管道或物理Android硬件上建立性能。

articles.title: Video-IFBench: Evaluating Instruction Following of Multimodal LLMs in Video Understanding Scenarios
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in video understanding. However, their ability to follow instructions in this domain remains under-explored. Real-world video understanding requires models not only to interpret video content correctly, but also to satisfy diverse user-specified constraints. Existing benchmarks focus primarily on task accuracy rather than instruction adherence, leaving this capability insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce Video-IFBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating instruction following in video understanding, where models must satisfy diverse user-specified constraints, including those grounded in visual and audio content. We develop an instruction taxonomy with four templates, including single-task, multi-task, selection, and nested instructions, covering 32 task types and 39 manually designed constraint categories spanning both semantic and format requirements. To reduce annotation cost, we build a semi-automatic data construction pipeline that combines MLLMs, programmatic processing, and human verification, resulting in 1.5K samples. We conduct a large-scale evaluation of more than 20 recent MLLMs and show that video instruction following remains challenging for current models, especially for instructions with many constraints, semantic constraints, or complex conditional structures that require selecting the correct branch or path based on video content. We hope our work will facilitate future research on instruction following in video understanding scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Video-IF Bench:评价在Video understands中采用多式联运有限责任公司的指示
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视频理解方面表现出了强大的性能. 然而,他们在这方面遵循指示的能力仍然没有得到充分探讨。 现实世界的视频理解要求模型不仅正确诠释视频内容,而且满足不同的用户特定限制. 现有基准主要侧重于任务的准确性,而不是遵守指令,使这种能力得不到充分的评价。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了Video-IF Bench,这是评价在视频理解中遵循的指令的全面基准,模型必须满足用户特有的各种限制,包括基于视觉和音频内容的限制。 我们开发了一个包含四个模板的指令分类学,包括单任务、多任务、选择和嵌套指令,涵盖32个任务类型和39个手动设计的制约类别,涵盖语义和格式要求。 为了降低注释成本,我们建造了一条半自动数据建设管道,将MLLM,程序处理,以及人机核查结合起来,产生了1.5K样本. 我们对最近20多个MLLMs进行大规模评价,并表明遵循的视频指示对于目前的模型来说仍然具有挑战性,特别是对于许多限制、语义限制或复杂的条件结构,这些结构需要根据视频内容选择正确的分支或路径。 我们希望我们的工作将促进今后在视频理解情景中进行教学研究。

articles.title: Asymmetric Cross-Modal Fine-Grained Visual Categorization: ACF-Net and the BirdPro Benchmark
articles.content: Audio-visual cross-modal Fine-Grained Visual Categorization (FGVC) aims to identify fine-grained categories by jointly leveraging visual and auditory information. However, FGVC under asymmetric cross-modal scenarios has received limited attention, where paired video and audio are not strictly synchronized and may not even correspond to the same individual or moment. Such weak and ambiguous cross-modal correspondence poses substantial challenges to effective representation learning and modality alignment. To address these issues, we propose ACF-Net, a novel optical flow-guided framework for asymmetric audio-visual fine-grained learning. ACF-Net consists of two key modules: Optical Flow-Guided Motion (OFGM) and Asymmetric CrossModal Adaptive Fusion (ACAF). OFGM captures motion-sensitive visual cues and suppresses irrelevant background interference, thereby enhancing discriminative dynamic representations in videos. ACAF estimates modality reliability under weakly matched audio-video pairs and performs uncertainty-aware adaptive fusion to improve category-level recognition robustness. To support research on asymmetric cross-modal FGVC, we further construct BirdPro, a new bird-oriented audio-visual benchmark, since existing datasets often lack large-scale category-level audio-video associations under non-strict temporal and instance correspondence. BirdPro contains 1,919 audio recordings and 11,965 videos covering 194 bird species. Extensive experiments show that ACF-Net achieves the best results compared with representative baseline methods, outperforming the strongest baselines by 2.97% and 1.92% in the fused and mismatched settings, respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不对称的跨 Modal 精细的视觉分类:ACF-Net和鸟类Pro基准
articles.content_zh: 视听跨模式的精致视觉分类(FGVC)旨在通过联合利用视觉和听觉信息确定精致的类别. 然而,非对称交叉模式情景下的FGVC受到的关注有限,配对视频和音频不严格同步,甚至可能无法对应同一个人或瞬间. 这种薄弱和模棱两可的跨模式函证对有效的代表学习和方式协调提出了重大挑战。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议使用ACF-Net,作为非对称视听精细学习的新光学流导框架。 ACF-Net由两个关键模块组成:光学流导动(OFGM)和不对称的跨流调性融合(ACAF). OFGM捕捉运动敏感视觉提示并压制无关背景干扰,从而增强视频中歧视性动态表现. ACAF在配对弱的音频-视频配对下估算模式可靠性,并进行不确定性-意识适应性聚变,以提高类别级识别强度. 为了支持对不对称的跨模式FGVC的研究,我们进一步构建了BirdPro,一个新的面向鸟类的视听基准,因为现有的数据集在非限制性的时间和实例通信下往往缺乏大规模的类别级音频视频协会. 鸟 Pro包含1,919个录音和11,965个视频,涉及194个鸟类物种. 广泛的实验表明,与具有代表性的基准方法相比,ACF-Net取得了最佳成果,在引信和不匹配的环境下,它的表现分别比最强的基线高出2.97%和1.92%。

articles.title: OpenVeinNet: Robust Open-Set Finger Vein Verification with Dynamic Snake Convolution and Graph Learning
articles.content: Finger vein verification is a promising biometric modality for secure authentication because vascular patterns are internal, difficult to observe externally, and relatively resistant to presentation attacks. However, reliable verification remains challenging in open-set settings, where test identities are unseen during training and non-enrolled probes must be rejected at inference. This paper presents OpenVeinNet, a finger vein verification framework designed for cross-dataset and open-set evaluation. The proposed model combines Dynamic Snake Convolution with graph-based feature modelling. Dynamic Snake Convolution extracts local curvilinear and tubular vein structures using adaptive sampling, while the graph convolutional backbone models long-range topological relationships between vein regions. To improve the discriminative quality of the embedding space, we introduce a Centroid Angular Hybrid Loss, which jointly encourages intra-class compactness and inter-class angular separation for cosinesimilaritybased verification. Experiments are conducted on five public finger vein datasets: FV-300, MMCBNU, FV-USM, PolyU, and VERA. The method is evaluated using leaveonedatasetout training under both enrolmentbased unknownrejection and fullsubject verification protocols, and is compared with handcrafted and recent deep learning-based baselines. The results show that OpenVeinNet achieves strong cross-dataset generalisation, consistently low equal error rates, and competitive true accept rates at fixed false accept rate operating points. Ablation studies further confirm the individual and combined contributions of adaptive tubular feature extraction, graph-based relational modelling, and the proposed loss function. These findings indicate that explicitly modelling local vein geometry, global vascular relationships, and angularly compact embeddings is effective for openset finger vein verification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OpenVeinNet: 强力的 Open-Set Finger Vein 验证 动态蛇的演化和图形学习
articles.content_zh: 指脉核查是安全认证的一种有希望的生物鉴别方式,因为血管模式是内部的,外部难以观察,相对能抵御表征攻击. 然而,在开放的设置环境中,可靠的核查仍然具有挑战性,在这种环境下,在培训过程中看不到测试身份,必须推论拒绝非注册探测器。 本文介绍OpenVeinNet,这是为跨数据集和开机评价设计的指脉验证框架. 提议的模型将动态蛇演化与基于图表的特征建模相结合. 动态蛇流利用适应性采样提取局部曲线和管状静脉结构,而图流骨干模型则在静脉区域之间形成远距离的地形关系. 为了提高嵌入空间的歧视性质量,我们引入了Centroid Angular Hybrid Loss,共同鼓励在同位素基础上进行同位素核查的类内紧凑和类间角分离。 在五个公共指脉数据集上进行实验:FV-300,MMCBNU,FV-USM,PolyU和VERA. 采用留职数据集培训对这种方法进行评估时,既有基于入学的无名拒绝,也有基于全部科目的核查规程,并将这种方法与手工制作的和最近的基于深层学习的基线进行比较。 结果显示,OpenVeinNet实现了强跨数据集通用化,一贯低等误差率,并在固定的虚假接受率操作点上实现竞争性真实接受率. 校准研究进一步证实了适应性管状特征提取、基于图表的关系建模和拟议损失功能的个别和综合贡献。 这些发现表明,明确模拟局部静脉几何,全球血管关系,以及角紧凑的嵌入,对于开位的手指静脉验证是有效的.

articles.title: Pose-Anchored Optical Flow for Low-Latency Human Action Anticipation in Human-Robot Teaming
articles.content: Human-robot interaction (HRI) requires robots to interpret human actions early in their execution in order to respond safely, efficiently, and naturally. However, many existing approaches to human action recognition rely either on sparse skeletal representations, which lack fine-grained motion cues, or dense optical flow, which can be computationally expensive for low-latency perception pipelines. In this paper, we propose PoseOFF, a pose-anchored optical flow representation that captures local motion information around human joints to support earlier human intent understanding. By conditioning motion feature extraction on human pose, PoseOFF encodes localised motion dynamics at semantically meaningful body locations, forming a structured motion representation that is explicitly aligned with human kinematics. We evaluate PoseOFF across multiple benchmark datasets and backbone architectures for action anticipation, demonstrating consistent improvements in recognition accuracy, particularly at early observation ratios. Our results show that PoseOFF enables models to achieve comparable or improved performance while observing less of the action sequence, highlighting its effectiveness for early prediction. Importantly, these gains are achieved without requiring full-frame motion processing, making the approach practical for real-time and resource-constrained settings. These findings suggest that pose-centred motion representations such as PoseOFF can enhance the ability of interactive robot systems to infer human actions earlier, supporting more responsive and anticipatory behaviour in human-robot interaction scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 低强度人类行动预测的Pose-Anchored光学流动
articles.content_zh: 人与机器人的相互作用(HRI)要求机器人在行刑初期对人的行为进行解释,以便安全,高效,自然的应对. 然而,许多现有的人类行动识别方法要么依赖缺乏精致运动提示的骨骼表达,要么依赖密集的光学流,对于低纬度感知管道来说,光学流在计算上可能是昂贵的。 在本文中,我们提出PoseOFF,一种姿势焦虑的光学流代表,它能捕捉围绕人类关节的局部运动信息,支持早期人类的意向理解. PoseOFF通过调节运动特征在人体姿势上的提取,将局部运动动力编码在有目的的身体位置,形成一种结构化的运动代表,明确与人类动能一致. 我们通过多个基准数据集和骨干架构对PoseOFF进行评估,以预测行动,显示识别准确性持续提高,特别是在早期观测比率方面。 我们的结果显示,PoseOFF使模型能够实现可比或更好的性能,同时较少观察动作序列,突出其早期预测的有效性. 重要的是,这些成果的实现不需要全方位的动作处理,使实时和受资源限制的设置方法切实可行。 这些研究结果表明,以姿势为中心的运动表现,如PoseOFF,可以增强交互式机器人系统更早地推断人类行动的能力,支持人与机器人互动情景中更具应变性和预期性的行为.

articles.title: SMART: MLLM-guided Temporal Alignment for Unifying Sign Language Recognition and Spotting
articles.content: Continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) aims to recognize gloss sequences from unsegmented sign videos under weak sequence-level supervision. However, existing methods rely on sentence-level gloss annotations, providing limited temporal and semantic guidance for fine-grained representation learning. Conventional video-text alignment also requires large batch sizes, making it inefficient for memory-intensive sign language video training. In this work, we propose SMART, an MLLM-guided temporal alignment framework for joint sign recognition and spotting. SMART uses MLLMgenerated motion descriptions as auxiliary semantic cues and performs stable videotext alignment under small-batch training. To improve temporal representation learning, we introduce a Multi-Scale Temporal Adapter that models temporal interactions during transformer encoding. For dense temporal localization, SMART incorporates CSFormer, a CSLR-guided spotting module that injects recognition-derived gloss evidence into a boundary-aware spotting network. This unified framework enables CSLR features to benefit spotting, while spotting supervision complements weak CTC-based recognition. Experiments on four sign language benchmarks, including PHOENIX14-T, CSL-Daily, Large-scale KSL, and Disaster and Safety KSL datasets, demonstrate the effectiveness of SMART across both recognition and spotting tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SMART: 统一手语识别和示意图的 MLLM 制导同步
articles.content_zh: 持续的手语识别(CSLR)旨在识别在弱序列级别监督下未分解的手语视频的光泽序列. 然而,现有方法依赖于句式层次的拼写说明,为精细的表达式学习提供了有限的时间和语义指导. 常规视频文本的对齐也需要大批量尺寸,使得对内存密集的手语视频培训效率低下. 在这项工作中,我们提议采用SMART,这是由MLLM制导的用于联合签名识别和抽查的时间调整框架。 SMART使用MLLM生成的运动描述作为辅助语义提示,并在小批量训练下进行稳定的视频文本对齐. 为了改进时间表现的学习,我们引入了一个多尺度时间适应器,在变压器编码过程中模拟时间相互作用。 对于密集的时间定位,SMART整合了CSFormer,一个CSLR制导的定点模块,将识别衍生的光泽证据注入了边界感知定点网络. 这一统一框架使CSLR特征能够有利于点查,而点查监督是对基于四氯化碳的薄弱识别的补充。 关于四个手语基准的实验,包括PHOENIX14-T,CSL-Daily,大规模KSL,以及灾难和安全KSL数据集,都展示了SMART在识别和点点评任务上的有效性.

articles.title: Semi-Supervised Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Image Classification
articles.content: Vision-language models like CLIP have shown sig- nificant potential in handling natural images, yet their perfor- mance is often limited by the distinct characteristics of satellite imagery. While parameter-efficient adaptation techniques exist, their efficacy is frequently limited by the scarcity of annotated samples. In this letter, we propose Self-Evolutionary CLIP (SE- CLIP), a semi-supervised framework designed for recursive label mining in scene classification. The approach follows a dual-phase pipeline, where an initial warm-up on a few annotated seeds is followed by a recursive discovery phase that iteratively identifies high-confidence samples from unlabeled pools. To maintain the integrity of the evolving support set, we employ a class-balanced selection strategy that prevents the model from being dominated by easily learned categories. Results on the UCM and NWPU benchmarks indicate that SE-CLIP significantly outperforms existing semi-supervised approaches. The framework provides a viable solution for adapting VLMs to the remote sensing domain with minimal human intervention.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 图像分类愿景-语言模型的半监督调整
articles.content_zh: 象CLIP这样的视觉语言模型在处理自然图像方面显示出巨大的潜力,然而,其表面壁画往往受到卫星图像特点的限制。 虽然存在参数效率高的适应技术,但由于缺少附加说明的样品,其效力常常受到限制。 在这封信中,我们提出自我进化的CLIP(SE-CLIP),一个半监督的框架,旨在场景分类中的递归性标签开采. 这种方法遵循双阶段管道,首先在几个附加说明的种子上加热,然后是递归式发现阶段,迭代地确定来自无标签池的高度自信样本。 为了保持不断演变的支助组合的完整性,我们采用了一种班级平衡的选拔战略,防止模式被容易学习的类别所支配. 关于《统一管理办法》和《国家工作计划》基准的结果表明,SE-CLIP的绩效大大高于现有的半监督方法。 该框架提供了一种可行的解决办法,使甚高分辨率技术适应遥感领域,同时尽量减少人类干预。

articles.title: Gaussian Splatting Underwater: A Controlled Cross-Regime Study
articles.content: The underwater environment is challenging for 3D reconstruction, because particles suspended in the water scatter and diffuse light, turbidity varies, absorption depends on wavelength, and illumination is rarely uniform. Methods based on Gaussian splatting have generally been developed for conditions that allow good image quality, and have primarily been tested on relatively shallow water. This paper examines how well Gaussian splatting performs across publicly available underwater datasets representing different degrees of turbidity, loss of illumination, and colour attenuation, together with an industrial survey. Five systems with public code are run under one protocol, with shared poses, initialisation, budget, and evaluator, to establish their relative advantages, disadvantages, and limitations. What these methods can do turns out to depend more on the setup than on the architecture. Water clarity binds upstream of rendering, since structure-from-motion registers 99.5 \% of frames in clear water and 0.0 \% at 12 NTU. Illumination geometry decides whether a medium model helps at all: under an artificial light that moves with the camera, medium-blind splatting beats both medium-aware systems. On the survey the benchmark's photometric leader comes last, beaten on geometry by a restoration pre-pass in front of vanilla 3DGS---and none of it is visible in the scores the field reports. Scene builds, per-run configurations, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/olayasturias/uw3dgs
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高斯白板游戏 水下:受控的跨行政区研究
articles.content_zh: 水下环境对3D重建具有挑战性,因为悬浮在水中的颗粒散射和散射光,扰动度不同,吸收取决于波长,照明很少统一. 以高斯滑板为基础的方法,一般是为能够具有良好图像质量的条件而开发的,主要在相对浅水上进行测试. 本文研究了高斯滑板在公共水下数据集中表现的好情况,这些数据集代表着不同程度的混凝土、光照损失和颜色衰减,以及工业调查。 5个有公共代码的系统在一个协议下运行,有共同的姿势、初始化、预算和评估,以确定它们的相对优势、劣势和局限性。 这些方法能做的,最终更依赖于设置而不是架构. 水的清晰度将成像的上游结合起来,因为结构的自动性在清水中记录了99.5个帧,在12 NTU中记录了0.0个帧。 光电几何可以决定一个介质模型是否有帮助:在与相机一起移动的人工光线下,中盲电镀会击败两个中意识系统. 在调查中,该基准的测光头领是最后一位的,在几何学上被一个修复前通道在香草3DGS前击败,在现场的分数中都看不出来。 在https://github.com/olayasturias/uw3dgs发布场景构建、每个运行的配置和评价代码

articles.title: DeCO: Discriminative Evidence Composition for Fine-Grained Dataset Distillation
articles.content: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while preserving its downstream utility. However, existing methods primarily preserve global image statistics and may overlook the localized evidence essential for fine-grained visual classification (FGVC), such as object parts, subtle textures, and region-specific structures. We formulate fine-grained dataset distillation as budgeted discriminative-evidence preservation and propose Discriminative Evidence Composition (DeCO). DeCO uses attention rollout from a pretrained TransFG teacher to identify informative patches, applies spatial diversification to reduce redundant coverage, and organizes the resulting regions into class-wise evidence banks. Multiple same-class regions are then packed into compact grid-composed images. The teacher is used only for dataset construction, whereas downstream students are trained with standard hard-label supervision without teacher logits. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, FGVC-Aircraft, and Stanford Cars show that DeCO consistently outperforms representative coreset and dataset-distillation baselines under different IPC budgets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DeCO:精细数据集稀释的歧视性证据构成
articles.content_zh: 数据集蒸馏将大型训练集压缩成紧凑的合成集,同时保留其下游的效用. 然而,现有方法主要保存全球图像统计,并可能忽略精细视觉分类所必需的局部证据,如物体部件、微妙纹理和特定区域的结构。 我们制定精细的数据集蒸馏法,作为歧视证据保存预算,并提出歧视证据构成。 DeCO利用经过预先培训的TransFG教师的注意力推展来识别信息补丁,应用空间多样化以减少冗余覆盖范围,并将由此产生的区域组织成阶级证据库. 多个同级区域随后被包装成紧凑的网格组合图像. 该教师仅用于数据集建设,而下游学生则在没有教师登录的情况下接受标准硬标签监管培训. 关于CUB-200-2011、FGVC-Aircraft和Stanford Cars的实验表明,DeCO在不同的IPC预算下,一直比有代表性的核心集和数据集的消化基准要好。

articles.title: 4DStreamCtrl: Interactive Video Generation with Online 4D Control
articles.content: Generative video models now synthesize footage nearly indistinguishable from reality. Their promise as interactive tools hinges on fine-grained control of how objects and the camera move over time, yet each existing approach captures only part of this: camera-parameter methods steer the viewpoint but cannot move objects, 2D-trajectory methods act in the image plane and ignore depth and occlusion, and recent 3D methods add geometry but run only offline at a fixed length. In particular, none combines 3D-consistent control of both camera and objects with real-time, streaming generation. Here we show that camera motion, object trajectories, and depth can be unified into a single 3D point-track representation, from which one model performs joint camera and object control, depth editing, and motion transfer in a single forward pass. To learn this interface at scale, we mine in-the-wild video for 3D motion supervision, yielding OpenVidHD-Motion3D, and encode it with a lightweight Geometric Motion Head that plugs into a pretrained video diffusion model. Because this encoder is temporally separable, we distill the model into a causal streaming student that generates arbitrarily long video in four denoising steps at memory independent of length. This unified design surpasses prior camera-only, 2D, and offline-3D methods in motion-control precision while covering modalities they address only in isolation. 4DStreamCtrl runs at 20 FPS on a single high-end GPU for 480p video and stays temporally coherent over hundreds of frames, enabling, to our knowledge, interactive 4D-controllable streaming generation for the first time. More broadly, grounding generation in explicit 3D geometry with efficient causal inference points toward interactive world models with closed-loop spatiotemporal control, from controllable simulators to real-time visual imagination for embodied agents.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 4DStreamCtrl:交互式视频生成与在线4D控制
articles.content_zh: 基因视频模型现在合成了几乎无法与现实区分的镜头. 他们作为交互式工具的承诺取决于对物体和相机如何随时间而移动的精细控制,然而每个现有方法只捕捉到其中的一部分:相机参数方法引导视线但不能移动物体,2D射线方法在图像平面中作用而忽略深度和隐蔽,最近的3D方法添加几何,但只在固定长度下运行. 特别是,无一将相机和物体的3D-一致控制与实时,流化生成相结合. 在这里,我们显示相机运动,物体轨迹,和深度可以统一为单一的3D点轨道代表,从中,一个模型进行联合相机和物体控制,深度编辑,在单个前传中进行运动转移. 为了在尺度上学习这个接口,我们为3D运动监督工作埋下全天候的视频,生成OpenVidHD-Motion3D,并用轻量级几何运动头来编码,将它插入预先训练的视频传播模型. 因为这个编码器在时间上是可分离的,所以我们把模型蒸馏成一个因果流派学生,在独立于长度的内存的四个解码步骤中任意生成长视频. 这种统一设计超越了先前的只摄像头,2D,以及运动控制精度的离线-3D方法,同时涵盖了它们只单独处理的方式. 4DStreamCtrl在480p视频的单高端GPU上以20FPS运行,并在数百个帧上保持时间一致性,使得我们所知的交互式4D可控流流代首次得以实现. 更广泛地说,将生成定位在清晰的3D几何中,并带有高效的因果推论点,向具有闭合-loop瞬间控制的交互式世界模型,从可控模拟器到对内含物剂的实时视觉想象.

articles.title: PAGS: Autofocusing Photoacoustic Tomography via Speed-of-Sound-Adaptive Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Photoacoustic computed tomography (PACT) combines optical absorption contrast with acoustic detection for high-resolution deep-tissue imaging. A persistent challenge is that unknown speed-of-sound (SoS) heterogeneity changes acoustic time-of-flight, causing defocusing artifacts when reconstruction assumes a uniform SoS. Existing SoS-adaptive methods either rely on calibrated acoustic priors or optimize dense physical medium models, which becomes expensive and difficult to scale in 3D. We propose PAGS, a differentiable framework for blind autofocusing PACT via speed-of-sound-adaptive Gaussian splatting. PAGS represents the initial pressure field with sparse Gaussian photoacoustic (PA) sources and replaces explicit medium recovery with a compact anisotropic path-averaged SoS (ASoS) field parameterized by spherical harmonic probes. This latent propagation field directly controls source-to-transducer arrival-time alignment, while an analytic Gaussian acoustic projection maps the source representation to transducer signals efficiently. The resulting closed-loop signal-domain optimization jointly updates the Gaussian PA source parameters and the ASoS field from measured data, without calibrated SoS priors. Experiments on simulated and physical phantom data demonstrate improved reconstruction sharpness under heterogeneous acoustic media, robustness to sparse-view sampling, and computational benefits from the analytic Gaussian projection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PAGS:通过声速高斯电镀自动聚焦光声摄影
articles.content_zh: 光声学计算成像法(PACT)将光学吸收对比与声学探测相结合,用于高分辨率的深组织成像. 一个持续的挑战就是未知的声速(SoS)异性会改变声学飞行时间,在重建假设一个统一的声速(SoS)时导致文物失去重点. 现有的声速(SS)适应方法要么依赖于校准的声学前科,要么优化密集的物理介质模型,这些模型在3D中变得昂贵且难以缩放. 我们建议PAGS,一个不同的框架,盲目自动聚焦PACT 通过声速适应的高斯滑板。 PAGS代表初始的压力场,带有稀疏的高斯光声学(PA)源,并以球形口号探测器所分解的紧凑的异同位素平均SOS(ASoS)场参数取代显性中恢复. 这个潜在的传播场直接控制源到发器的到发时间对齐,而分析的高斯声波投射则将源的表示图高效地映射到传发器信号. 由此形成的闭路信号域优化,联合更新了高斯PA源参数和ASOS域的测量数据,没有校准SOS前传. 对模拟和物理幽灵数据的实验表明,在各种声学介质下,重建的锐度有所提高,对零视采样的强度提高,分析高斯投影的计算效益提高。

articles.title: Automatic weld seam segmentation for industrial quality control: a comparison of RGB and polarimetric imaging with CNN and transformer architectures
articles.content: Visual inspection of welded assemblies remains one of the least automated stages in many industrial production processes, still depending largely on the experience of human operators and thus subject to inter-operator variability; the manufacturing of special-purpose machinery cabins, the setting of this study, is one representative case. This work evaluates the feasibility of automatic weld seam segmentation from RGB and polarimetric imagery, comparing controlled laboratory acquisitions with images captured under real, uncontrolled conditions. Convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures and transformer-based architectures are benchmarked under a unified, threshold-independent protocol, training each CNN with three random seeds to separate genuine effects from seed noise. In controlled RGB conditions, CNN models reach a mean mask mAP50 of up to 0.87, but drop to 0.22-0.48 under uncontrolled acquisition, showing that the acquisition setup is a first-order component of the inspection system. Polarimetric imaging with alignment-preserving geometric augmentation localizes previously unseen welds with a mean mask mAP50 up to 0.93: on par with, rather than ahead of, the best controlled-RGB result, but reaching that accuracy on uncontrolled RGB without requiring acquisition control. The clearest architectural finding concerns viewpoint robustness. In-distribution, transformers and CNNs are broadly comparable; but under a test-time viewpoint shift, the transformer models, and RF-DETR in particular, retain high accuracy while every CNN collapses. The gap holds across three seeds and a resolution-matched control, pointing to architecture rather than training resolution. Within the CNN family, capacity brings no reliable in-distribution gain once seed variance is accounted for: small CNNs suffice for fixed viewpoints, transformers for variable ones.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 工业质量控制的自动焊接接分割:将RGB和极度成像与CNN和变压器架构进行比较
articles.content_zh: 对焊接组装的视觉检查仍然是许多工业生产工艺中自动化程度最低的阶段之一,仍然主要取决于人类操作人员的经验,因此受操作人员间变化的影响;制造特殊用途机械舱,本研究的设置,是一个有代表性的案例. 这项工作评价了从RGB和极度图像中自动焊接缝隙的可行性,将受控制的实验室购置与在真实,不受控制的条件下捕获的图像进行比较. 革命神经网络(CNN)架构和基于变压器的架构以统一,阈值独立的协议为基准,训练每个CNN使用三个随机种子,将真能效果与种子噪声区分开来. 在受控RGB条件下,CNN型号达到平均面罩mAP50,最高可达0.87,但在不受控制的收购下降至0.22-0.48,表明收购设置是检查系统的第一订单组件. 配对保存几何增强的极度成像将先前未见的焊接器定位在0.93以下:与最佳控制-RGB结果相当,而不是领先于最佳控制-RGB结果,但在不受控制的RGB上达到该精度而不需要获取控制. 最清楚的建筑发现涉及观点稳健性。 分散式、变压器和CNN大致相当;但是,在试验时间角度的转变下,变压器模型,特别是RF-DETR,在CNN每一次倒闭时都保持高精度。 差距存在于三个种子和一个与分辨率相称的控制之间,指向架构而不是培训分辨率。 在有线电视新闻网的家族中,一旦种子差异被计算在内,能力就不会带来可靠的分配收益:小的有线电视新闻网足够固定的视线,变形器可以变形。

articles.title: VGA-BenchV2: An Expanded Unified Benchmark and Multi-Model Framework for Evaluating Video Aesthetics and Generation Quality
articles.content: We introduce VGA-BenchV2, an extended human-aligned benchmark and optimization framework for jointly evaluating and improving video generation quality and aesthetic value. Built upon VGA-Bench, VGA-BenchV2 preserves the original fine-grained taxonomy with two primary dimensions-Aesthetic and Generation-and 52 sub-dimensions. Guided by this taxonomy, we curate 1,016 diverse prompts and collect over 60,000 videos generated by 12 mainstream video generation models. More importantly, VGA-BenchV2 substantially expands human-labeled supervision by adding 36,000 task-level annotations, including 16,200 for aesthetic quality, 13,200 for aesthetic tagging, and 6,600 for generation quality, corresponding to 13.46x, 11.15x, and 1.55x scale-ups over VGA-Bench, respectively. Leveraging this enlarged annotation corpus, we develop a hybrid evaluator architecture consisting of VAQA-Net for continuous aesthetic scoring and two Qwen-based Large Vision-Language Model evaluators, VTag-Net and VGQA-Net, for aesthetic tagging and generation quality assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong alignment with human judgments across diverse generation models. Beyond evaluation, VGA-BenchV2 further introduces an evaluation-to-optimization pipeline, where the learned aesthetic evaluator serves as a reward model for reinforcement learning-based generator fine-tuning. This closes the loop from benchmark construction and human supervision to automated evaluation and model optimization, enabling video generators to improve not only in realism but also in aesthetic quality and human preference alignment. Resources are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/BestiVictoryLab/VGA-Bench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VGA-BenchV2:评价视频美学和生成质量的扩大统一基准和多模式框架
articles.content_zh: 我们采用VGA-BenchV2,这是扩大的与人相适应的基准和优化框架,用于共同评估和提高视频生成质量和美学价值。 建于VGA-Bench上,VGA-BenchV2保留了原始的细纹分类法,具有两个主要维度——美学和世代——和52个子维度. 在这种分类学的指引下,我们整理了1,016个不同的提示,收集了12个主流视频生成模型产生的超过6万个视频. 更为重要的是,VGA-BenchV2大幅扩展了人类标注的监管,增加了36000份任务级说明,包括16200份美学质量说明,13200份美学标签说明,6600份生成质量说明,分别对应13.46x,11.15x,以及1.55x在VGA-Bench之上的提升. 利用这一扩大的注释表,我们开发了一个混合评价结构,由用于持续美学评分的VAQA-Net和两个基于Quen的大型视觉语言模型评价员VTag-Net和VGQA-Net组成,用于美学标记和生成质量评估。 广泛的实验表明,不同代模型与人类判断高度一致。 除了评价之外,VGA-BenchV2还引入了评价到优化的管道,学习的美学评价员作为强化基于学习的发电机微调的奖励模式. 这关闭了从基准建设和人监督到自动评价和模型优化的循环,使得视频生成器不仅在现实主义方面,而且在美学质量和人类偏好一致性方面都有改善. 资源可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/BestiVictoryLab/VGA-Bench查阅。

articles.title: Saliency-Depth Conditioning for Zero-Shot Segmentation of Communication-Tower Components in Cluttered UAV Imagery
articles.content: Fine-grained segmentation of communication-tower components in UAV imagery is essential for automated inspection, yet task-specific models are hard to develop due to limited instance-level annotations. Zero-shot segmentation models offer a promising alternative, but in cluttered scenes, visually similar background structures interfere with component localization, causing missed instances and false positives. We propose a model-agnostic saliency-depth foreground-conditioning strategy combining appearance-based saliency with monocular relative depth to construct a coarse tower prior and suppress irrelevant content. We integrate this module with Grounded-SAM and SAM 3, yielding SD-Grounded-SAM and SD-SAM 3. SD-Grounded-SAM further applies geometric and depth-aware box refinement before mask generation, while SD-SAM 3 relies on SAM 3's internal setup. On TOW-300, a dataset of 340 communication-tower UAV images, our strategy improves both baselines: SD-SAM 3 achieves the strongest instance-segmentation performance, while SD-Grounded-SAM produces fewer false positives. Ablations confirm complementary gains from saliency, depth, and box refinement, improving robustness in cluttered scenes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Cluttered UAV中通信-接触器组件零分热的深度条件 图像
articles.content_zh: 无人驾驶飞行器图像中通信塔部件的精细分解对于自动检查至关重要,但由于实例级说明有限,具体任务模式难以开发。 零射分片模型提供了一个很有希望的替代方案,但在杂乱无章的场景中,视觉上相似的背景结构干扰了组件本地化,导致错失的事件和假阳性. 我们提出一种模型不可知的深度前缘修复策略,将外观上的显著性与单质的相对深度结合起来,在不相关内容之前建造一个粗瓦的塔,并压制不相关内容. 我们把这个模块与地面-SAM和SAM 3结合,生成SD-Grounded-SAM和SD-SAM 3. SD-Grounded-SAM在面具生成前进一步应用几何学和深度感知盒的改进,而SD-SAM 3依赖于SAM 3的内部设置. 在TOW-300上,一个由340个通信端的无人驾驶飞行器图像组成的数据集,我们的战略改进了两个基线:SD-SAM 3实现最强的实例分隔性能,而SD-Grounded-SAM产生较少的假阳性. 缺损证实了从显著性、深度和箱型精细化中取得的互补成果,提高了杂乱场景的稳健性。

articles.title: Bootstrapping a 4D LiDAR Annotation Tool from Video Foundation Models
articles.content: Progress in 4D LiDAR segmentation is bottlenecked by data. Assigning temporally consistent labels across sparse point cloud sequences is costly and hard to scale, and every new task or domain tends to demand fresh dense annotation. This motivates a simple question of whether high-quality LiDAR training data can be produced automatically, without any human labeling. To this end, we introduce LiDAR-SAM2, a framework that turns a 2D video foundation model, SAM2, into a scalable source of supervision for the 4D LiDAR domain. On the data side, it automatically generates temporally coherent LiDAR-level labels from SAM2 video masks through multi-view projection and spatio-temporal aggregation. On the modeling side, a tailored modality interface and a two-stage learning objective adapt SAM2's video segmentation kernel to spatio-temporal LiDAR structure, so that a single click per object yields a consistent mask track across the sequence. Trained with no human LiDAR annotation, LiDAR-SAM2 produces semantic and panoptic labels on SemanticKITTI that approach the quality of full human annotation from only a few points, and models trained on these labels approach the performance of full ground-truth supervision. This positions LiDAR-SAM2 as a scalable labeling tool that substantially reduces the annotation burden for 3D and 4D scene understanding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 来自视频基础模型的 4D LiDAR 注释工具
articles.content_zh: 4D LiDAR分解的进展因数据而瓶颈. 在稀疏的点云序列间分配时间上一致的标签,代价高昂,且难以规模化,每个新任务或领域都往往需要新鲜的密集注释. 这引发了一个简单的问题,即高质量的LiDAR训练数据是否可以自动生成,而无需任何人类标签. 为此,我们引入了LiDAR-SAM2,这个框架将2D视频基础模型SAM2转化为4DLiDAR域的可伸缩监督源. 在数据方面,它通过多视图投影和spitio-时空聚合,从SAM2视频口罩自动生成时间上一致的LiDAR级别标签. 在建模方面,一个定制模式界面和一个两阶段的学习目标使SAM2的视频分割内核适应了spatio-temporal的LiDAR结构,这样每个对象一次点击就能产生一个贯穿序列的一致的面具轨道. LiDAR-SAM2在没有人类LiDAR注释的训练下,在SemanticKITTI上生产语义和泛光学标签,这些标签只从几个点接近人的全面注释的质量,这些标签的训练模型则接近完全地面真实监督的性能. 这将LiDAR-SAM2定位为可缩放的标签工具,大大减轻了3D和4D场景理解的注释负担.

articles.title: AdaptiveEmbed: Sample-Adaptive Multi-Vector Representation for Multimodal Retrieval
articles.content: Multi-vector representations have emerged as an effective paradigm for multimodal retrieval, representing each sample with multiple complementary embeddings to capture fine-grained cross-modal information. However, existing approaches typically employ a fixed representation capacity, assigning the same number of vectors to all samples regardless of their individual retrieval demands. Such a fixed-capacity formulation overlooks the fact that different samples may require different amounts of representation capacity for effective retrieval. In this work, we introduce \emph{Sample-Adaptive Multi-Vector Representation} (SAMVR), a new problem setting for multimodal retrieval that studies how multi-vector representation capacity can be allocated at the sample level. Under SAMVR, each sample is represented by a \emph{content-adaptive embedding set} (CAES), whose capacity is determined according to the sample-specific retrieval utility of additional representation vectors. To instantiate SAMVR, we propose \emph{AdaptiveEmbed}, a unified framework for learning sample-adaptive multi-vector representations. AdaptiveEmbed learns structured multi-vector representations through \emph{Multi-Group Contrastive Learning} (MGCL) with the symmetric \emph{set-to-set similarity} (SetSim), and further employs \emph{Utility Policy Optimization} (UPO) to determine sample-specific representation capacity via \emph{Marginal Utility Allocation} (MUA). Experiments across multimodal retrieval benchmarks involving image, text, video, and audio show that sample-adaptive capacity allocation achieves overall better retrieval performance than fixed-capacity multi-vector representations, validating the effectiveness of SAMVR for multimodal retrieval. These results establish SAMVR as a viable formulation for adaptive capacity allocation in multi-vector multimodal retrieval.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 适应Embed:多式联运检索的多变量演示样本
articles.content_zh: 多媒介表述已成为多式联运检索的有效范例,代表每个样本,并配有多种互补嵌入,以获取精细的跨模式信息。 然而,现行办法通常使用固定的表示能力,为所有样本分配同样数量的矢量,而不论其个别检索需求如何。 这种固定容量的配制忽视了这样一个事实,即不同的样品可能需要不同数量的表示能力才能有效检索。 在这项工作中,我们引入\emph{样本-多变量代表}(SAMVR),这是一个用于多模式检索的新问题设置,研究如何在样本一级分配多变量代表能力. 在SAMVR下,每个样本由一个\emph{content-adaptive 嵌入集}(CAES)来表示,其容量根据额外表示矢量的样本特定检索用途来确定. 为了即时化的SAMVR,我们提出\emph{AdaptiveEmbed},一个学习样本适应性多媒介表达的统一框架. 适应Embed通过\emph{多组对比学习}(MGCL)与对称\emph{set-set-set-set相似性}(SetSim)学习结构化的多变量表达方式,并进一步使用\emph{功能政策优化}(UPO)通过\emph{Marginal Utility Group}(MUA)确定特定样本表达能力. 跨越涉及图像、文字、视频和音频的多式联运检索基准的实验表明,样本适应能力分配比固定容量的多载体表示实现总体更好的检索性能,验证了SAMVR对多式联运检索的有效性。 这些结果将SAMVR确定为在多媒介多式联运检索中进行适应能力分配的一种可行方案。

articles.title: Token-Oriented Semantic Communication with Pretrained Vision Transformers
articles.content: Token communications realize the semantic communication principle at the granularity of transformer tokens, providing a promising direction for client--server collaborative inference in resource-constrained edge systems. However, directly transmitting token embeddings presents two practical challenges: substantial communication cost and limited interoperability across model-specific token embedding spaces. To address these challenges, we propose a \emph{token-oriented} semantic communication framework. In this framework, token-level task relevance determines which compressed image latents are transmitted, enabling token-granular transmission without directly transmitting token embeddings. The framework is modular, coordinating three pretrained components---a lightweight client-side vision transformer (ViT), a learned image compression (LIC) model, and a large server-side ViT---without end-to-end training. The key enabler is the one-to-one spatial alignment between ViT patch tokens and the LIC latent vectors, which allows token-level task relevance to directly determine which latent vectors are transmitted. Building on this alignment, token-aligned LIC selectively transmits task-relevant latents, layer-selective attention rollout estimates token relevance from a selected range of attention layers in a single forward pass, and surrogate token substitution adapts the frozen server model by optimizing a single learnable token. Experiments on ImageNet show that the proposed framework achieves a more favorable rate--accuracy trade-off than recent semantic communication schemes, hand-crafted codecs, and task-agnostic LIC models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Token- Oriented 语义学与预训视觉变形器的交流
articles.content_zh: Token通信在变速器符号的颗粒性上实现了语义通信原理,为客户端-服务器在资源约束的边缘系统中的合作推论提供了有希望的方向. 然而,直接传送信使嵌入带来了两个实际挑战:通信费用高昂,以及模型专用信使嵌入空间之间的互操作性有限。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了一个\emph{面向语义的交流框架。 在这个框架中,符号级的任务关联性决定了哪些压缩图像潜伏物被传输,使得符号角传输不直接传输符号嵌入. 框架是模块化的,协调三个预先训练的组件——一个轻量级客户端视觉变压器(ViT),一个学习过的图像压缩(LI)模型,以及一个大型的服务器侧ViT——没有端到端训练. 关键使能器是ViT补丁令牌和LIC潜在矢量之间的一对一空间对接,这使得令牌级任务相关,可以直接确定哪些潜在矢量被传输. 基于这种对齐,符号对齐的LIC有选择地传递与任务相关的潜质,层选择性的注意力展开估计从单个前传的选定关注层中象征性的关联性,代位符号替代通过优化单个可学习的符号来调整被冻结的服务器模型. 在ImageNet上的实验显示,拟议的框架比最近的语义通信计划、手工编译的编码和任务不可知的LIC模型,实现了更优惠的速率精确权衡。

articles.title: PIVOT: A Multi-Trajectory Dataset and Testbed for Pose, Intrinsics, and Novel Viewpoint Evaluation in Real-World 3D Reconstruction
articles.content:
Neural radiance fields (NeRFs), 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), and related novel-view synthesis methods are commonly evaluated under capture and reconstruction conditions cleaner than those encountered by robots, drones, and autonomous systems. Benchmarks often rely on reconstruction-friendly trajectories, optimized camera poses and intrinsics, and held-out views sampled from trajectories represented during training. These assumptions can obscure performance with measured poses, reusable camera calibration, and structurally different camera paths.
  We introduce PIVOT (Pose, Intrinsics and Viewpoint Oriented Testbed), a multi-trajectory dataset, processing pipeline, and evaluation framework for independently studying these factors. PIVOT captures each scene using diverse camera trajectories and retains, where available, both sensor-derived measured poses and COLMAP-optimized poses, together with calibrated and optimized camera intrinsics. It defines three benchmark families: (1) seen versus unseen trajectory novel-view generalization, (2) measured versus optimized pose sensitivity, and (3) calibrated versus optimized intrinsics sensitivity. We also introduce a directed pose-space Chamfer distance to quantify how well training poses cover an evaluation trajectory.
  PIVOT v1 contains five real-world scenes captured with a DJI Mini 4 Pro and provides an open processing and Nerfstudio-based evaluation toolchain. Benchmark results show a consistent quality gap between held-out views on represented trajectories and unseen trajectories, as well as substantial sensitivity to pose source and camera intrinsics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PIVOT: Pose、 Intrinsics 和 Real-World 3D 小说视图评价的多轨数据集和测试台 重建
articles.content_zh:
与机器人、无人机和自主系统相比,通常在较清洁的捕捉和重建条件下对神经辐射场(NERFs)、3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)以及相关的小说视野合成方法进行评估。 基准往往依赖有利于重建的轨迹、最佳照相机的姿势和内在特征,以及从培训期间代表的轨迹中抽取的搁置观点。 这些假设可以用测量的姿势,可重复使用的相机校准,以及结构上不同的相机路径来模糊性能.
我们引入了PIVOT(Pose, Intrinsics and Viewpoint Oriented Testbed),这是一个多轨数据集,处理管道,以及独立研究这些因素的评价框架. PIVOT利用不同的相机轨迹捕捉每个场景,并在有的情况下保留传感器衍生的测量姿势和COLMAP优化姿势,以及校准和优化的相机内在形式. 它定义了三个基准家族:(1) 所见轨迹与未见的小说-观点概括,(2) 所测与优化的姿势敏感性,(3) 校准与优化的内在敏感性. 我们还引入了定向姿势空间Chamfer距离,以量化培训对评价轨迹的影响。
PIVOT v1包含用DJI Mini 4 Pro捕获的五个现实世界场景,并提供开放处理和基于Nerfstudio的评价工具链. 基准结果表明,对所表现的轨迹的持有观点与不可见的轨迹之间始终存在质量差距,而且对形成源头和相机内在的高度敏感性。

articles.title: Efficient Training with Foresight: Multi-Token Auxiliary Supervision for Autoregressive Image Generation
articles.content: Autoregressive (AR) image generation has shown strong potential for scalable high-fidelity synthesis by modeling images as discrete token sequences. However, traditional next token prediction (NTP) continues to suffer from sparse and myopic supervision, insufficiently discriminative representations, and high training cost caused by dense computation over the full token sequence. To address these issues, we propose multi-token autoregressive (MTAR), a unified training framework that improves autoregressive image generation from three aspects: prediction objectives, representation regularization, and training efficiency. Specifically, MTAR introduces multi-token prediction (MTP) to alleviate the sparsity and myopia of traditional NTP by imposing joint supervision on multiple future tokens; employs token-level contrastive regularization (TCR) to explicitly enhance the separability of sampled token representations and thereby improve representation discriminability; and incorporates semantic dropping (SD) as a semantics-aware training acceleration strategy to reduce redundant computation on low-information tokens while preserving informative learning signals. All three components are applied only during training and introduce no additional overhead during autoregressive inference. On ImageNet, MTAR achieves a better balance between generation quality and training efficiency. Compared with LlamaGen, MTAR achieves up to 0.95 lower FID and 39\% faster training. Moreover, even with only 1/3 of the training iterations, it still attains performance comparable to or better than the baseline, substantially reducing training time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有前瞻性的高效培训:自动回转图像生成的多托肯辅助监督
articles.content_zh: 自动递归(AR)图像生成通过将图像作为离散的符号序列进行模型化,显示出强大的可伸缩性高真性合成潜力. 然而,传统的下一个标志性预测(NTP)继续受到很少和微弱的监督,缺乏充分的差别性表述,以及密集计算整个标志性序列造成的高培训费用。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用多键自动递减(MTAR),这是一个统一的培训框架,从预测目标、代表性规范化和培训效率这三个方面改进自动递减图像生成。 具体来说,MTAR引入了多键预测(MTP),通过对多个未来符号实施联合监管来缓解传统NTP的痉挛和肌萎缩;采用符号级对比性规范化(TCR),以明确增强被抽样的符号表示的可分离性,从而增强表达的差别性;并纳入语义投放(SD)作为语义意识培训加速策略,以减少对低信息符号的冗余计算,同时保留信息性学习信号. 所有这三个部分仅在培训期间适用,在自动推论期间不增加间接费用。 在ImageNet上,MTAR在生成质量和培训效率之间实现了更好的平衡. 与LlamaGen相比,MTAR实现了高达0.95的低FID和39QQ的快速训练. 此外,即使只有三分之一的培训周期,它仍能达到与基线相当或更好的业绩,从而大大减少了培训时间。

articles.title: PlanSightRAG: A Visual-First Multimodal RAG for Automating Question Answering and Compliance Checking for Civil Standard Plans
articles.content: Civil infrastructure compliance checking has long relied on engineers manually reading legacy 2D plans; however, OCR-based automation strips away the geometry and layout essential for interpreting these plans. We present a Visual-First Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework called PlanSightRAG. It indexes and reasons directly over plan imagery, integrates a ColNomic-3B multi-vector retrieval, an agentic Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer, and MaxSim heatmaps as an evidence trail. We introduce a 4,056-pair benchmark from five state Departments of Transportation (DOT) standard plans (1,898 pages). PlanSightRAG achieves 91.47% Recall@5 on zero-shot retrieval, while on a held-out Michigan DOT corpus, it achieves 91.40%. On synthetic, parametrically-generated compliance drawings, our Qwen2.5-VL-72B pipeline reaches 100% verdict accuracy only when supplied a pre-resolved rule threshold, a controlled ceiling that a non-VLM OCR baseline already reaches at 76.4%. Finally, we demonstrate autonomous visual rule-grounding by extracting numeric limits directly from a specification corpus without any human-supplied rules.
