articles.title_zh: PlanSightRAG:用于公民标准计划自动化问答和合规检查的视觉-第一多式联运RAG
articles.content_zh: 民用基础设施合规性检查长期以来依靠工程师手动阅读遗留的2D计划;然而,基于OCR的自动化脱去解释这些计划所必需的几何和布局. 我们提出了一个名为PlanSightRAG的视觉-第一多式联运检索增强型(RAG)框架。 它直接在计划图像上索引和原因,整合了ColNomic-3B多向量检索器,代理计划器-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer,以及MaxSim热图作为证据线索. 我们从五个州交通部的标准计划(1 898页)中引入了4 056页的基准。 PlanSightRAG在零镜头检索上实现了91.47%的Recall@5,而在被搁置的密歇根DOT仪上,它实现了91.40%. 在合成的,参数生成的遵守图纸上,我们的Qun2.5-VL-72B输油管只有在提供预先解规则阈值时才达到100%的判定精度,这个控制上限非VLM OCR基线已经达到76.4%. 最后,我们通过直接从一个没有人类提供规则的规格中提取数字限制来展示自主的视觉规则基础。

articles.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents
articles.content: Collective intelligence can emerge when individuals coordinate through a shared environment, allowing local actions to accumulate into durable social organization. Language-model agents offer a new substrate for this process, yet most multi-agent systems rely on direct conversation, predefined roles, or centralized workflows. It remains unclear whether decentralized agents can build functional technologies and outperform independent search. Here, initially homogeneous LLM agents in SwarmWorld self-organize without assigned roles or recipes into evolving technological societies. Agents explore a spatial environment, process resources, test materials, construct persistent artifacts, and write executable controllers evaluated by a deterministic simulator under unseen disturbances after the agents are removed. SwarmWorld splits cognition from consequence: agents propose architectures and controllers within fixed action and material schemas, while the simulated world determines function. Shared societies develop broader, more resilient technological portfolios than a strong best-of-N isolated-search baseline, although isolated search remains competitive for the strongest artifact. Agents differentiate into exploration, construction, maintenance, and coordination behaviors, transitioning as the world matures. Technologies accumulate through collaborative construction, executable inheritance, and persistent agent-artifact networks, with most reuse beginning through physical observation rather than communication. Explicit cultural mechanisms amplify collaboration and organization, but functional benefits depend on outcome and timescale. Physical stigmergy alone supports capable societies, while interaction drives persistent technological ecologies rather than universally superior individual inventions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SwarmWorld:语言模型代理人社会中的尖端技术演变
articles.content_zh: 当个人通过共同的环境进行协调,使地方行动能够积累到持久的社会组织中时,集体智能就可以出现. 语言模型代理为这个过程提供了一个新的基底,然而大多数多代理系统依赖于直接对话,预先定义的角色,或集中的工作流程. 仍然不清楚的是,分散的代理人是否能够建立功能技术,超越独立搜索。 在这里,SwarmWorld最初的同质LLM代理在没有指定角色或配方的情况下自行组织,进入不断发展的技术社会. 代理商探索空间环境,处理资源,测试材料,构建持久性文物,并在物剂被移除后,在隐蔽扰动下,写出一个确定模拟器评估的可执行控制器. SwarmWorld将认知从结果中分解:代理在固定动作和材料计划内提出架构和控制器,而模拟世界则决定功能. 共享的社会比最强的N型零星搜索基线发展范围更广、更具复原力的技术组合,尽管孤立的搜索仍然对最强文物具有竞争力。 代理人区分了探索、建筑、维护和协调行为,随着世界的成熟而转变。 技术通过合作建设、可执行的继承和持久性的物剂工艺网络积累,大多数再利用是通过物理观察而不是通信开始的。 明确的文化机制扩大了合作和组织,但功能效益取决于成果和时间尺度。 仅靠物理结构就支持有能力的社会,而互动则推动持久的技术生态,而不是普遍优越的个人发明。

articles.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
articles.content: Test-time scaling uses extra test-time compute to improve performance, such as letting language models reason longer when solving a problem. As models keep the entire reasoning trace in memory via full attention, hard tasks that need long thinking can be prohibitively expensive. However, we find most intermediate reasoning tokens lose importance as the model continues reasoning. This calls into question whether retaining them is worth the cost. Based on this insight, we propose Prefix Sliding, which discards tokens during reasoning that are not part of the prefix or the window of the last few thousand tokens. The prefix has key instructions and tools available to the model, while the most recent tokens are the current reasoning the model is working on. This caps the total memory requirement regardless of how long the model reasons, allowing for efficient long-horizon test-time scaling. Without training, Prefix Sliding can make existing models 3x faster while maintaining performance. Training with Prefix Sliding using reinforcement learning can achieve better performance by enabling scaling to reasoning traces beyond a hundred thousand tokens. Ablations show Prefix Sliding outperforms summarizing intermediate tokens or vanilla sliding window. Our code is at https://github.com/Muennighoff/prefix-sliding
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效测试时间缩放的前缀滑动
articles.content_zh: 测试时间缩放使用额外的测试时间计算来提高性能,比如让语言模型在解决问题时更长时间地理性. 由于模型通过充分关注将整个推理追踪在记忆中,需要长时间思考的艰巨任务可能过于昂贵. 然而,我们发现大多数中间推理符号随着模型继续推理而失去重要性. 这令人怀疑保留这些资产是否值得付出代价。 基于这种洞察力,我们提出"前缀滑动"(Prefix Sliding),在推理过程中丢弃不属于前缀或最后几千个符号的窗口中的符号. 前缀有可供模型使用的关键指令和工具,而最新的符号是模型正在工作的当前推理. 这为总的内存要求封顶,无论模型原因有多长,都允许高效的长视距测试时间缩放. 没有训练,前缀滑翔可以在保持性能的同时,使现有的型号3x更快. 利用强化学习进行前缀滑行训练,可以使推理的痕迹超过10万个符号,从而实现更好的性能. 缩写显示 Prefix Sliding overperforms 总结中间符号或香草滑动窗口. 我们的代码在https://github.com/Muennighoff/prefix-sliding上

articles.title: Fine-Tuning Whisper for Automatic Speech Recognition in Baniwa: A Preliminary Study
articles.content: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technologies have achieved remarkable performance in recent years through the use of large multilingual foundation models. However, most advances remain concentrated on high-resource languages, while indigenous languages continue to suffer from a lack of speech resources and language technologies. This work presents a preliminary study on the adaptation of Whisper for Automatic Speech Recognition in Baniwa, an indigenous Arawakan language spoken in Brazil, Colombia, and Venezuela. The experiments were conducted using a corpus of 1,373 manually transcribed recordings obtained from a linguistic documentation project. The corpus contains approximately 0.54 hours of speech and consists primarily of isolated words and short elicited utterances. The Whisper Small model was fine-tuned using supervised learning and evaluated using Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER). The best model achieved a WER of 37.5% and a CER of 7.45%, demonstrating that multilingual foundation models can be successfully adapted to extremely low-resource indigenous languages. The results establish an initial baseline for Baniwa Automatic Speech Recognition and provide a foundation for future research involving larger datasets, language-specific adaptation strategies, and post-processing techniques.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 班尼瓦语自动语音识别精益通听:初步研究
articles.content_zh: 近年来,通过使用大型多语种基础模型,自动语音识别(ASR)技术取得了显著成绩. 然而,大部分进展仍然集中在高资源语言上,而土著语言仍然缺乏语言资源和语言技术。 这项工作对巴西、哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉使用的土著阿拉瓦坎语巴尼瓦语 " 自动语音识别之声 " 进行了初步研究。 进行实验时使用了从一个语言文件项目中获取的1 373个手动转录的录音。 教程包含约0.54个小时的言论,主要包括孤立的言语和简短的言论。 Whisper Small模型通过有监督的学习进行了微调,并使用词错误率(WER)和字符错误率(CER)进行了评价. 最佳模式实现了37.5%的WER和7.45%的CER,表明多语种基础模式可以成功地适应资源极其低的土著语言。 结果为Baniwa自动语音识别确定了初步基线,并为今后涉及较大数据集、语言适应战略和处理后技术的研究奠定了基础。

articles.title: $R^3$: Training Robots to Reason in Natural Language via Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Reasoning in language allows foundation models to spend more test-time compute on hard problems, such as those requiring decomposition, constraint tracking, and prediction of future consequences. Whether this mechanism can improve robotic manipulation remains unclear, where long-horizon tasks require tracking partial progress, reasoning about object relations, recovering from mistakes, and steering noisy low-level policies. In this paper, we study whether VLMs can be trained to reason directly in natural language to guide low-level manipulation policies. We introduce $R^3$, a simple post-training recipe that turns off-the-shelf VLMs into robotic reasoners: it first mid-trains a VLM on expert-generated reasoning traces to initialize the desired reasoning style, then improves the reasoner with single-step rubric-based RL from offline action data. Unlike prior robotic reasoning methods that mostly use structured traces as auxiliary supervision, $R^3$ trains free-form language reasoning to produce test-time guidance for action. We instantiate $R^3$ on Language Table and simulated bimanual grocery packing, two controlled testbeds for studying robotic reasoning and long-horizon manipulation. $R^3$ improves exploration and generalization across unseen tasks and significantly outperforms instruction-only imitation learning baselines on both benchmarks. Our analyses suggest that free-form language reasoning can function as a test-time compute mechanism for steering low-level policies. Our project page is available at https://robotic-reasoner.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 3美元:通过强化学习培训自然语言方面的机器人
articles.content_zh: 语言上的理由可以使基础模型在硬性问题上花费更多的测试时间计算,如需要分解,约束跟踪,以及对未来后果的预测. 这种机制是否能够改进机器人操纵仍然不清楚,因为长远任务需要跟踪部分进展,对对象关系的推理,从错误中恢复,并指导吵闹的低层政策. 在本文中,我们研究VLM是否可以接受自然语言的直接推理训练,以指导低层次的操纵政策. 我们引入了$R^3$,一种简单的训练后食谱,将现成的VLM关闭为机器人理性器:它首先在专家生成的推理痕迹上通过一个VLM来初始化所期望的推理风格,然后通过离线动作数据来改进基于单步路标的RL的推理器. 与之前大多使用结构化痕迹作为辅助监理的机器人推理方法不同,$R^3$列车自由形式语言推理,生成测试时间指导用于行动. 模拟双人杂货包装、两个用于研究机器人推理和长视距操纵的控制试验床。 3雷亚尔改进了对未见任务的探索和概括,并大大超过了两个基准上仅学习教学的基线。 我们的分析表明,自由形式的语言推理可以作为指导低层次政策的测试时间计算机制。 我们的项目网页可在https://robotic-reasoner.github.io/上查阅。

articles.title: How Much Rank Does LoRA Need? Rank-Error Bounds for Transformer Attention
articles.content: Choosing the rank of a low-rank adaptation (LoRA) update is usually an empirical task. In this paper, we provide a task-dependent theory of the approximation error achievable at each LoRA rank for Transformer attention. We fix a pretrained attention head, a target attention function, and a distribution over inputs from the downstream task, and bound the smallest expected Kullback--Leibler (KL) error achievable by a rank-$r$ query LoRA update. When target attention probabilities are bounded away from zero, we prove a lower bound of the error proportional to $ψ(\|d\|_2)$, where $d$ is the difference between candidate and target attention scores and $ψ(t)=\min\{t^2,t\}$. We also prove an unconditional upper bound $\min\{\|d\|_2^2/4,\sqrt2\|d\|_2\}$. Under explicit realizability, geometry, and moment conditions, we then bound the best rank-$r$ error between an explicit multiple of $ψ(\sqrt{T_r})$ and $\min\{T_r/4,\sqrt{2T_r}\}$, where $T_r$ is the downstream-weighted tail energy of the target update. We also provide target-Fisher bounds when candidate scores remain within a fixed range of the target scores, and an unrestricted lower bound when a subset of tokens carries most of the probability mass. These spectral bounds describe finite-score approximation. We then construct explicit families in which softmax saturation makes the rank required to match the attention function strictly smaller than the rank required to match the finite logits. Finally, we extend the analysis to fused multi-head LoRA and joint query/key updates, exposing the effects of rank sharing and query/key factorization constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 洛拉需要多少军衔? 变形器注意级别错误
articles.content_zh: 选择低级适应(LORA)更新的级别通常是一种经验性的任务. 在本文中,我们提供了一个关于每个LORA级别上可实现的近似误差的任务依赖理论,用于变形器的注意. 我们固定一个预先训练的注意头,一个目标注意功能,以及从下游任务中输入的分布,并将最小的预期的Kullback-Leibler(KL)错误绑定起来,通过一个级别-$查询LORA更新可以实现. 当目标注意力概率被限制在零之外时,我们证明误差的下限是按美元(\|d\|_2)的比例,其中美元是候选人和目标注意力分数与美元(t)的差数。 我们还证明了一个无条件的上限 $\ mind ^2^2/4,\sqrt2\|d\|_2\}$。 在明确可实现性、几何和瞬间条件下,我们再将$\(\sqrt{T_r})美元和$\min\T_r/4、\sqrt{2T_r}\}$之间的最优级-美元差错约束在目标更新的下游加权尾能量之间。 我们还在考生的分数保持在目标分数的固定范围内时提供目标-Fisher的界限,在某一个符号子集携带大部分概率质量时提供不受限制的下界限. 这些光谱界限描述的是有限分数近似. 然后,我们构建了显性家族,其中软马克斯饱和度使注意功能的等级严格小于有限对数所需的等级。 最后,我们扩大分析范围,将多头LORA和联合查询/键更新纳入引信,暴露出分级共享和查询/键要素化限制的影响。

articles.title: Trace Integrity for LLM Data Agents: A Vision for Auditable Structured Reasoning in Real-World Systems
articles.content: Answer accuracy is an insufficient reliability signal for LLM data agents. In structured-data tasks, a benchmark-correct answer can be produced by an invalid trace. This paper introduces Trace Integrity, a deployment reliability criterion for evaluating whether the computation recorded behind an answer is explicit, executable, schema-valid, operator-faithful, replayable, answer-consistent, and auditable. We identify the Structure Gap as the deployment failure mode that makes Trace Integrity necessary: natural-language reasoning and free-form rationales do not reliably specify the operator-level programs required by real-world systems. We operationalize Trace Integrity with execution contracts, structured artifacts that bind user intent to schema elements, operator plans, assumptions, executable queries, verification status, and final-answer linkage. We also introduce CAIT (Correct Answer / Invalid Trace) Rate, which measures how often answer-only evaluation counts computationally unsupported outputs as successes. In an empirical demonstration on BIRD Mini-Dev, Direct SQL, Operation Summary + SQL, and Contract-First SQL achieve answer accuracies of 20%, 22%, and 24%, while their Trace Integrity Pass Rates are 39%, 43%, and 40% and their CAIT Rates remain high at 55%, 59.1%, and 45.8%, showing that answer accuracy, trace validity, and silent-failure risk are distinct evaluation signals. Real-world LLM data agents should, therefore, be evaluated not only by whether their outputs match a reference answer, but by whether those outputs are backed by auditable computation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 跟踪 LLM 的完整性 数据代理:真实世界系统中可审计结构的构想
articles.content_zh: 对LLM数据代理来说,答案精度是一个不充分的可靠性信号. 在结构化的数据任务中,可以通过无效的跟踪生成一个基准正确答案. 本文介绍了 Trace Guide,这是用于评估一个答案背后记录的计算是否明确、可执行、有计划、有操作员诚信、可重复播放、符合答案和可审计性的部署可靠性标准。 我们把结构漏洞确定为部署失败模式,使得 Trace Guide 变得必要:自然语言推理和自由形式推理无法可靠地指定现实世界系统所需要的操作员级程序. 我们以执行合同,结构化的文物,将用户的意图与计划、操作者计划、假设、可执行查询、核查状况和最后回答的联系联系在一起。 我们还采用了 CAIT(校正回答/无效追踪) 比率,该比率衡量只回答评价在计算上将无支持的产出算作成功。 在BIRD Mini-Dev, Direct SQL, Operation Summary + SQL, 和 Contract-First SQL 的实证演示中, 解答率达到 20%, 22%, 24%, 而他们的 Trace完整性通过率是 39%, 43%, 40% 及其 CAIT 率仍然很高, 分别为 55%, 59.1%和 45.8%, 显示答案准确度, 微量有效性, 和无声故障风险是不同的评价信号 。 因此,不仅应评价其产出是否符合参考答案,而且应评价这些产出是否得到可审计计算的支持。

articles.title: Beyond Local Surprise: Grounded Dialogue as Selective Belief Revision under Referential Uncertainty
articles.content: When a speaker refers to a scene that the listener cannot directly see, the listener must decide whether to preserve its current understanding or revise it as new utterances arrive. Many language systems treat local mismatch as a cue for updating: divergence from the current understanding encourages adjustment. Yet conversational understanding may be more conservative, interpreting mismatching evidence relative to prior understanding rather than immediately revising it. We introduce a controlled, data-driven framework for turn-by-turn preserve/revise decisions in dialogue, where competing revision policies are learned under otherwise identical conditions. We compare four theory-driven revision strategies, each reflecting a different assumption about when listeners should preserve or revise. Two findings stand out. First, a mismatch-driven policy that updates solely based on local divergence reacts strongly to mismatch but destabilizes grounding and degrades retrieval. Second, an uncertainty-sensitive policy extends mismatch-based updating with accumulated evidence, preserving coherent understanding while maintaining strong retrieval performance. Surprisingly, coherent understanding emerges from a counterintuitive pattern: local mismatch promotes preservation, whereas accumulated uncertainty promotes revision, suggesting that listeners maintain prior understanding despite local mismatch and revise only when uncertainty sufficiently accumulates. This pattern is consistent with conceptual pact theory.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Local Surprise:作为参考不确定性下的选择性信仰修订的基于对话
articles.content_zh: 当发言者提到听众无法直接看到的场景时,听众必须决定是保留其目前的理解还是随着新言论的到来而修改. 许多语言系统将本地错配作为更新的提示:与当前理解的分歧鼓励调整. 然而,对话理解可能比较保守,解释与先前理解不匹配的证据,而不是立即修订。 我们采用一个控制下、数据驱动的框架,以便在对话中保存/复审决定,在本来相同的条件下学习相互竞争的修订政策。 我们比较了四个理论驱动的修订策略,每个策略都反映了对听众何时应该保留或修改的不同假设. 有两个发现是突出的。 首先,完全基于本地差异进行更新的不匹配驱动政策对不匹配作出强烈反应,但破坏定位和降解检索。 第二,对不确定性敏感的政策将基于不匹配的更新与积累的证据相延伸,保持一致的理解,同时保持强大的检索性能。 令人惊讶的是,从一种反直觉模式中出现了一致的理解:局部不匹配会促进保护,而累积的不确定性会促进修订,这表明,尽管局部不匹配,但听众会保持先前的理解,只有在不确定性充分累积时才会修订. 这种模式符合概念上的协约理论.

articles.title: VISA: Agentic Self-Evolving Data Synthesis for Multimodal Instruction Following
articles.content: Multimodal instruction-following models require training data that is accurate, diverse, verifiable, and challenging. Existing synthesis pipelines typically follow a one-pass generate-and-filter paradigm, discarding feedback from failed samples, verifier outcomes, and target-model errors. We present VISA (Visual Instruction Synthesis Agent), an agentic framework that reformulates multimodal instruction synthesis as a self-evolving loop. At each round, VISA analyzes an image to filter incompatible constraints and discover new verifiable ones, samples diversity- and difficulty-aware constraint sets from persistent memory, generates candidate instructions, and verifies the resulting samples with executable tools and structured large language model judges. Failed samples trigger diagnostic-guided recovery, while accepted samples are probed against the target model to estimate difficulty. The resulting verifier signals and target-model failure profiles are written back to memory, allowing subsequent rounds to adaptively expand the constraint space, reduce template repetition, and focus on unresolved model weaknesses. The same verifier contracts further provide reward signals for reinforcement learning without a separately trained reward model. Experiments on MM-IFEval show that VISA consistently improves multimodal instruction following over strong baselines, while preserving general multimodal capability across seven public benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VISA: 多式联运指令代理自演数据合成
articles.content_zh: 采用多式联运教学模式需要准确、多样、可核查和具有挑战性的培训数据。 现有的合成管道一般遵循单通道生成和过滤模式,丢弃来自失败样品的反馈,验证结果,以及目标模型错误. 我们提出VISA(视觉指令合成剂),这是一个将多式联运指令合成重新编订为自演循环的代理框架。 在每回合,VISA分析一个图像来过滤不兼容的制约并发现新的可核查的制约,从持续内存中取样多样性和难度意识的制约集,生成候选指令,并用可执行工具和结构化的大型语言模型判断来验证所产生的样本. 失败的样本触发了诊断引导的恢复,而接受的样本则对目标模型进行探测,以估计难度. 由此产生的验证器信号和目标模型故障剖面被写回内存,允许后续的回合适应性地扩展约束空间,减少模板重复,并专注于未解决的模型弱点. 同一份核查合同进一步为强化学习提供了奖励信号,而没有经过单独培训的奖励模式。 关于MM-IFEval的实验表明,国际船舶和航天局在强有力的基线基础上不断改进多式联运指令,同时在七个公共基准中保持一般的多式联运能力。

articles.title: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework Defense against LLM Jailbreak Attacks
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit techniques such as role-playing, obfuscation, code transformation, and multi-step indirection to elicit harmful outputs. As jailbreak strategies keep emerging, defenses have proliferated in an ongoing cat-and-mouse game, yet most remain static: their safety behavior is fixed at deployment, so they cannot accumulate defensive experience or adapt to unseen strategies. We propose a self-evolving test-time defense built around a persistent, cross-interaction rule memory: when an attack succeeds, the framework abstracts that failure into a method-level rule capturing the structural attack wrapper rather than the harmful topic, and reuses it against future inputs. Because rules are method-level, one induced rule generalizes across an entire attack family, and the label space expands as novel wrappers appear. The mechanism operates entirely through external memory and prompting, with no parameter updates, and applies to both open-weight and black-box API models. We realize it as four cooperating modules, but the contribution is the memory-based adaptation mechanism, not the module decomposition. Across four black-box jailbreak families and multiple models, our method substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving benign utility, remains robust under an adaptive composite-wrapper attack, and does not increase over-refusal as the memory grows.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自我演变的多代理框架防御LLM 越狱袭击
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)仍然容易受到越狱攻击,这种攻击利用角色扮演、模糊、代码转换和多步骤间接等技术来诱导有害产出。 随着越狱策略的不断涌现,防守在一场持续的猫捉老鼠游戏中激增,然而大多数都保持静态:他们的安全行为固定在部署状态,因此他们无法积累防御经验或适应隐形策略. 我们提出一个围绕持续,交叉交互规则内存构建的自演测试时间防御:当攻击成功时,框架将失败归纳成一个方法级规则,捕捉结构攻击包而不是有害主题,再利用它来对抗未来的输入. 因为规则是方法层面的,所以一个诱导规则将整个攻击家族普遍化,随着小说包装器的出现,标签空间也扩大了. 该机制完全通过外部内存和提示来运行,没有参数更新,并同时适用于开放量级和黑盒API模型. 我们意识到它是四个合作模块,但贡献在于基于内存的适应机制,而不是模块分解. 在四个黑盒式的越狱家庭和多个模式中,我们的方法在保持良性效用的同时大幅降低了攻击成功率,在适应性复合包装器攻击下仍然强劲,并且不会随着记忆力的增长而增加过度反弹。

articles.title: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs
articles.content: Agentic LLM pipelines face escalating inference costs as context accumulates across retrieval, tool use, and multi-turn interactions. To control latency, deployments routinely compress inputs, but this degrades task accuracy. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates generation losslessly, yet it assumes the drafter and verifier share an identical context, preventing SD from resolving the accuracy-overhead trade-off. We propose AsymSpec, an asymmetric speculative decoding framework that breaks this symmetry: a lightweight drafter reads the full input while the large verifier operates on the compressed view. The drafter steers the verifier via a contrastive $δ$-fusion of logits, modulated by a divergence-aware acceptance gate that preserves verification stability and high draft acceptance rates. Evaluated across four agentic capabilities and two end-to-end agent benchmarks, AsymSpec reaches $\approx 90\%$ of full-context accuracy on average, delivering $1.3$--$1.7\times$ throughput speedups at $0.2$--$0.3\times$ the compute cost on isolated text capabilities. These results show that asymmetric context access yields substantial gains precisely when compression discards critical reasoning signals.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AsymSpec:上下文对称 代理法学硕士的光谱解码
articles.content_zh: 代理LLM输油管面临不断上升的推论成本,因为上下文在检索、工具使用和多回合相互作用之间累积。 为了控制耐久性,部署会例行压缩输入,但这会降低任务准确性. 光谱解码(SD)会毫无损失地加速生成,然而它却假设起草者和核查者有相同的上下文,使SD无法解决精度-管理头交易. 我们提出AsymSpec,一个打破这种对称性的不对称的投机解码框架:一个轻量级的起草器读取全部输入,而大验证器则在压缩视图上操作. 起草者通过对比性美元输入的对数来引导核查者,该对数由能保持核查稳定性和高草案接受率的分辨式接受门进行调制。 对四个代理能力和两个端到端代理基准进行评价后,AsymSpec平均达到约90美元全文本精度,以0.2美元至0.3美元的速度提供1.3美元至1.7美元次的吞吐速度。 这些结果表明,当压缩丢弃批判性推理信号时,不对称上下文访问就会产生很大的收益.

articles.title: Distinct dynamics of conceptual and referential disruptions in human reading and large language model processing
articles.content: Linguistic meaning is grounded in conceptual content, from which reference to particular entities emerges as words enter discourse. To examine the processing dynamics associated with these two dimensions of meaning, we selectively disrupted conceptual or referential information in short narratives and traced the resulting effects in human self-paced reading and in the predictive and representational processing of large language models. In human reading, conceptual disruptions produced a strong but localized processing cost, emerging immediately after the distorted word, reaching an early maximum, and then declining rapidly. Referential disruptions produced weaker effects, which decreased more gradually across subsequent words, and were more strongly modulated by sentence boundaries. In the language model, both disruptions emerged immediately at the manipulated word. Contextual model surprisal showed a pattern closely paralleling human reading: conceptual disruption produced a larger, more locally concentrated effect that decayed rapidly, whereas referential disruption produced a smaller and more gradual downstream effect. Output-layer representations showed a different pattern: referential disruption produced a larger initial displacement, while both distortions were subsequently characterized by power-law decay. Together, these results provide convergent evidence for distinguishable processing dynamics of two types of meaning: conceptual information imposes a more locally concentrated integration cost, whereas referential information engages a more distributed process of maintaining discourse-level identity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 人类阅读和大语言模型处理中概念和偏好中断的不同动态
articles.content_zh: 语言含义以概念内容为基础,从概念内容中,当文字进入讨论时,就会出现对特定实体的提及. 为了审查与这两个意义维度有关的处理动态,我们有选择地中断了简短叙述中的概念信息或偏好信息,并追溯由此对人类自我节奏阅读以及大语言模型的预测和代表处理的影响. 在人类阅读中,概念中断产生了强大但局部化的处理成本,在被扭曲的单词之后立即出现,达到早期最大,然后迅速下降. 引证中断产生较弱的影响,在后来的词组中逐渐减少,并被句子边界更强烈地调换. 在语言模型中,这两个中断都立即出现在被操纵的单词中. 环境模型外观显示出一种与人类阅读密切相关的模式:概念中断产生更大、更集中的局部效应,迅速衰减,而特惠中断则产生较小和更渐进的下游效应。 产出层的表述呈现出一种不同的模式:特惠干扰导致较大的初始转移,而这两种扭曲后来都以权力法衰败为特征。 这些结果共同为两类含义的可区分处理动态提供了趋同的证据:概念信息要求更集中的当地整合成本,而偏好信息则涉及更分布式的保持语境层次身份的过程.

articles.title: When Personality Meets Quantization: A Layer-wise MBTI Analysis of Quantized LLMs
articles.content: Personality is increasingly important in large language models (LLMs), as it shapes users' trust, engagement, and emotional experiences. While the Myers--Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) has emerged as a common framework for assessing LLMs' personality, existing studies focus primarily on full-precision models and evaluate only final outputs. They overlook the widespread deployment of quantized LLMs requiring low memory footprints, whose personality traits remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic MBTI analysis of open-source LLMs across multiple precisions, including mainstream 4-bit methods (GPTQ, AWQ) and extreme 2-bit settings (AQLM variants). Beyond output-level evaluation, we examine how personality emerges across layers through option-level entropy and confidence-gap dynamics, and introduce Uncertainty-Amplified Layer Decoding (UALD) to study decoding-induced personality drift at inference time. Our results reveal a key insight: LLMs' personality is not a static property, but an emergent, layer-dependent decision process sensitive to quantization, prompting, and decoding. Specifically, we find that (1) ENFJ remains dominant across model families and precisions; (2) 4-bit quantization largely preserves coarse personality structure, while 2-bit quantization disrupts fine-grained prompt consistency and cross-precision agreement; (3) personality decisions emerges in upper layers, following substantial ambiguity in early layers; and (4) inference decoding can shift personality, while personality-aligned conditioning improves robustness. These findings provide a new perspective on the behavioral reliability of quantized LLMs and highlight the importance of considering internal dynamics and inference strategies in personality-sensitive chatbot applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当个性满足量化:对量化的LLMs进行逐层的 MBTI 分析
articles.content_zh: 个性在大型语言模型(LLMs)中越来越重要,因为它塑造了用户的信任,参与和情感体验. 虽然迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标(MBTI)已成为评估LLMS个性的共同框架,但现有的研究主要侧重于全精度模型,只评价最终产出. 它们忽略了需要低记忆足迹的量化LLMs的广泛部署,其个性特征仍未得到充分的探讨。 在这项工作中,我们提出了对多种精度的开源LLMs的系统MBTI分析,包括主流4位方法(GPTQ,AWQ)和极端2位设置(AQLM变体). 除了产出层面的评价外,我们研究个性如何通过选项层面的 en和置信-gap动态层间出现,并引入不确定性-放大层解码(UALD),研究解码引发的个性在推论时间漂移. 我们的研究结果揭示了一个关键见解:LLMs的个性不是一个静态属性,而是一个对量化、催化和解码敏感的、以层为主的新兴决策过程。 具体来说,我们发现(1)ENFJ在模型家族和精度上仍然占据主导地位;(2)4位的量化在很大程度上保留了粗糙的个性结构,而2位的量化则扰乱了精细的快速一致性和交叉精度一致;(3)人格决定在上层出现,在早期的层次上出现实质性的模糊;(4)推论解码可以改变个性,而个性调和则能改善强性. 这些研究结果为量化的LLMS的行为可靠性提供了新的视角,并突出了在人格敏感的聊天器应用中考虑内部动态和推论策略的重要性.

articles.title: Lost but not erased: Finding traces of a forgotten language in neural speech models
articles.content: International adoptees retain phonological traces of a birth language they can no longer speak or comprehend, a persistence typically attributed to a biologically-timed critical period. We asked whether it could instead reflect the ordinary dynamics of learning, using automatic speech recognition models that simulate the international adoptee experience without maturational confounds. Models were trained on one language and then abruptly switched to a second. We found that traces of the first language persisted throughout second-language training, but mainly in the lowest, pre-phonemic layers. These traces were functional, as models with early exposure re-learned their lost first language 14% faster than naive models; this advantage held even against models adopted early from a related language and disappeared when the earliest layers were substituted from a non-adopted model. We argue that these critical-period effects reflect entrenchment of foundational representations rather than a maturational loss of plasticity, and that experience plays a central role in critical periods in language acquisition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 丢失但未删除 : 在神经语言模型中找到被遗忘语言的痕迹
articles.content_zh: 国际被收养者保留了他们不再能说或理解的出生语言的录音痕迹,这种持久性通常归因于一个生物时间临界期。 我们问它是否可以反映学习的通常动态,使用自动语音识别模型,模拟国际被收养者的经验,而不产生成熟的困惑。 模型接受了一种语言的培训,然后突然切换到第二种语言。 我们发现,第一语言的痕迹在第二语言培训中一直存在,但主要是在最低的、预听层。 这些痕迹是实用的,因为早期接触的模型比天真的模型快14%地重新学习了丢失的第一语言;这种优势甚至与早期从相关语言中采纳的模型相比,在未采用模型取代最早的层次时就消失了。 我们争辩说,这些关键时期的影响反映了基本代表性的巩固,而不是成熟时丧失可塑性,经验在关键时期在语言获取方面发挥着中心作用。

articles.title: Unveiling Spectral Mechanisms in Training-Free LLM Text Detection
articles.content: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish human writing from machine-generated text. Training-free detection offers a scalable solution, yet common confidence-based metrics mainly measure average token probabilities and often miss the signal fluctuations that characterize human writing, which we call "generative vitality". Spectral analysis offers a way to capture this vitality, but its mechanism and practical boundaries remain underexplored. In this paper, we analyze spectral detection from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. We connect spectral energy to variance in proxy log-probability trajectories and explain how broader human token choices create the fluctuations used by frequency-domain indicators. We further show that the strength of this signal depends on text length and sampling range: spectral evidence is clearest for long, continuous, constrained generation, while short, fragmented, mixed, and edited settings require complementary confidence and fluctuation views. These findings clarify when frequency-domain detection works and provide guidance for future multi-dimensional detector design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在无培训的LLM中无限制的光谱机制 文本检测
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)的迅速进步使得人书写与机器生成的文本越来越难以区分. 无训练检测提供了一个可伸缩的解决方案,然而共同的基于信心的度量标准主要衡量平均的征兆概率,并经常错过了人类写作特征的信号波动,我们称之为"遗传活力". 光谱分析为抓住这种活力提供了一种方法,但其机制与实际界限仍然未得到充分探讨。 在本文中,我们从理论和经验的角度分析光谱检测. 我们把光谱能量与代理日志概率轨迹的差异联系起来,并解释更广泛的人类符号选择如何制造频率域指标所使用的波动. 我们进一步表明,这一信号的强度取决于文本长度和采样范围:光谱证据对于长、连续、受限的生成最为清楚,而短、零散、混合和编辑的设置则需要补充信心和波动观点。 这些发现澄清了频率域探测何时起作用,并为未来的多维探测器设计提供了指导.

articles.title: One Symptom, Three Levers: A Critical Review of On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.content: On-policy distillation trains a language model on its own generations while a teacher scores them token by token. It combines the dense supervision of imitation learning with the on-policy sampling of reinforcement learning. But it requires a second, larger model to act as teacher. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) removes that cost. The teacher is the model itself, conditioned on privileged information the student will not have at test time, such as a reference solution, a plan, or environment feedback. The teacher is no stronger than the student, only better informed. Early results were promising, with accuracy comparable to reinforcement learning at a fraction of the generated tokens. But the same asymmetry that produces the signal also biases it. One failure mode now dominates the field: collapse, the progressive narrowing of the set of reasoning paths the model can produce. Collapse is not specific to OPSD, though privileged information aggravates it. This review treats collapse as a symptom governed by three levers: (i) where the signal is applied, that is, how tokens are weighted; (ii) what the teacher is shown, that is, the nature of the privileged information; and (iii) when the signal changes, that is, the teacher's dynamics and the decay of guidance. We restrict our scope to mathematical reasoning, where the method originated and where its failure modes are best documented. We report no new experiments. The contribution is structural: a shared vocabulary for phenomena named differently across papers, and a clear line between what is settled and what is still disputed.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个症状,三个列弗斯:对政策上自我扭曲的批判性审查
articles.content_zh: 政策蒸馏在自己的几代人身上训练一种语言模型,而老师则以象征性的方式给它们评分。 它将模仿学习的密集监督与强化学习的政策抽样相结合. 但是这需要第二个更大的模型来做教师. 政策上的自我分散可以消除这一成本。 老师是模型本身,以学生在测试时不会得到的特权信息为条件,如参考解决方案,计划,或环境反馈. 老师不比学生强,只知道更清楚. 早期的结果很有希望,准确性与在一小部分产生的符号上加强学习相当。 但产生信号的同样不对称性也使其偏差. 一个失败模式现在主导了这个领域:崩溃,逐渐缩小模型可以产生的一组推理路径. 折叠并不是OPSD所特有的,尽管特权信息使其恶化. 本评论将坍塌视为由三种杠杆调节的症状:(一)信号的应用地点,即符号的加权方式; (二)老师显示的是什么,即特权信息的性质; (三)信号改变时,即老师的动态和引导的衰变. 我们仅限于数学推理,方法的起源地和它的失败模式的最好文献记录. 我们没有报告新的实验。 其贡献是结构性的:对不同论文中不同命名的现象有共同的词汇,在已解决的事项和尚有争议的事项之间有明确的界线.

articles.title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
articles.content: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining the reasoning and coding capabilities of language models with the generative priors of video models. A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state and perform rule-consistent evolution. To connect executable state with visual generation, we introduce a proxy representation that encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video, which conditions a video model to render high-fidelity visual observations. We further develop data pipelines for constructing aligned proxy-observation pairs from gameplay and real-world videos. After fine-tuning on paired gameplay data, MiniMax-H3 follows proxy-based spatiotemporal specifications from simple interactive worlds built by the coding agent while preserving rich visual details and dynamics. These results demonstrate the potential of combining code for persistent world evolution with video models for flexible visual realization, providing a new path toward open-ended world models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代码世界模型:作为世界大脑的编码代理
articles.content_zh: 世界模型旨在模拟复杂环境在行动和事件下是如何演变的,然而现有的基于视频的世界模型主要是从视觉观测中学习动态,这些动态揭示的是结果,而不是指导世界演变的基本知识、规则和机制。 这使得难以保持持续的后果,也难以支持连贯、无限制的发展。 我们引入了代码世界模型(Code World Model),这个框架通过将语言模型的推理和编码能力与视频模型的基因前传相结合,将世界进化与视觉实现区分开来. 编码剂充当世界大脑,对事件及其后果进行推理,并生成可执行代码,以维持持续的世界状态,并进行符合规则的演化. 为了将可执行状态与视觉生成连接起来,我们引入了一种代理表示,它编码了帧式的spatiotemporal约束,并被编译成代理视频,它以视频模型为条件来制作高真实性的视觉观察. 我们进一步发展数据管道,从游戏和现实世界视频中构建对齐的代理观测对. 在对配对的游戏游戏数据进行微调后,MiniMax-H3遵循了来自编码代理构建的简单互动世界的基于代理的spatiotopal规格,同时保留了丰富的视觉细节和动态. 这些结果表明,将持续世界演变的代码与视频模型结合起来以灵活视觉实现的潜力,提供了通往开放世界模型的新途径。

articles.title: Formal, Executable and Explainable Runtime Monitoring of Spoken Air Traffic Control Operational Procedures
articles.content: Air traffic control procedures are executed through spoken exchanges between controllers and pilots. These interactions are essential to the safety of air transportation: failures in their execution can create severe operational hazards, as evidenced by past fatal accidents. Assessing whether an instruction has been followed requires relating what was said to the aircraft concerned, its state, and the obligations that pilots must meet. We present a runtime verification framework that monitors such procedures by checking controller-pilot exchanges, surveillance data, and onboard observations. The framework parses radio communications into events linked to the entities they concern and merges them with surveillance and onboard observations into a time-stamped trace. The ICAO-derived obligations as formalized as temporal formulas with explicit time bounds and evaluated over execution traces. Every violation is reported along with the breached obligations and the observations that support the verdict. With real traffic, the complete pipeline reaches an F1 of 0.85 against blind human-annotated violations; in 1,495 synthetic situations derived from two public corpora, the monitor logic returns the expected verdict in every case. In two historical accidents reconstructed from official investigation reports, the monitor identifies the same procedural deviations documented by the investigators.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 正式、可执行和可解释的空中交通管制操作程序运行时间监测
articles.content_zh: 空中交通管制程序通过控制员和飞行员之间的口头交流执行. 这些互动对空运安全至关重要:如以往的致命事故所证明的那样,若未能执行这些互动,就会造成严重的行动危险。 评估一项指示是否得到遵守,需要涉及对有关飞机所说的话、其状况以及飞行员必须履行的义务。 我们提出了一个运行时间核查框架,通过检查控制器-飞行员交换、监视数据和机上观察来监测这些程序。 该框架将无线电通信分为与其所涉实体相关的事件,并将其与监视和机上观测合并成一个时间标记的跟踪。 民航组织衍生的义务形式为时间公式,具有明确的时限并对执行痕迹进行评估。 每项违反行为以及违反的义务和支持判决的意见都得到报告。 随着实际流量的增加,整条输油管达到了0.85的F1,针对盲目的人为附加说明的侵权行为;在1,495个人工合成情况下,从两个公共公司衍生出来的监控逻辑返回每个案件中的预期判决. 在根据官方调查报告重建的两起历史事故中,监测员查明了调查人员记录的相同程序偏差。

articles.title: Query-Side Attacks on GNN-Based KGQA: Tracing Failures from Entity Linking to Answer Generation
articles.content: GNN-based Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) pipelines process queries through four discrete stages: entity linking, subgraph retrieval, GNN reasoning, and answer generation. Standard robustness evaluations conflate stage-level failures into a single end-to-end metric, obscuring both the source of brittleness and the appropriate mitigation target. We ask which stage fails, and why, when the pipeline is subjected to adversarial perturbations on the input question. We introduce a stage-isolation protocol with two answer-preserving adversarial perturbations verified against the knowledge graph: Compositional Restructuring (CR) and Relation Synonym Swap (RS) target distinct stages while leaving entity seeds intact. Evaluated across ComplexWebQuestions and WebQSP, the results run counter to prevailing assumptions: the GNN reasoning stage retains near-baseline accuracy when the subgraph is intact, while subgraph construction accounts for over 99\% of the end-to-end collapse under CR, occurring even when the gold answer is present in 74\% of retrieved subgraphs. This exposes a fundamental distinction between answer presence and answer reachability that end-to-end metrics cannot detect, and places the mitigation target firmly at the subgraph construction stage rather than the reasoning model. Perturbed datasets and evaluation infrastructure are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atkgrag-E85C .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对基于GNN的KGQA的查询-系统攻击:追踪实体链接到答案生成的失败
articles.content_zh: 基于GNN的知识图问答(KGQA)管道通过四个离散阶段处理查询:实体链接,子图检索,GNN推理,和答案生成. 标准稳健性评价将阶段层面的失败组合成一个单一的端到端度量度,模糊了脆性的来源和适当的缓解目标. 我们问,当管道在输入问题上受到对抗性干扰时,哪个阶段失败了,为什么? 我们采用一种阶段隔离协议,根据知识图核实两种保存答案的对抗性扰动:结构重组和关系同义词交换(RS)瞄准不同的阶段,同时使实体种子完好无损。 在整个ComplexWebQuestions和WebQSP的评价中,结果与主流假设背道而驰:当子图完好无损时,GNN推理阶段保留了近基线精确度,而子图构造则占了CR下端到端崩溃的99\%以上,即使黄金解答在74\%存在被检索子图时也会发生. 这暴露了答案存在和答案可达到性之间的根本区别,端到端的度量衡无法检测,并将缓解目标牢固地置于子图构建阶段,而不是推理模型. 在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atkgrag-E85C上发布扰动数据集和评价基础设施 。 。 。

articles.title: SAMpLE: A SystemC-AMS Machine LEarning-based Framework for Virtual Prototyping
articles.content: Machine Learning (ML) is increasingly used in virtual prototypes of embedded systems to model behaviors that are difficult to capture analytically. However, integrating ML models into virtual platform simulation is still typically done through ad hoc solutions, which limits reuse, comparability, and reproducibility. This paper presents \textbf{\textit{SAMpLE}}, an open-source SystemC-AMS-based framework that integrates ML models as first-class Timed Dataflow (TDF) components through a standardized plug-and-play interface. SAMpLE provides two execution backends: a native C++ backend for online training of lightweight models, and an offline backend for executing externally developed models without requiring re-implementation in C++ or manual integration steps. The framework uses ONNX as a standard model exchange format to enable integration of externally trained ML models into SystemC-AMS simulations, and allows the evaluation of different ML-based solutions within the same testbench, dataset, and simulation workflow. The modular design and unified and reproducible environment will allow future extensions of SAMpLE to new models, without modifying the SystemC-AMS structure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 系统助理 基于机器的虚拟原型框架
articles.content_zh: 机器学习(ML)越来越多地用于嵌入式系统的虚拟原型,用于模拟难以在分析上捕捉的行为. 然而,将ML模型整合到虚拟平台模拟中,通常仍然通过临时解决方案完成,这些解决方案限制了再利用,可比性,以及可复制性. 本文介绍\textbf\textit{SAMpLE}}},一个基于开放源代码SystemC-AMS的框架,通过标准化的插件和游戏接口,将ML模型集成为一流的时间数据流(TDF)组件. SAMpLE提供了两个执行后端:一个用于轻量级模型在线训练的本土C++后端,另一个用于执行外部开发的模型而无需在C++或人工集成步骤中重新执行的离线后端. 该框架使用ONNX作为标准模型交换格式,以便能够将外部培训的ML模型纳入SystemC-AMS模拟,并允许在同一测试台,数据集和模拟工作流程内评价基于ML的不同解决方案. 模块化设计以及统一和可复制的环境将允许SAMpLE未来向新模型扩展,而不修改SystemC-AMS结构.

articles.title: One Form to Transfer Them All: Pretraining Multilingual Language Models Beyond Native Orthography
articles.content: Multilingual language models transfer knowledge across languages through shared subword vocabulary, a mechanism that breaks down when related languages use different writing systems. Prior work addresses this via script equalization (romanization or IPA transcription), but direct comparisons are rare; the focus has been on encoder-only models, with most work adapting existing pretrained models. We systematically compare different input representations in autoregressive multilingual pretraining, comparing orthographic text, IPA, and romanization in a controlled setup across three scales (467M, 709M, and 1.03B) on eight languages in four typologically motivated pairs. Across a wide range of downstream tasks on seen and unseen languages, romanized pretraining yields the strongest cross-lingual transfer, and the advantage over text widens with scale. IPA improves over text in most settings but trails romanization. Surprisingly, finetuning a text-pretrained model on romanized data hurts performance on languages already covered by the base model, only marginally helping when the model lacks script coverage. Our results indicate that for multilingual models spanning typologically diverse scripts, to obtain maximum benefits, romanization should be treated as a core design choice applied at pretraining rather than a post hoc fix.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: One Form to Transfer Them All: Pretraining 多语种语言模式超越本土整形
articles.content_zh: 多语言语言模型通过共享的子词词汇来跨语言传递知识,这种机制在相关语言使用不同的书写系统时会分解. 先前的工作通过脚本均匀化(罗马化或IPA转录)来解决这个问题,但直接比较却很少见;重点一直放在只编码器的模型上,大部分工作都适应了现有的事先训练过的模型. 我们系统地比较了自递式多语种预训中不同的输入表示,比较了正体文字,IPA,以及八种语言在四种类型动机的组合中在三种尺度(467M,709M,和1.03B)的可控结构中罗马化。 在各种下游任务中,在可见和看不见的语言上,罗马化的预训产生最强的跨语言转移,对文本的优势随着规模的扩大而扩大。 投资促进机构在多数情况下改进了文本,但跟踪罗马化。 令人惊讶的是,在罗马化数据上微调一个文本预修模型会伤害到基础模型已经覆盖的语言的性能,只有在模型缺乏脚本覆盖时才略有帮助. 我们的结果表明,对于跨越类型多样的脚本的多语种模型,为了获得最大效益,罗马化应当作为在预训中应用的核心设计选择,而不是一个临时后固定.

articles.title: From Passive Response to Proactive Correction: Enhancing LLM Robustness Against Input Fact Perturbations
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce confident yet factually incorrect responses when user inputs contain misleading premises, a phenomenon we attribute to fact perturbations in the input. Existing approaches to hallucination mitigation typically assume reliable user inputs, overlooking how such factual errors can actively mislead model reasoning. To address this vulnerability, we propose DEDUCE, a three-stage framework that transforms LLMs from passive responders into proactive error correctors. DEDUCE operates in three stages: (1) detect errors through fine-grained fact extraction and verification; (2) devise correction strategies via multi perspective deliberation; and (3) correct misconceptions while delivering reliable answers. We also present MisFactQA, a dataset containing factual errors of varying degrees, and propose new metrics for evaluating model robustness. Experiments on TruthfulQA, FalseQA, and our MisFactQA benchmark demonstrate that DEDUCE significantly improves both accuracy and error correction capability. Consistent gains across Qwen, LLaMA, and Gemma families confirm its effectiveness and scalability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从被动反应到主动修正:增强LLM 强力对抗输入事实干扰
articles.content_zh: 当用户输入含有误导性前提时,大型语言模型经常产生自信但事实上不正确的反应,我们把这一现象归因于输入中的事实扰动。 现有减少幻觉的方法通常假定用户提供可靠的投入,忽略这些事实错误如何能积极误导模型推理。 为解决这一脆弱性,我们提议采用DEDUCE这一三阶段框架,将LLMs从被动反应者转变为主动纠正错误者。 DEDUCE分三个阶段运作:(1) 通过精细的事实提取和核实发现错误;(2) 通过多视角审议制定纠正战略;(3) 在提供可靠答案时纠正错误。 我们还提出MisFactQA,这是一个包含不同程度的事实错误的数据集,并提出了评价模型稳健性的新指标. 关于TrealfulQA, FalseQA的实验和我们的MisFactQA基准显示,DEDUCE大大提高了准确性和错误校正能力. Quen、LLaMA和Gemma家族的不断进步证实了其有效性和可扩展性。

articles.title: Loss-Based Active Learning for Neural Abstractive Summarization
articles.content: Fine-tuning abstractive summarization models requires high-quality annotated data. However, obtaining such corpora is expensive and time-consuming, as it requires human annotators to read and comprehend long documents to create accurate summaries. Active learning mitigates this issue by selecting only the most informative instances for annotation, allowing models to achieve competitive results with significantly fewer labels. However, the application of active learning to summarization remains under-explored, and existing studies often suffer from instability and significant computational bottlenecks. To overcome these challenges, we propose LOBSTER (LOss-BaSed acTivE leaRning), a novel active learning framework designed specifically for abstractive summarization. LOBSTER improves performance by prioritizing unlabeled instances semantically similar to the model's current high-loss training examples, enabling the model to explicitly correct its specific weaknesses. Our empirical evaluation across three benchmark datasets and two summarization backbone models demonstrates that LOBSTER consistently matches or outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches while achieving a query selection speedup of up to 665x.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于损失的神经总结活动学习
articles.content_zh: 精细的抽象归纳模型需要高质量的注释数据. 然而,获得这种公司是昂贵和费时的,因为它要求人的注释员阅读和理解长的文件,以产生准确的摘要。 积极学习减轻了这一问题,只选择了信息最丰富的注释实例,使模型能够以显著较少的标签实现竞争结果. 然而,将积极学习用于总结的做法仍然没有得到充分利用,现有的研究往往受到不稳定和重大的计算瓶颈的影响。 为了克服这些挑战,我们提出LOBSTER(Loss-BASED acTivE leaRning),这是专门为抽象归纳设计的新的积极学习框架. LOBSTER通过优先排序无标签的事件来提高性能,这些例子与模型目前的高损失培训例子非常相似,使模型能够明确纠正其具体的弱点. 我们对三个基准数据集和两个汇总主干模型的实证评价表明,LOBSTER始终匹配或超过目前最先进的方法,同时实现最多665x的查询选择速度。

articles.title: Anchoring Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Systems: Prior Scores Compromise Evaluation Independence
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly assess generated content, giving rise to the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm. These systems now score outputs, filter content, and gate iterative refinement in production pipelines, where each judgment is often assumed to be independent of earlier evaluations. We test this assumption using three prompt conditions: no metadata, revision framing, and anchored metadata containing revision, attempt, and prior-score fields. We show that prior scores, even when included only as context metadata, anchor judgments and systematically shift ratings toward their values. Across 192,000 attempted evaluations (185,271 successful), seven out of the eight evaluated models have 95% task-stratified bootstrap intervals below zero for the total anchored-metadata effect on 20 fixed texts. Cohen's $d$, a standardized measure of the difference between score distributions, reaches an absolute value of 0.71. Token-level analysis of selected model-task probes suggests a threshold-like response pattern: introducing anchored metadata produces a marked redistribution of output-score probabilities, while changing the anchor value within the tested below-threshold range produces comparatively little additional variation. On categorical industry data with human-labeled ground truth, anchored metadata blocks 48% of error corrections and flips 10.18% of correct judgments toward an assigned wrong label, demonstrating the bias extends beyond numerical scoring to categorical decisions. Neither Chain-of-Thought nor a metadata-disregard warning reduces the total effect, although the warning improves the paired accuracy effect relative to baseline in the industry experiment. Reliable LLM evaluation demands careful context engineering rather than an assumption of impartiality. Effective mitigation must be validated for the intended model and task or domain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在LLM-as-a-Judge Systems中设置比阿斯:先前的得分折中评价独立
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地评估生成的内容,从而产生了LLM-as-a-Judge范式. 这些系统现在在生产管道中评分产出、过滤内容和闸门迭代改进,其中往往假定每项判断独立于先前的评价。 我们利用三个即时条件测试这一假设:没有元数据、修订框架,以及包含修订、尝试和先前得分字段的固定元数据。 我们显示,先前的得分,即使只是作为上下文元数据列入,也支持判断,并系统地将评级转向其价值。 在192 000项尝试性评价(185 271项成功)中,8项评价模式中有7项将任务定级的靴子间隔比零低95%,对20份固定文本的总固定元数据效应。 Cohen的美元($d$),是衡量得分分配的差额的标准,达到0.71的绝对值. 对选定的模型-任务探测器的托肯级分析提出了类似阈值的响应模式:引入锚定元数据会产生输出-计分概率的显著再分配,而改变被测试的低于阈值范围内的锚定值则产生相对较少的额外差异. 在贴有人名标签的绝对行业数据上, 固定的元数据阻断了48%的错误校正, 无论是思维链还是元数据偏差的警告都无法降低总效果,尽管警告比行业实验中的基线提高了配对精度效应. 可靠的LLM评价需要认真的背景工程,而不是公正的假设. 有效的缓解措施必须针对预期的模式和任务或领域加以验证。

articles.title: Key Point Analysis Needs Structure Recovery: Task Definition, Dataset Diagnosis, and a Structure-Aware Benchmark
articles.content: Key Point Analysis (KPA) aims to identify a concise set of key points that summarize a collection of arguments together with their prevalence. We argue that KPA is fundamentally a structured prediction problem that requires recovering semantic groupings, generating representative key points, ensuring coverage, and estimating prevalence. Under this formulation, we show that existing KPA benchmarks suffer from limitations in grouping quality, redundancy, coverage, and argument-key point mappings, causing ceiling violation and selection failure in reference-based evaluation. To support future research on true KPA, we introduce a structure-aware, distribution-sensitive benchmark built via a human-in-the-loop re-annotation. Human and LLM evaluations consistently show that the resulting structures yield more coherent groupings, higher-quality key points, better coverage, and more reliable prevalence estimates than existing annotations. We further release several annotation resources to support research on KPA evaluation, argument-key point matching, explainable KPA, and LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, and outline a research agenda for true KPA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关键点分析需求结构 恢复:任务定义、数据集诊断和结构辅助基准
articles.content_zh: 关键点分析(KPA)旨在确定一套简明的关键点,总结各种论点及其普遍性。 我们认为,人民军基本上是一个结构化的预测问题,需要恢复语义分类,产生具有代表性的要点,确保覆盖面,并估计流行率。 根据这一提法,我们表明,人民军现有基准在分组质量、冗余、覆盖面和辩证点绘图方面受到限制,造成最高限值违规和参照评价的甄选失败。 为了支持今后对真正的人民军的研究,我们采用了通过人-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-在-再说明的基础上建立的结构意识、对分配敏感的基准。 人类和LLM评价始终表明,由此产生的结构比现有说明更能形成一致的分组、更高质量的关键点、更好的覆盖面和更可靠的流行率估计。 我们还发布了一些注释资源,以支持对人民军的评价、论点-关键点比对、可解释的人民军和作为法官的LLM方法的研究,并概述了真正的人民军的研究议程。

articles.title: Skill Issue: Are Skills Language-Invariant in LLMs?
articles.content: Large language models access knowledge inconsistently across languages, but to what extent do they differ in their skill sets when interacting with different languages? This work quantifies cross-lingual skill inconsistency orthogonally from knowledge and general benchmark performance. We do this via multilingual self-play: two instances of the same model compete in a text-based game, each interacting through a different language interface. Since the model, opponent, rules, state space, and available actions remain fixed, this setting isolates the effect of language on the model's realized behavior. We build a multilingual extension to TextArena and evaluate three open-weight models across eight languages and six games covering spatial reasoning, imperfect information, resource allocation, and repeated interaction. We find that the same model can exhibit markedly different playing strength across languages, with systematic variation in win--loss margins, invalid actions, and strategic tendencies. Detailed analyses reveal language-specific failures in spatial reasoning, card-conditioned decisions, and optimal move selection. In some settings, changing only the intermediate reasoning language recovers much of the lost performance, suggesting that language can affect different stages of the decision process. These results show that skill discrepancies are a measurable major roadblock in the development of truly multilingual models. Better understanding these discrepancies can help us design models that perform more equitably across languages.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 技能问题:技能语言-Invariant在法学硕士课程中吗?
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型获得不同语言的知识不一致,但在与不同语言互动时,其技能组合有何种程度的差异? 这项工作从知识和一般基准业绩中将跨语言技能的正统不一致加以量化。 我们通过多种语言的自我游戏来做到这一点:在基于文字的游戏中,同一模式的两个实例竞争,每个实例通过不同的语言界面进行交互. 由于模型,对手,规则,状态空间,以及可用的动作仍然固定不变,这种设置隔离了语言对模型实现的行为的影响. 我们建立了TextArena的多语种扩展,并评价了涵盖8种语言和6种游戏的3种开放量级模型,涵盖空间推理,不完善的信息,资源分配,以及反复互动. 我们发现,同一模式在各种语言之间可以显示出显著不同的演奏实力,在赢-输幅度、无效行动和战略倾向方面有系统的变化。 详细的分析揭示了特定语言在空间推理,卡片条件决定,最佳移动选择方面的失败. 在一些设置中,只改变中间推理语言恢复了大部分失去的性能,说明语言可以影响决定过程的不同阶段. 这些结果表明,技能差异是开发真正多语种模式方面一个可衡量的主要障碍。 更好地理解这些差异可以帮助我们设计出在语言间发挥更公平作用的模型.

articles.title: Unfolding Scientific Papers into Multi-Turn Generation Trajectories for Continued Pre-Training
articles.content: A recent line of synthetic-data work reconstructs the thinking behind existing text rather than rewriting the text itself, but it operates on short web passages, recovers only local thoughts, and leaves the structure of whole documents untouched. Scientific papers are written to a clear and largely uniform structure and make a natural substrate for lifting this paradigm to the document level. We present a pipeline that unfolds each paper into a multi-turn generation trajectory in which a teacher model reconstructs the writing process of the whole paper: a writing request, a global plan, and pre-writing deliberation for each section. All section texts and the abstract are kept verbatim from the source paper. We apply the pipeline to quality-filtered arXiv papers and obtain a corpus for continued pre-training (CPT) that is roughly twice the size of the source text. The same reverse construction extends to instruction data and evaluation. Treating real paper text as the answer yields an SFT dataset. Anchoring tasks in held-out papers yields PAW-Bench, an academic-writing benchmark whose tasks carry their own rubrics and checklists. In controlled experiments CPT on our corpus followed by supervised fine-tuning on public datasets improves writing benchmarks broadly while preserving general reasoning and improving long-document reading. The writing gain persists even when every model is fine-tuned on a dedicated writing SFT dataset. Mixing our SFT data into that recipe lifts academic writing further.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 将科学论文合并到多轮生成轨迹中,以继续进行预培训
articles.content_zh: 最近一行的合成数据工作重建了现存文本背后的思维,而不是重写文本本身,但它在短的网页段落上运行,只恢复了局部的想法,使整个文档的结构没有受到影响. 科学论文是写给一个清晰且基本统一的结构的,为将这一范式提升到文件级别而做一个自然的底座. 我们提出一个管道,将每份文件都排入一个多回合生成的轨道,一个教师模型在其中重建整份文件的写作过程:写作请求、一个全球计划,以及每个部分的预写审议。 所有节文和摘要均从原始文件逐字保留。 我们把管道用在质量过滤的arXiv纸张上,并获得大约两倍于原始文本的继续预训(CPT)的教程。 同样的反向构思延伸到指令数据和评价. 将真实的纸张文本作为答案处理,生成一个 SFT 数据集。 搁置的论文中的任务产生PAW-Bench这一学术写作基准,其任务带有自己的标题和清单。 在管制实验中,欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚委员会进行了关于我们人身保护的试验,随后对公共数据集进行了有监督的微调,大大改进了写作基准,同时保留了一般推理和改进长文件阅读。 即使每个模型在专用的写作SFT数据集上都经过微调,写入增益仍然持续. 将我们的SFT数据混入这个食谱会进一步提升学术写作.

articles.title: Localize-Then-Decide Guarantees for LLM Judgments
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as evaluators to assess output quality and preference alignment, yet providing reliable guarantees of agreement with human judgments remains challenging. Recent work introduces confidence-thresholding methods that provide such guarantees for pairwise comparisons, relying on the assumption that higher estimated confidence implies lower disagreement risk with humans. However, this assumption can break down when the number of candidate responses increases, since distributing probability mass across many alternatives can distort confidence estimates. To address this issue, we propose a Localize-Then-Decide framework. First, conformal prediction localizes a small shortlist that contains the human-preferred response with high probability. Then, a calibrated confidence-based rule selectively chooses a single response from this shortlist or abstains. This design restores the monotonic relationship between confidence and disagreement risk and enables high-probability agreement guarantees. Experiments with multiple candidate sizes across several datasets and judge LLMs demonstrate that our framework consistently achieves higher guarantee success rates and substantially higher coverage than single-stage baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 地方化-然后确定LLM判决的担保
articles.content_zh: 越来越多的大型语言模型作为评价者用来评估产出质量和偏好调整,但提供与人类判断一致的可靠保证仍然是挑战。 最近的工作引入了信心率高的方法,为对等比较提供了这种保障,所依据的假设是,高估计信心意味着与人类的分歧风险降低。 然而,当候选答复数量增加时,这一假设可以打破,因为在许多替代品中分配概率质量会扭曲信心估计。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了本地化-然后是 " Decide " 的框架。 首先,一致的预测将包含人类首选反应的小型短名单本地化,极有可能。 然后,一个经过校准的基于信心的规则有选择地从这个短名单中选择一个单一的答复或弃权. 这种设计恢复了信心与分歧风险之间的单调关系,实现了高概率协议保证. 多个数据集的多个候选规模的实验和法官有限责任公司证明,我们的框架一贯取得较高的保证成功率,其覆盖面大大高于单阶段基线。

articles.title: MoganBert-TR: A Turkish Encoder Foundation Model Trained from Scratch with a CLM-to-MLM Curriculum
articles.content:
Turkish encoder models have adopted modern architectures while leaving the pretraining objective fixed at masked language modelling. This paper introduces MoganBert-TR, a 149M-parameter Turkish encoder foundation model trained from scratch on a language-specifically filtered corpus, together with an embedding model derived from it (MoganBert-Embed).
  MoganBert-TR is trained over 237.3B tokens with a two-stage CLM-to-MLM curriculum: causal language modelling first, masked language modelling for the remainder, with the transition made inside the stable phase of a WSD schedule. In a controlled ablation under an equal step budget, this design outperforms pure MLM by 2.7-3.7x on Turkish MS MARCO retrieval; the measured mechanism is embedding geometry, where a single direction absorbs 28.1% of the variance under pure MLM against 11.9% under the curriculum. Long-context extension and learning-rate decay are then split into two branches after a shared prefix: running the final portion of decay at 1024 context improves the TrGLUE average by 0.49 +/- 0.26 points across five paired seeds (p = 0.013) and beats a model-soup alternative by 0.75 points at ~4.3% additional cost.
  MoganBert-TR attains 78.41 on TrGLUE, the best among the Turkish ModernBERT models compared, and 77.73 on TabiBench, where it leads two of the eight categories with the largest margin on code retrieval (+3.62 points over TabiBERT). MoganBert-Embed, produced through teacher distillation and multi-signal contrastive fine-tuning, ranks first among student models on the MTEB(Turkish) overall average with 68.30 and reaches 99.5% of its 7.57B-parameter teacher's score with a 51x smaller backbone. The accompanying 50,048-token tokenizer outperforms all compared Turkish tokenizers on compression and fertility across two independent test sets. Weights, tokenizer, embedding model and evaluation code: https://huggingface.co/moganai
